Nanfeng Yunxi froze in place as soon as she arrived there, and she immediately became wary of the two women. She could sense that Feng Yao was stronger than her, but she could not sense Shang Yumei's cultivation, especially since she had already broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm. 'How could it be? Why are two powerful women like them willing to stay by his side?'

"It seems that Xiu Hanyu did not tell you about my presence in this realm." Nanfeng Yunxi's eyes widened as she stared at Feng Yao, and she immediately realized her true identity. "As you might have guessed, I am a member of the Phoenix Race, and I am their princess."
"What?" Nanfeng Yun let out a soft cry. "Are... are you really the Phoenix Princess? Why... why are you in this realm?"
Just as Feng Yao was about to answer Nanfeng Yunxi, Zhang Fei suddenly hugged her waist. "Naturally, Yao'er stayed in this realm because of me, especially since she is my future wife."
'Shameless!' Feng Yao and Shang Yumei screamed in their hearts.

Nanfeng Yunxi stiffened in place, as her gaze kept shifting between Zhang Fei and Feng Yao. Moreover, the phoenix princess maintained a relaxed expression and did not remove his hand from her waist. 'Is he really her future husband? How could a princess like her be willing to marry such a weakling?'

"I asked you to come here because I wanted to offer you something." Nanfeng Yunxi raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei. "You may not know about it, but Huoyun Zhiyan asked Xiu Hanyu to send you to me, and he hoped that I would be captivated by your beauty and sexiness. They did not explain to you about Yao'er being by my side, which meant they were willing to sacrifice you. Therefore, I invite you to join us, as we can provide you with a better opportunity compared to the Alchemy Union."
Nanfeng Yunxi did not immediately respond to Zhang Fei's offer, but she was already aware that her masters and higher-ups wanted to use her against him regardless of the risks.

"The Alchemy Union does dominate the alchemy market in the middle realms, but they can't do anything in the upper realms." Nanfeng Yunxi did not deny Zhang Fei's words, especially since she had heard about her higher-ups' actions in trying to invade the upper realm in the past, which failed miserably. "On the other hand, Yao'er's parents are the leaders of the alchemists in the upper realms, and they have a close relationship with the alchemy god and goddess."
"The alchemy god and goddess?" Nanfeng Yunxi was shocked to hear those two nicknames, especially since both of them had reached the pinnacle of alchemy.

Feng Yao told Nanfeng Yunxi directly. "Tian Shuxiang is the alchemy god, and Lin Jingxia is the alchemy goddess. As their nickname suggests, they are the best alchemists in the three mortal realms, and no one dares to claim to be the best alchemist in the presence of the two of them. Like you, I am an alchemist, currently ranked in the ancestor realm, but I am on track to achieve saint-rank alchemy in the near future. If you are willing to join us, you can surpass the higher-ups of the Alchemy Union in the future."

Their offer greatly piqued Nanfeng Yunxi's interest. From childhood to adulthood, she lived in the Alchemy Union under the guidance of Xiu Hanyu, who taught her all she knew about alchemy. Although they clearly wanted to sacrifice her to win Zhang Fei's attention, she still found it difficult to turn away from her master and organization.
Zhang Fei suddenly disappeared from Nanfeng Yunxi's sight and reappeared behind her, shocking her.

"Is your loyalty to the Alchemy Union more important than yourself?" Nanfeng Yunxi wanted to turn back, but Zhang Fei suddenly hugged her waist and used his enhanced demon touch on her, making her legs weak. "They planned to use you to seduce me, and it goes without saying that I wouldn't turn down such a wonderful woman as you. If I wanted to, I could get you right away, but I don't intend to."
"Mhmm..." Nanfeng Yunxi moaned softly as her lust began to increase. 'Ugh! He had just hugged me, but I felt aroused.' "Mhmm... please let me go; you're making me uncomfortable."
Nanfeng Yunxi could have attacked Zhang Fei, but she knew that Shang Yumei and Feng Yao would immediately take action if she did so, which would only harm her.
Zhang Fei did not immediately release Nanfeng Yunxi. Instead, he put a pill into her mouth. "It's not a poison pill, so swallow it without fear, and you'll like the effects."

Nanfeng Yunxi first looked at Feng Yao, who nodded at her. She then swallowed Zhang Fei's pill directly, using her qi to dissolve and spread it. In a few minutes, she experienced a significant increase in the Yin Qi within her body, and her Yin Qi also became purer than before. 'Did the Phoenix Princess teach him to concoct the pill? My master once taught me to concoct a pill that can purify and strengthen Yin and Yang Qi, but the effect is not as strong or fast as his pill.'

"Have you realized the effects of my Yin Purifying Pill?" Nanfeng Yunxi nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately showed her several types of pills, which caused her eyes to widen in shock. "See? My alchemist rank is still at the Grandmaster Rank, but I concocted all these pills myself, and all of them are superior grades. Unlike you, I just learned alchemy a month and a half ago, and I will successfully concoct a rank 4 pill soon. Once I succeed in concocting it, I will become a king-rank alchemist."
Upon hearing that, Nanfeng Yunxi immediately turned her head back, making her face just an inch away from Zhang Fei's. "Did you really concoct all these pills?"

"Do I need to lie to you?" Zhang Fei then took off the veil covering Nanfeng Yunxi's face, causing her to frown, especially since she never showed her face to anyone except her master. "Despite your aloof and apathetic nature, you are truly such a beauty, and I always like a woman like you."
"You—" Nanfeng Yunxi swallowed her words back as soon as she sensed Shang Yumei's aura.

"Aside from these pills, I still have many other things that are useful for you, but I won't show them to you now." Zhang Fei then released his embrace from Nanfeng Yunxi, took her hand, and placed his pills into her palm. However, he did not return her veil, instead keeping it hidden behind his clothes, which caused her face to darken. "You can think about my offer first, and you can meet some of my wives in my shop once you have made up your mind."
After saying that, Zhang Fei immediately moved between Feng Yao and Shang Yumei, escorting the two women out of the area.

"His movements are extremely fast for a cultivator at his level." Nanfeng Yunxi muttered to herself after she couldn't sense their aura. She then took out a spare veil and put it on her face before returning to the Yun Royal Capital.

However, Nanfeng Yunxi did not return to the Alchemy Union branch shop right away; instead, she went to the Sky Jade Shop in the kingdom. Zhang Fei had already guessed that she would do that, so he had already told Zhong Yan and Tang Ziyu about her.

'Are they Zhang Fei's wives?' Nanfeng Yunxi immediately ignored the two women and looked at the various items on the second floor, but she was disappointed because she couldn't find any pills or other items related to alchemy there. 'Hmm? He may not sell his pills here due to the presence of our shop, but I'm sure that he sells them in his shop in the Xian Kingdom.'

Nanfeng Yunxi then asked Zhong Yan and Tang Ziyu about it, and the two women confirmed it immediately. After that, she hurriedly left the shop and went to the Xian Kingdom to check on Zhang Fei's other pills, not caring about Qu Qiuxue's fate.

Zhong Yan and Tang Ziyu immediately informed Zhang Lingxue of Nanfeng Yunxi's departure so she could prepare to welcome her, but Zhang Fei had also informed his alchemist wife about the woman. Moreover, he had already sent Feng Yao to his shop in the Xian Royal Capital, so there was nothing to worry about.

With her high cultivation and speed, Nanfeng Yunxi arrived at the Xian Royal Capital in no time. Zhang Fei had already told Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang about her, so they paid no attention to her presence.
Nanfeng Yunxi hurriedly rushed to the Sky Jade Shop in the kingdom, where Zhang Lingxue immediately greeted her before guiding her to examine the pills in the shop.

As she listened to Zhang Lingxue's explanation, Nanfeng Yunxi repeatedly glanced at the back room, sensing Feng Yao's presence there, where the phoenix princess was guiding Chu Ying and Chu Qing on alchemy.

'So these three women are also Zhang Fei's wives?' Nanfeng Yunxi then asked Zhang Lingxue. "Did you and your husband concoct all these pills? How did you two concoct so many superior-grade pills? Even my organization doesn't have this many, and their quantity is actually quite limited. After all, we need to supply many realms, and we only have a small number of alchemists who can concoct them."

Zhang Lingxue nodded to her. "For rank 1 to 3 pills, my husband concocted them, especially since his alchemist rank just reached the grandmaster rank. As for the pills at rank 4 and above, Big Sis Yao and I concocted them."
"What is your relationship with the Phoenix Princess? Is she really your husband's future wife?" Nanfeng Yunxi curiously asked.

Nanfeng Yunxi's second question surprised Zhang Lingxue. She knew that Zhang Fei was interested in Feng Yao, but their relationship had not reached that far. "You're right; Big Sis Yao is my husband's future wife. As for our relationship, you can say that she is my master in alchemy, but our relationship is like blood sisters."
"I see." Nanfeng Yunxi nodded in understanding. "Are the two women with Princess Yao in the back room her disciples, too?"

"Not really." Zhang Lingxue replied with a shake of her head. "Big Sis Yao never intended to take in disciples, and she taught Chu Ying and Chu Qing because they were my sisters. Although they are still novice alchemists, their talent in alchemy is quite high, and they are always enthusiastic about learning it."

Nanfeng Yunxi gave a light nod and did not ask further about the Chu Sisters. She was more interested in all the pills there, such as the basic pills, the healing pills, the recovery pills, and several others. "I want to buy one batch of each pill."

"Sure." Zhang Lingxue took out several bottles of each type of pill and handed them to Nanfeng Yunxi, who immediately paid for them with jewels, given the rarity of gold coins and similar items in other realms. "Are you interested in buying other items? Our mattress is the best-selling item in all realms, and you won't be able to find it in any store."
"All realms?"

Zhang Lingxue nodded at her. "Actually, we are not natives of this Nine Stars Realm, and we came from other realms, where my husband owns several shops. However, since my husband has established relationships with several princesses from various kingdoms, this realm has now become our home."

"Oh." Nanfeng Yunxi responded with a disinterested expression, but she immediately looked at the pile of mattresses. "All right, I'll buy that one. Anyway, where does your husband get those weird items?"

"Haha." Zhang Lingxue softly laughed as she looked at the sex toy counter. "My husband comes from a unique realm, and the people in that realm use such items to satisfy themselves, especially those who have no interest in marriage. If you are interested in them, I can recommend some items for you, but you might feel strange when using them for the first time."
Nanfeng Yunxi raised her eyebrows for a moment, but some of them piqued her interest. "Please show me."
A faint smile appeared on Zhang Lingxue's face, and she led Nanfeng Yunxi over. She selected several items and explained their functions to her, so she would have no trouble using them.

Although Nanfeng Yunxi felt embarrassed by all of this, she did not show it on her face. She eventually decided to buy some items according to Zhang Lingxue's recommendations, one of which was a costume.

Once Nanfeng Yunxi had settled all the bills, Zhang Lingxue extended an invitation to accompany her to the Sky Jade Restaurant, as per Zhang Fei's request, with the expectation that she would agree to join him after talking with his wife.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was already in his shop in the Bai Kingdom, where the number of customers was significantly higher than in the Yun Kingdom, particularly considering the latter kingdom's smaller size.
From the back room, Zhang Fei could see some familiar faces visiting his shop, and they were the senior cultivators he had deliberately used to kill Lian Jinshu and the others some time ago.

Han Yuanzhi immediately sat on Zhang Fei's lap and put his arms around his neck. "Bai Zizhen is Bai Yaowei's uncle, and he was enraged when we discovered the Alchemy Union's warehouse was already empty when we arrived. We ordered our clans to look for the culprit, but you managed to deceive all of us."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Do you have a close relationship with Xiong Ningwu? Is her Xiong Clan powerful?"
- To Be Continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 705 Invitation
paragraphs: "Do you also want to have Xiong Ningwu by your side?"
"No." Zhang Fei immediately denied it. "Xiong Ningwu is indeed strong, but I have no interest in her. Like your Han clan, I want her Xiong clan to be a part of my organization."

"The strongest clan in this kingdom is definitely the Bai Clan, and the second is the Linghu Clan. Regrettably, Huangfu Shou's control over Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng led to the split of both clans, scattering their members across various kingdoms. If you can unite them again, you can get their support. The other powerful clans are my Han Clan, the Kong Clan, the Xiong Clan, and the Tu Clan." Han Yuanzhi then asked him. "Did you hide Linghu Yincheng and her three children in another realm?
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Four of them are in the Azure Sky Realm, and my third clone watches over them."

"I see." Han Yuanzhi then told him. "If you wish to gain the support of the Bai Clan, you should approach Bai Zizhen and Bai Shushi. After Bai Yaowei split his clan, they led the two largest factions within it. If you are willing to support his people, you can easily persuade that old man. Additionally, Bai Tian'er has already fallen in love with you, and if you are willing to accept her, you can gain her mother's support. Despite their poor condition, the people of the Linghu Clan are still loyal to Linghu Yincheng. Since you've rescued her and her three children, I'm confident she won't mind joining you, and you can have her clan as your subordinates."

"In that case, I will send my third clone to Linghu Yincheng, and I will meet Bai Zizhen after this." Zhang Fei then thought for some time. "I know Bai Tian'er is in love with me, but she is too manipulative and greedy, so I have never been interested in her and have rejected her several times."

"Haha." Han Yuanzhi laughed at Zhang Fei's remark about Bai Tian'er. "Believe me, I know Tian'er much better than you, and she isn't that kind of person. "All right." Linghu Yincheng nodded at him.

Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei were shocked when the gate opened before their eyes. Zhang Xiaolong [3] first looked at Bai Shouyi, but he didn't say anything to her and disappeared into the gate directly.
After Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, Linghu Xiaoting asked Linghu Yincheng. "Empress, could you please explain to us why he helped you?"
Linghu Yincheng invited Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei to sit with her and her three children. Bai Chongxi explained to them, starting with their encounter with Zhang Fei at the Star Tower.

After they had talked enough, Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei immediately returned to their hiding place to inform their clan members about Linghu Yincheng's decision to join Zhang Fei's organization.

Linghu Yincheng then looked at her daughter and caressed her head. "I know you want to talk to Zhang Fei, but he is still busy taking care of many things right now. I hope you can be patient and wait for him to have some free time."
"I know, mother." Bai Shouyi replied with a nod, but she still felt sad in her heart.

After he satisfied Han Yuanzhi with a round of dual cultivation, Zhang Fei immediately asked the two women to get dressed. However, Ling Long had a sullen face. "You don't have to act like this, okay? Aren't you afraid to do that?"
"Yeah." Ling Long didn't deny it. "I'm still afraid to do that kind of thing, but Zhang Lin and the others have told me that it's not painful, so I want to try it with you."
Zhang Fei smiled and pinched Ling Long's cheeks. "Naturally, I won't cause you pain, so you don't need to be afraid anymore, and you will definitely enjoy it later."
"Hehehe." Ling Long giggled and hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "In that case, let's meet those clans now, and we will enter into seclusion afterward."

paragraphs: Zhang Fei and the others' first stop was the residence of one of the Bai Clan members, and Shang Yumei also joined them.
Han Yuanzhi immediately led them to meet Bai Zizhen, but the old man fell into a daze after seeing her new appearance, and his eyes showed interest in her.
'This old fart!' Han Yuanzhi immediately hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "Old man! We came here to offer you something."
Han Yuanzhi's words brought Bai Zizhen back to his senses, but he frowned because she was hugging Zhang Fei's arm so intimately. "Before you make an offer, tell me how to recover your youth."

"Senior Yumei helped me regain my youth." Han Yuanzhi deliberately used Shang Yumei as a scapegoat, especially since she was sure that Bai Zizhen would not dare to say anything to her, considering their vast cultivation differences.
Shang Yumei naturally didn't mind it, especially since it would keep Zhang Fei out of danger.
'This woman is truly powerful, and her cultivation should be several major levels above mine!' Bai Zizhen then cupped his hands toward Shang Yumei. "Did you come from the upper realms, Senior?"
"I don't need to explain anything to you." Shang Yumei then hugged Zhang Fei's other arm. "My husband wants to offer you something, and I don't want to hear your refusal."

'Tch! How did this kid come to be so fortunate? Han Yuanzhi liked him, and this senior even referred to him as her husband. Bai Zizhen then glanced at Ling Long, and he could immediately recognize her identity. "What kind of an offer do you have, young master?"

'This kid! How could his killing intent be this strong? Had he killed countless living beings to make his killing intent this strong?' "Xian Xianqin is my wife."

"What? Is that true?" Bai Zizhen asked in shock.

"Even a powerful cultivator like Big Sis Yumei is willing to be his wife, let alone young women like me, Yun Xinyue, and Zhou Shenxin. Even so, Bai Zizhen still seemed doubtful about everything, and he contacted Xiong Ningwu to confirm it. After she gave him the answer, the old man agreed to Zhang Fei's offer. "Young master, as long as you are willing to help my clan members, I will bring them into your organization, and I dare to guarantee with my life that they will never betray you."

"I want the Bai Clan members under your leadership to join my organization." Zhang Fei's response surprised Bai Shushi once again, and he immediately showed her the Linghu Clan's plaque. "Linghu Yincheng has returned, and her Linghu Clan has joined me. Three other clans, including Bai Zizhen's clan, have also joined me."

Bai Shushi was not surprised that Zhang Fei managed to save Linghu Yincheng, especially since Bai Tian'er had already told her many things about him, including the abilities that he demonstrated at the Star Tower. However, she was surprised by her uncle's decision, especially since she knew Bai Zizhen's character for sure. "Has Uncle Zizhen really agreed to join you?"
"You can contact him directly to ask for confirmation."

Bai Shushi nodded to Zhang Fei before contacting Bai Zizhen, who told her that he was discussing it with members of the Bai Clan under his leadership. "I am willing to accept your offer but on one condition."
"Bai Tian'er, right?"

"Yes." Bai Shushi then spoke to Zhang Fei. "My daughter has told me many things about you, including some things from when you two were at the Star Tower. Tian'er told me why you rejected her, but I can assure you that your perceptions of her are wrong. I don't deny that she has taken advantage of many other men for our benefit, but she is not that kind of woman, and she did it because of the force of the situation. I didn't ask you to accept her straight away, but I hope you are willing to give her a chance to prove that she is different from your opinion."

"All right, I will give Bai Tian'er a chance to prove herself." Zhang Fei himself had already thought carefully about Han Yuanzhi's previous words, so he immediately agreed to Bai Shushi's wishes. Bai Shushi did not respond to Zhang Fei directly, but she gave him the Bai Clan's plaque. "I will speak to my clan members regarding this matter, and you can use this plaque to order them."

Bai Shushi ignored that and contacted Bai Tian'er directly, informing her about her decision and Zhang Fei's, which made her overjoyed.

"According to my master, he has already turned the man into Ruo Yanxi, and the Huangfu Emperor will not realize that his concubine is not the real one, especially since their auras are similar."

"No!" Wushuang vigorously shook her head.

Wushuang clenched both fists tightly. "I know."

chapters.title: Chapter 708 Building His Force III
paragraphs: "That's because my grandfather, my parents, and all my clan members are idiots! They care more about Huangfu Shou's affairs than their family, and they don't hesitate to sacrifice their family for him. If they want to die for him, then just let them die and rot in their graves. However, my life is a choice, and I will never sacrifice myself for an evil person such as him." Ling Long then asked Zhang Fei. "Why don't you show her those two people? That way, she will realize the situation, and she will understand that her husband will never have a chance to win."
"Who are those two people?"
"You'll meet them in a moment." A few minutes later, Zhang Fei opened the gate to the Yin-Yang Space.
Ruo Yanxi's eyes widened as soon as two men walked out of it. "Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Ziyuan?"
Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Ziyuan were no longer shocked to see Ruo Yanxi, especially since they witnessed how Zhang Fei turned Du She into her.

"Do you still think your husband will win against my husband?" Ling Long asked in a mocking tone. "Huangfu Shou would never guess that his brother and son have already become my husband's slaves, and they will be his trump cards to destroy him."
"Master, my brother contacted me just now, and he asked us to come back." Huangfu Ziyuan suddenly informed Zhang Fei.

Huangfu Lian also told Zhang Fei. "My father asked me to bring Ling Long back with us. If she doesn't come back with me, my father will be suspicious of her, and he will send Ling Baozi to look for her."

paragraphs: A while later, they arrived at a hill on a deserted island. Although Zhang Fei [5] did not see anything there, the map showed an entrance. Han Yuanzhi immediately took out a talisman and activated it, causing a transparent barrier to appear before their eyes.

'Compared to the formation in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place, this formation is nothing.' Zhang Fei [5] muttered in his heart as he followed them until they arrived at a large room with a large stone table and stone chairs inside.
Once they had gathered around the stone table, Bai Zizhen immediately inquired. "So, what are your detailed plans? Are we going to fight Huangfu Shou openly?"
"Do you really think we can do that?" Bai Zizhen frowned at Zhang Fei [5]. "Please be patient; I'll explain everything after the others arrive."
"The others?"
Zhang Fei [5] then opened several portals at once, and several people emerged from them. They were Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, Yun Shang, and Guo Xuehua.
After he closed them, Zhang Fei [5] opened another portal, through which two unexpected people emerged.
'This kid! How did he manage to call forth the Elf Emperor and Empress?' Bai Zizhen, Bai Shushi, Xiong Ningwu, Kong Heng, Tu Shen, Linghu Xiaoting, and Linghu Shiwei wondered in their hearts.

At first, Zhang Fei [5] was unsure whether Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling would be willing to join them, especially since they disliked humans. However, he tried to contact them, and to his surprise, they accepted his invitation. "Let's wait for some other people."
"Who else are we waiting for?" Xiong Ningwu asked him.
Zhang Fei [5] just smiled and looked out. "They're here."
Soon, five people walked in, and those clan leaders immediately recognized four of them. However, they did not recognize Feng Yao, who was leading them.
The seven individuals experienced a fresh wave of shock. 'What the hell? How could he summon the Beast Emperor and Empress? Who is the woman in front of them?'

Bai Zizhen and the leaders of those clans felt pressured by their presence, especially since the auras of Long Huang, Long Baiyun, Xian Lianghua, and Xue Jingling were too strong for them despite their equal cultivation.

"Brother!" Long Tian and Long Chen shouted as they ran to Zhang Fei [5], who had already stood up from his seat. "We waited for you in our kingdom, but you never came. However, we didn't expect that you would send Senior Feng Yao to us, and here we are now."

"Haha." Long Huang laughed and moved to Zhang Fei [5]'s side. "I've been wanting to meet you for a long time, and we finally meet now. Actually, I wanted to spar with you, but it seems like we can't do it now, especially since we have more important problems."

"Old Long, your brain is only filled with fighting." If someone else had said that, Long Huang would have been furious, and he would have attacked directly. However, it was Xian Lianghua who made the statement, to which he only responded with a wide grin. "I believe this is the first time we've all come together in one place, correct?"
"If it weren't for Zhang Fei, we would never have gathered like this, Emperor Lianghua." Yun Shang and the others agreed with Xian Feng. "Now that we're all together, we can start our discussion."

Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Feng Yao and Shang Yumei, who immediately explained to those people about the strength of the Huangfu Clan from the Grand Royal Realm, which made their expressions turn extremely serious.
"Can we face them if they come here?" Yun Shang posed the question in a serious tone.

"The level difference between cultivators from the middle and upper realms is too big, so you guys have no chance of winning against them, especially since the cultivation of the strongest among them is in the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm." Feng Yao's answer caused all of them to take a deep breath. "Even if that person doesn't come to this realm in person, many people from his clan can crush you guys easily. Therefore, we must exercise extreme caution when dealing with Huangfu Shou, particularly considering their periodic visits to this realm. If they know that their clan members' situation is at stake, they will immediately attack all the residents of this realm."
"So what can we do to prevent that from happening?" Xue Jingling asked.
Xian Lianghua directly added to his wife's words. "After all, you guys won't stop until you can get rid of Huangfu Shou, and your actions will affect the future of this realm."

"Actually, my and Shang Yumei's presence in this realm can provide a deterrent against them, especially since they wouldn't dare go against our Phoenix and Shang Clans." Despite Feng Yao's statement, Long Huang and Yang sensed that the situation would not be as simple as it seemed. Unfortunately, the Huangfu Clan has too many crazy people and many clans under them who are willing to die for them, so they will fight us no matter what. Moreover, they have many branch clans in many realms, and they can escape whenever they want."

"My Shang Clan is indeed strong, but the situation there is not as peaceful as you imagine, so I cannot ask for their help." Shang Yumei then turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "My husband could mobilize some people who were stronger than Huangfu Shou's ancestors, but it was too risky and would blow his disguise, and other powerful cultivators might come to this realm to hunt him down."
'Stronger cultivators? How far is his connection actually?' All of them wondered as they looked at Zhang Fei [5].

Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to them. "Honestly, it doesn't matter if my cover is blown, and I just need to start everything from scratch. However, things will become more and more difficult for me, especially since my enemies are much stronger than the Huangfu Clan. Even the Shang and Phoenix Clans wouldn't dare to face them head-on, so I have to think things through carefully."
"Who are your main enemies?" Long Huang asked.

Zhang Fei [5] sighed deeply before revealing the information to them. "They are the ancestors of the Heavenly Fox Race, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, whose cultivation has already reached the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm."
"Huh?" Long Huang, Long Baiyun, Xian Lianghua, and Xue Jingling were shocked when they heard that.
Long Baiyun then asked him. "Aren't you a heavenly fox yourself? Why are they hostile to you?"

'What is a heavenly fox? Isn't he human? Why did Empress Long ask if he was a heavenly fox?' After all, Bai Zizhen and the others were unfamiliar with Zhang Fei [5], so they lacked knowledge about his other identities.

"Empress Long, I am indeed a heavenly fox, but I am not one of them." The four people looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion. "In fact, I come from the lower realms, and they have already hunted me down once in my home realm. Fortunately, they only dispatched their younger generation during that period, and Feng Yao assisted me in stopping them. I am unable to delve into the specifics of our situation due to its complexity, as revealing too much could put all of you at risk."
They chose not to delve deeper into the matter between Zhang Fei [5] and the fox race, as they lacked the ability to fight the heavenly fox.
Long Baiyun then asked him again. "Then, what about your plans regarding Huangfu Shou?"

"Actually, I have already started my plan against Huangfu Shou, but I will not execute it openly." Zhang Fei [5] then explained to them about Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian's situation. "Even though I am sure that the Huangfu Clan of the Grand Royal Realm will not know of my actions against them, I still invite all of you to gather at this place. This way, you guys know the detailed situation, and you can prepare for the worst if they see through my actions. If the situation is really urgent, I will use my last card to end everything. However, I have to take my family away from this realm after that, and we will hide in another realm. Otherwise, my enemies will come and destroy this realm, and countless people will suffer because of me."

"Where would you go if that happened?" Xian Feng asked Zhang Fei [5], especially since he was his son-in-law. Unfortunately, he couldn't possibly leave his kingdom, or his kingdom would fall into chaos without a leader.

"I haven't thought about that possibility, so I still don't know my next destination. Perhaps I'll take my family to the upper realms directly, and we'll hide on one of the planets there until my strength is sufficient to deal with my enemies." Zhang Fei [5] then shifted their conversation to another topic. "Anyway, I will postpone taking action against Huangfu Shou until Li Tiannan returns to this realm. Once I have dealt with him, I will proceed with my next plan. For the time being, I will concentrate on Zhou Xiaochuan and the Zhou Kingdom, and I will push Zhou Shenxin to succeed his father."
"Are you sure your plan will go smoothly?" Guo Xuehua asked him. "After all, people in the Zhou Kingdom look down on women, and they will definitely put up a hard fight against Zhou Shenxin."

"Actually, you don't have to think about that, Empress Guo." Zhang Fei [5] then told them. "Currently, Zhou Xiaochuan's aides and Kong Zi are already under my control, and all his wives are in bad condition, so he is alone now. As for those nobles, I will use his subordinates to get rid of them if they really intend to fight, and I will reorganize the kingdom after they are gone."
After Zhang Fei [5] said that, the atmosphere in the place became silent, and everyone stared at him in disbelief, especially because his actions were so quick and precise.

Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Bai Zizhen and the others. I want you to check all the Bai Kingdom clans for now, as I'm afraid some support Huangfu Shou. To avoid bigger problems, you can get rid of those clans, and we can focus on the issues of the royal family."
Xiong Ningwu and the others immediately agreed with Zhang Fei [5]. "Speaking of which, you asked us to join your organization, but you haven't told us its name."
"The demon fox." They frowned to hear that name from Zhang Fei [5]. "I am a human, but I am also a demon."
"What?" Han Yuanzhi was not surprised to hear that, especially since Zhang Fei [5] had already revealed the truth to her.
Tu Shen pointed at Zhang Fei [5]. "You... are you really a demon?"

"Do I need to lie to you?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately transformed into his demon form, causing Tu Shen and the others to jump back. "Aren't you guys overreacting? Look at my parents-in-law and the others; none of them reacted like you guys."
Bai Zizhen, Bai Shushi, Xiong Ningwu, Kong Heng, Tu Shen, Linghu Xiaoting, and Linghu Shiwei immediately looked at them all.

"We've known for a long time that he is a demon, but we have no problem with that." Xian Feng was the first to answer. Yun Shang and the others immediately nodded at the people, confirming that they already knew Zhang Fei [5]'s demon identity.

"Just like humans and beasts, not all demons are evil." They turned to Long Huang. "Moreover, he has helped you guys a lot, right? Would he do all that if he were an evil demon? If he was an evil demon, you guys wouldn't be able to do anything against him, and you would have fallen into his control by now."
Xian Lianghua joined in. "You guys surely know that I hate those demons from the two demon kingdoms, right? I don't mind his demon identity, and I welcome him to my kingdom."

"As soon as possible, you guys must do it secretly so as not to arouse Huangfu Shou's suspicion." They immediately agreed with Zhang Fei [5], who had already transformed back into his human form. "In that case, you guys can go back now, and you can report the results to me."

"What if we apply the same method we used in the Zhou Kingdom to the Huangfu Kingdom?" Yun Shang inquired.

Once I come out of seclusion, we will immediately take over his kingdom."
"How long will you be in seclusion this time?"

Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment before answering Shi Qingzhuang. "I plan to take them into seclusion for three to six months, mother-in-law. However, I will continue to monitor the situation of the three kingdoms, so your armies just need to be prepared in the Zhou Kingdom and wait for me to come out."
Shi Qingzhuang and the others nodded in understanding. "In that case, we will prepare our armies from now on, and we will move once you come out of seclusion."

Instead, Zhang Fei [5] asked Long Huang. "Emperor Long, you are a water dragon, right? I have a wife with a powerful water element, but she lacks a special bloodline. Therefore, I want to get a few drops of your bloodline for her, and I am willing to exchange it for anything."
Zhang Fei [5]'s request not only shocked Long Huang, but Long Baiyun and their two sons were also shocked by it, especially since their dragon bloodline was too precious.
"Heavenly fox is also a mythical beast; what if I exchange my bloodline with yours?"

Zhang Fei [5]'s offer tempted Long Huang, but Feng Yao spoke quickly. "You must not give your bloodline to him. He was indeed a dragon, but he would not be able to fight against Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian. If they find out that he has your bloodline, they will kill him and his family."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a heavy sigh. He then took out four Youthful Retaining Pills and Beauty Restoring Pills, explaining their respective effects to Long Huang and the others. "What do you think of my offer, Emperor Long?"
Their effects naturally tempted Long Baiyun. "Do these two pills really have that kind of effect?"

"This woman has already swallowed both of them, or else she still looks old now." Shang Yumei spoke, gesturing with her index finger at Han Yuanzhi. "Your dragon bloodline is indeed precious, but two pills each for the four of you is perfect reciprocity, right?"

Feng Yao also helped Zhang Fei [5] to persuade them. "I have already given my phoenix bloodline to one of his wives, especially since she has great talent in alchemy. His wife, who has the water element, also has great talent in cultivation. Your water dragon bloodline will not be wasted on her, so I hope you are willing to accept his offer."

chapters.title: Chapter 710 Dragon Bloodlines
paragraphs: After hearing Feng Yao give her bloodline to a human, Long Huang finally agreed. Zhang Fei [5] immediately sent them all to his residence, but he didn't return there and went somewhere else instead.
Zhang Fei immediately brought Zhang Lin to see them, but Long Huang said that he couldn't give his bloodline there, and the southern ocean was the best location to do so, so they hurried there.

Long Tian and Long Chen stayed in the residence and observed the people. They could sense that most of the women had Zhang Fei's Yang Qi in their bodies, which convinced them that they were his wives.

Unlike them, Han Yuanzhi was in shock and awe when he found out that Zhang Fei had so many women. Their number was not yet complete, as many of them were still in the four kingdoms, and the rest were in the portable mansion, dual-cultivating with his clones.
As usual, Zhang Chen took on the role of Zhang Fei's grandmother, bringing Han Yuanzhi along to engage in conversation with the family members present at the residence.

Long Huang had returned to his blue dragon form, and his body size was several times larger than Zhang Fei's complete fox form. Before he gave his bloodline to Zhang Lin, he first warned them. "Once she inherits my bloodline, she will gain many dragon characteristics, one of which is our lustful nature. She'll be your most lustful wife, but she must overcome it, or she'll only think about sex."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and hugged Zhang Lin's waist. "Emperor Long, this wife of mine is already the most lustful and perverted among my wives, even though she still doesn't have a dragon bloodline. Furthermore, as a lust demon myself, I will assist her in controlling her lustful nature."
Zhang Fei then summoned Hai Ma, the hippocampus, from the Beast Space. However, she immediately swam away from Long Huang, especially since his dragon form was too terrifying for her.
"Oh? Is that your wife's beast contract?" Long Baiyun asked.

paragraphs: "How was your meeting with Mai Xiaomeng? Did she agree to join us? Where is Qianying?" Yan Yizhen questioned Hong Xinxin as soon as she arrived.

"Sister Qianying must care for her husband and the others, as Shang Huaqiang is expected to arrive in two days, and Shang Chongyun and the others must depart for the Netherworld Realm by then." Hong Xinxin then sat in front of her mother and grandmother, informing them about Mai Xiaomeng's decision. "We all know that she and her clan members are cat beasts, and my lover is basically a powerful beast. Therefore, I used his Yang Qi to tempt her, and she agreed to join us as long as I gave her a thousand bottles every month."
Cai Yinzhi immediately asked. "Won't that be a problem for him? A thousand bottles of Yang Qi is not a small amount, and he will definitely weaken if he releases too much of it."
"Grandma, you don't need to worry about him." Hong Xinxin replied with a confident smile. "A thousand bottles of Yang Qi was only a small amount to him, and he could release more if he wanted."
"What kind of beast is he? How can he be so strong with his cultivation still in the ten mortal realms?" Both women asked in unison.

"You two will know a lot about him someday." Hong Xinxin's answer caused the two women to frown, but she did not discuss Zhang Xiaolong [3] with them further. She then used the interspatial communication device to contact him. "I'm going back to the Wasteland Realm now, and I will ask him to prepare his Yang Qi for Mai Xiaomeng."
After Hong Xinxin left, Yan Yizhen asked her mother-in-law a question. "Do we need to follow Xin'er, mother?"
"No need." Cai Yinzhi immediately refused. "Xin'er has a good reason to hide the man's identity from us, so we don't need to do that and let her handle their relationship on her own."
"All right." Yan Yizhen replied with a nod of agreement.
Murong Qianying arrived at the Shang Clan branch and immediately asked her husband a question. "Do you want me to accompany you to the Netherworld Realm?"

"If you go with us, no one will protect your Murong Clan, so you must stay in this realm." Shang Chongyun then turned his attention to the exit. "Shang Tinglong decided to bring Ran Keqing with us, and she was more than enough to help us there. Anyway, they informed me that Shang Xiaojuan is expected to return soon, so I would like you to discuss this matter with Ai Weiren. However, I am uncertain if Ai Weiren will be willing to assist us at no cost, given her apparent greed."

"All right, I will talk to Ai Wenren when she arrives here, but I will not rely on her too much." Shang Chongyun agreed directly with Murong Qianying. "Actually, Grandma Yinzhi has already offered to help support my Murong Clan, but I will only ask for her help if I cannot control the situation."

Shang Chongyun nodded in understanding. "I am just a member of the Shang Clan's branch, so this clan is not that important, but your Murong Clan is different. No matter what, you must defend your clan from Shang Huaqiang, and if he intends to attack you, you must seek assistance from the Hong Clan. Do you know when our children will return from the Sun Tower?"

"No." Murong Qianying answered with a shake of her head. "According to the information I have, they will face many challenges in the Sun Tower, so I don't think they will return for several months or even several years. Moreover, Shang Xiaojuan will return soon, and she still hasn't forgotten our second daughter, so I hope Yaolin won't come back too soon, or their affairs will only add to my burden."
Shang Chongyun let out a heavy sigh, remembering his nephew's behavior toward Shang Yaolin. "I'll go meet Shang Tinglong and Shang Chenguang to prepare for our departure."

"All right." After Shang Chongyun left, Murong Qianying immediately leaned back in her chair. She wanted to go to the Azure Sky Realm again, but she was the only one who could take care of her Murong Clan. "Should I bring Long'er here? He can cultivate faster here, and I can be with him every day. Sigh! Forget it! It would be troublesome if Shang Huaqiang's spies found out about his presence, and they would definitely capture him immediately."

paragraphs: Feng Yao was already sitting in front of a woman with long, curly brunette hair. Unlike the female cultivators who typically wore hanfu, she was wearing a fairly modern outfit that resembled Earth's clothing.
Behind the brunette woman, a man and a woman stand with tense expressions. They felt oppressed by Feng Yao's aura, and none of them dared speak.

Without further ado, Feng Yao took out and showed the woman her phoenix token, which caused her to become tense. "Luo Xuejia, right? I believe you must have heard from Huoyun Zhiyan and the others about Feng Xishui's visit, and you must have heard about the deaths of Lian Jinshu and several others."
"Yes, I am Luo Xuejia." Even though her voice sounded calm, Luo Xuejia was afraid to offend Feng Yao. "Can you please tell me your identity, Senior? What is your purpose in coming here to see me?"

"I don't want to exchange pleasantries with you, and I came here to ask you to leave the Alchemy Union." Luo Xuejia and the two people behind her looked shocked after Feng Yao said that. "You only have two choices now: leave the organization or leave this realm."
"What do you mean by that, Senior?"

Feng Yao stared at the three for a moment before answering. "If you don't leave the organization, you will meet the same fate as Lian Jinshu and the others. If you leave the organization, I can give you a better opportunity for your future, and you can still stay here for the time being. However, the opportunity is not without conditions, but you don't need to worry because the conditions are not difficult."
"Please tell me the conditions, Senior."

"You must have heard about the Sky Jade Shop in the Xian and Yun Kingdoms, right?" Luo Xuejia nodded to Feng Yao. "My sister and her husband own the shop, and your organization has attempted to harm them. That's why I sent Feng Xishui to your higher-ups to suppress them, but those foolish people still thought of doing something by sending Nanfeng Yunxi to them."
Luo Xuejia took a deep breath and clenched both fists, especially since she already knew about Nanfeng Yunxi's arrival. "Do you want me to leave my organization and join them, Senior?"

"That's right." Feng Yao then continued. "To tell you the truth, my brother-in-law killed Lian Jinshu, Cheng Feng, and the others. Soon, Wei Chou, Qu Qiuxue, and Han Ling will follow them. If you stay in this realm, it's just a matter of time before your turn comes."
Feng Yao's statement appeared to irritate the three people, yet they did not refute her. "Why is your brother-in-law targeting me? We've never even met each other, so we don't have any problems."

"My brother-in-law's principles are simple, and he will destroy all his enemies down to the roots. Since your organization is his enemy, he also considers you as an enemy." Feng Yao's answer left Luo Xuejia and the other two shocked and flabbergasted. "Therefore, I came here to prevent that from happening, and I offered you the opportunity because of your qualities; otherwise, I wouldn't have bothered coming here. Your organization's leaders' past mistakes will slow its growth, and staying with them will slow yours. On the contrary, you will grow faster if you join my sister and brother-in-law, and you will be able to see many things that you have never imagined before."

"You don't need to decide now." Feng Yao interrupted Luo Xuejia by waving her hand. "My sister and brother-in-law are in seclusion and will leave in six months, so you have time to consider my offer."
After she said that, Feng Yao immediately disappeared from the place, especially since she felt she had enough to talk with them.
The woman behind Luo Xuejia immediately asked. "What should we do now, Big Sis?"
"Shall we inform our higher-ups about this matter, Big Sis?" The man also asked.

"Do you want to die, Pei Yun?" The man immediately shut his mouth, and Luo Xuejia answered the woman. "Actually, Yi Zuoli, the woman's words about our organization are true. Our leaders once tried to invade the upper realms, but they made a fatal mistake by causing a commotion in several realms. The alchemists from the upper realms ultimately drove them out, threatening to destroy our organization if they returned. As long as our organization cannot exist there, we will not be able to grow. If we want to continue to grow, we have to leave it and join another organization."

chapters.title: Chapter 718: Disclosure
paragraphs: "Isn't the answer easy, Grandpa?" Ling Baozi frowned as Ling Long hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "I'm not an idiot like you and the others! You guys devoted your lives to Huangfu Shou, and you guys didn't hesitate to sacrifice everything for him, including your lives. My life is my own, and I won't sacrifice my life for an evil person like him. Oh, I want to tell you that Zhang Fei is my future husband, and we will get married once he breaks through to the seven divine realms."
"You—" Ling Baozi swallowed his words once Zhang Fei pressed his sword against his neck. "Were you the one who poisoned my Ling Clan?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei openly admitted it. "I transformed one of my subordinates into Ling Long, and she helped me poison your clan members. I didn't want them to die too quickly, and they would continue to be tormented by the pain every night until they died."
"We underestimated you too much." Ling Baozi muttered to himself. "Kill me."

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I know about Huangfu Shou's ancestors, so I also know about Li Tiannan and the Huangfu Clan in the Grand Royal Realm. Therefore, I cannot kill you at this moment, and you will become my slave, just like Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian."
"Hahaha." Ling Baozi laughed as hard as he could when he heard that. "I have cultivated for thousands of years to reach this stage, but I never expected to fall into the hands of a brat like you."

"I may be a brat in your eyes, but this brat is no less experienced than you. No matter what, the kingdom you protect with your life will fall into my hands one day, and you will help me with that." After he said that, Zhang Fei pulled Ling Baozi's soul out of his body. Then, he planted his demon slave mark and soul mark into the old man's soul before returning it to his body again. "You're Ling Long's grandfather, but you're my slave, and your life is mine."

Ling Baozi couldn't help but sigh. He looked at Ling Long, but she turned her face away. After Shang Yumei unsealed his cultivation, the old man immediately stood up, and Zhang Fei gave him some pills to restore his condition. "What do you want me to do?"

"Nothing." Zhang Fei responded. "Li Tiannan has not yet returned to this realm, so I will not take any action against Huangfu Shou at this time. All you need to do is monitor them for me. Once that guy returns, I will contact you again, and that day will be the downfall of the Huangfu Kingdom."
Ling Baozi nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will return to my kingdom in a few days, or Huangfu Shou will be suspicious of me."
"Sure." Zhang Fei then sent Ling Long back into the training space. "After you return to the Huangfu Kingdom, I want you to meet Huangfu Lian and the fake Ruo Yanxi."

"What do you mean by the fake Rup Yanxi?" Zhang Fei immediately told Ling Baozi the woman's true identity, which was Du She, the sect master of the Venomous Serpent Sect. The old man looked shocked and stared at him incredulously.
Zhang Fei smirked at Ling Baozi's expression. "Do you want me to transform you into a woman? That way, you can have fun with Huangfu Shou, just like Du She."
"No!" Ling Baozi refused with a trembling body. "I'll go now."

"Ha ha." Shang Yumei laughed as she watched Ling Baozi running away like a frightened chicken. "Husband, Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan have returned. Besides, my father and the others are on their way to the Netherworld Realm, and they will probably arrive there in two months."

"Two months, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered, nodding in understanding. "Only Alder, the wolf king, can match your father and the others. However, he can't possibly defeat them by himself, so I have to think of something to stop them. Anyway, Zhou Xiaochuan's other four sons are looking for Zhou Shenxin and Jiang Tingxi, and I want you to capture them."
"Are you going to enslave them too?"

Zhang Fei refused with a shake of his head. "Those four are weaker than Zhou Fang, and I still have Zhou Hanling and the others. Since they're not useful, you can capture them and lock them up somewhere."
"All right." After Zhang Fei shared their location and information, Shang Yumei immediately moved to capture the four princes of the Zhou Kingdom.

Zhang Fei then took Zilvora to the Netherworld Realm, where they met several demons, including Cain, Arbeola, and Alder. He informed them of the expected arrival of cultivators from the Red Sun Realm, which shocked them as they were not prepared to face them.
"Do you have anyone who can help me?" Alder asked.
Zhang Fei thought for a moment before asking Mei to open a portal to the Diyu Realm. He did not stay there for long, and he soon returned with Oz the First and Morgana.

Zhang Fei then spoke to them. "If those people succeed in opening a portal to the Sky Jade Realm, it will pose a significant threat to the people living there. Since the situation in the Diyu Realm is still safe, I want you two to help Alder protect this realm for the time being."

Cain naturally remembered Oz the First and his actions in the past, so he didn't expect that Zhang Fei would bring him back to the Netherworld Realm. Despite his hatred for him, the demon prince did not say anything, especially since a great danger was threatening his realm.
"All right." Oz the First immediately agreed with Zhang Fei's request. "I owe a lot to the demons in this realm, so I will help you protect this place."
"Have you still not gone to the Nine Hells Darkland?" Morgana asked Zhang Fei.

"Not yet." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "My cultivation just broke through to the 4-Star Earth Realm today, so I'm not ready to go there yet. Once I reach the Heaven Realm and resolve all the issues in my current realm, I will go to that realm to explore the pond and search for the Soul Flame."
"The Soul Flame?" Morgana was a little surprised by that. "The flame is harder to find than the pond, so be careful and don't let those demon souls affect you."

Zhang Fei nodded to her. "I've improved myself a lot, and my soul power is quite high now, so I'm confident that I can handle those demon souls. Instead, I was thinking of using them to increase my demon rank, but I still have to think about it again, especially since such a shortcut will only make me addicted to using my techniques."

"That's true." Morgana nodded in agreement. "If you continue to use your technique, you will gradually become like Xereth, a cold-blooded demon. However, it doesn't matter if you use it once or twice at a time; it will accelerate your progress."
Zhang Fei looked at their surroundings for a moment. "In that case, I will leave this realm to the three of you, and I will bring Zilvora back to my realm now."

Zhang Fei then went to his shop in the Bai Kingdom, where two disciples from the Black Fang had already arrived. He gave Xuan Cunhua and Fang Qiuwen the basic pills, but after some thought, he gave them his Yang Qi and the dual cultivation technique, which embarrassed them. "You two are indeed strong, but I need even stronger subordinates, so you guys must use the technique and my Yang Qi to cultivate. By the way, the name of my organization is the Demon Fox Group, and Liu Hua is the main leader. However, she is currently in seclusion, so you can wait for her here with the others."
"Yes, Sect Master."

After that, Zhang Fei went to the Bai Royal Palace to talk to Old Wen, but he still ignored Wushuang. After that, he went to Bai Shushi's residence and found her having a light conversation with Bai Tian'er.
Zhang Fei decided not to meet them, and he went straight to the Sky Jade Realm to meet Feng Jinqiu in the Blazing Phoenix Sect. "Do you need my help?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei then told Feng Jinqiu about the information he had obtained regarding Cheng Gaoji. "Can you stop him from causing trouble here?"

Feng Jinqiu nodded. "Cheng Gaoji's cultivation is indeed several levels above mine, but he is not a fighting cultivator, and he is more focused on artifact creation, so I'm confident I can handle him."

If they manage to open a portal to this realm, I want you to help me freeze it. If you are unable to do so, you can eliminate every demon that enters this realm."
"My ice element can freeze almost anything, but I can't freeze a teleportation portal." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding to Feng Jinqiu. "If you really want those demons dead, I'll kill them all."
"Yes! You can kill them." Zhang Fei then looked south. "I still have other matters in this realm, so I'll take my leave now."

After Zhang Fei disappeared, Feng Jinqiu let out a soft sigh. "Two weeks ago, his cultivation was still at the 3-Star Earth Realm, but he has already reached the 4-Star now. If his progress continues at this rate, he will be able to bring Zhang Yue to the Phoenix Realm much faster than I expected, and I hope he can face the trial. Whether she dies or becomes stronger, the result lies in her hands. If she succeeds through it, she will become the strongest among all his wives."

"Does that mean you want us to join your organization?" Meng Guanqiu asked with a frown.

"Actually, I have already recruited several big clans in that realm, and I will still recruit several other clans. If you two are willing to bring your clan under my banner, it will be a great opportunity for them, and I can help them all become strong enough to protect themselves."
Meng Guanqiu turned to Meng Qi and inquired. "What do you think about that, Big Sis?"

"Are you sure about that, Big Sis?"

"One hundred percent." Meng Qi then ordered her little sister. "You can go meet Meng Zhuo and the others now, Guanqiu. Order them to pack up all the things here quickly, and we will move there as soon as they are finished."
"Yes, Big Sis."

"My Yang Qi is a shortcut for you to become strong, but you don't need to rush to use it, and you can think about it first."
"Why did you give both of them to me?" Meng Qi asked in confusion.

Zhang Fei smiled and answered him. "Since you have decided to bring your clan under my banner, they will be my subordinates soon. However, I can't handle them alone, and since you are their leader, you will be my right-hand man in managing them. Therefore, you must become much stronger than them, and both are the fastest solutions for you to achieve it."
"All right." Although she felt strange about swallowing Zhang Fei's Yang Qi, Meng Qi decided to accept it. "Can I share them with my little sister?"

"As long as Meng Guanqiu doesn't mind, you can share both of them with her." Zhang Fei then observed the members of the Meng Clan who had gathered in the main hall. "I will return to my realm now, and I will have someone prepare a place for them. I will come here in three days, and I hope they will be ready by then."
"They will be ready in three days."
"That's good."

After Zhang Fei returned to the Nine Stars Realm, Meng Qi immediately opened one of the bottles and swallowed his Yang Qi directly, causing her body to heat up from within. "His Yang Qi is much stronger than what Ma Mingxin gave me. Speaking of that woman, I'm sure she will come to this realm to look for me, so I have to escape from here as quickly as possible."
Meng Qi immediately stored all the bottles in her storage ring and rushed to join her clan members, especially since Meng Guanqiu seemed to have difficulty convincing them.

As soon as he arrived at the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei immediately went to see Xian Feng, who right away ordered Yang Caojing to prepare a place for the Meng Clan. After that, he returned to the training space and resumed dual cultivation and dual soul cultivation with all his wives. However, he did not absorb their Yin Qi, as his cultivation was still unstable after his previous breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 719: Telling Hong Xinxin
paragraphs: "Shang Huaqiang?" Hong Xinxin immediately remembered all of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s stories. "Don't tell me that you are the one who foiled his plans to invade that realm."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded. "I didn't do it alone, and someone with a far higher status than all of you helped me."
"Who?"
"Feng Yao."
"Are you kidding me?" Hong Xinxin inquired in a raised voice, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] swiftly touched her forehead and shared his memories with Feng Yao. "So you knew her in that realm?"

"The Sky Jade Realm was my first realm as a cultivator, and I found many precious things there. In fact, I met many of my wives there, and Shang Huaqiang's actions made some of them suffer. Therefore, we went to the Netherworld Realm to stop him, and I decided to disguise myself as a ten-year-old boy to infiltrate the Shang Clan." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s statement left Hong Xinxin dumbstruck, her eyes wide with shock. "However, many things changed from my original plans, and one of them was our meeting. In my eyes, all of you are my enemies, so I would never have revealed my secret to you if I had not made a mistake with my breakthrough."

Hong Xinxin's expression turned furious after that. She felt that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had deceived her too much. She had assisted him in becoming a body cultivator, taught him the lightning body cultivation technique, and provided other forms of assistance.
Hong Xinxin's aura immediately exploded, and she wanted to beat Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, her body suddenly became stiff, and her strength immediately disappeared.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled and pressed Hong Xinxin down on the bed. "As I said before, all of you are my enemies. Therefore, I have taken precautions against all of you, and I have done several things for you to prevent you from attacking me after you find out the whole truth. Not only have I taken precautions against you, but I have also taken similar actions against Murong Qianying and Shang Yumei, ensuring that you can never harm me."
"You—"

"Xinxin, I know that I deceived you, but you should already know my reasons." Hong Xinxin furiously glared at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "To tell you the truth, I have never considered you an enemy before, and I am truly grateful because you taught me about the body cultivation path. However, the situation changed when you brought Shang Yumei to Huo Yaoshui to request the potion, and ever since then, I have viewed you as my enemy."

Hong Xinxin naturally still remembered that matter, but her efforts were ultimately in vain because Huo Yaoshui's potion had no effect on Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Instead, Shang Yumei fell into his hands, and they suffered the same fate as hers.

Hong Xinxin felt that she was truly stupid, especially since she could not see through Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s deception from the start. If she could have seen through everything from the start, she would never have been in such a situation.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] planted a short kiss on Hong Xinxin's lips. "Even though I considered you my enemy, I couldn't deny my feelings for you, and I decided to snatch you from Shang Guangming because I like you."
"Liar!" Hong Xinxin furiously shouted. "If you liked me, you wouldn't deceive me to this extent!"

"I admit that I have deceived you too much, but I have never lied about my feelings." Hong Xinxin still did not believe Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Actually, I could have planted my demon slave mark on you, and you would be completely obedient to me. However, I chose not to use it on you, and I used other methods to restrict your movements. Anyway, let me show you a few things."

In a few seconds, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already brought Hong Xinxin into the Yin-Yang Space, and he showed her those female prisoners. "All of them are my enemies, but they are different from you, and I planted my demon slave mark into their souls. If I order them to serve me, they will obediently do so. However, I am not fond of them, and I have never touched them."

Hong Xinxin remained silent in response to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and continued to observe the nine women who were fast asleep. She was more curious about the glass tube in the middle of the room, especially since there was so much Qi inside it.

"Using one of my demon abilities, I imprisoned their subconscious, causing their bodies to continue producing Yin Qi, which this glass tube will contain." Hong Xinxin turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock because she had never heard of such a thing before. "In addition to the Yin Qin in this glass tube, I have several other abilities that I can use to absorb other people's cultivation attainment and comprehension."
"Does that mean you used your abilities to achieve your previous breakthrough?" Even though Hong Xinxin was furious with him, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could still hear the worry in her tone.

"My previous enemy was a cultivator at the 5-Star Divine Expansion Realm, and I gained a lot of Qi after I absorbed his cultivation." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer shocked Hong Xinxin, especially since the difference in cultivation between him and his enemy was like heaven and earth. "Unlike dual cultivation, this glass tube and my technique bypass the difference in cultivation level, and I can absorb the cultivation of cultivators who are much stronger than me without worrying that my body will explode."

"Try it on me." Hong Xinxin's expression turned painful as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] used all three of his absorption abilities, but he only used them for a few seconds. "What kind of demon are you really? Where did you get this place?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] instantly transformed into his lust demon form, causing Hong Xinxin to step back. "I am a lust demon, and most of my abilities are related to lust. My abilities are unrelated to cultivation, and they don't require the use of Qi, which is why no one noticed my actions. Not many people can withstand their effects, including you and Murong Qianying. So far, only two people have been able to resist my abilities, and one of them is Feng Yao. As for this place, I got it from someone, but I don't know her identity because he gave it to me after he resurrected me from the dead. Although I don't know her, I believe that she is much stronger than all the cultivators in the upper realms, including the Nameless One."
Hong Xinxin stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in utter shock. She felt that his words about the woman were true, especially since she had never heard of anyone who could bring someone back from the dead.
Hong Xinxin turned to the portal that had just appeared, and Shang Yumei walked out of it with a playful smile on her face. "You finally know the truth, huh?"
"Has he told you everything, too?"

"Isn't that obvious? Otherwise, I wouldn't be here right now, right?" Hong Xinxin nodded to Shang Yumei. "At first, I was shocked after knowing everything, but we both knew that he was not an ordinary cultivator. Even though he had been lying and deceiving all of us this time, I didn't need to think twice about accepting him, and I'm happy with my decision because I found happiness that I never got in the past."
"Happiness?"

Shang Yumei gave a light nod. "Naturally, you haven't forgotten how the people in our realm treat the younger generation like me, right? Unlike them, Zhang Fei's family treats me with so much warmth, and they treat me as a human being, especially Grandma Chen. Although I have only lived with them for two weeks, I enjoy living with them, and I will do anything to protect them because they are my family now."
"Zhang Fei?" Hong Xinxin looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately explained. "Zhang Fei is my real name, and I use the name Zhang Xiaolong for this clone."
"Huh? A clone?" Hong Xinxin was once again shocked. "Is this really your clone?"
"My real body lives in the Nine Stars Realm with all my family, and I have already sent Yumei there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the gate to that realm and brought the two women there.
Since she had been to the Nine Stars Realm several times in the past, Hong Xinxin could immediately recognize it, especially the Cyanwood Mountain in the distance.

Hong Xinxin's arrival alerted all the strong cultivators in the realm, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] was aware of it and immediately told them not to worry about her. He asked all the emperors other than Huangfu Shou to calm their people down.
Hong Xinxin intended to question Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Feng Yao unexpectedly appeared before them, shocking her. "Princess Feng!"
"I didn't expect him to bring you here, Hong Xinxin." Feng Yao then questioned Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Does this mean you will take her as part of your harem?"

"It depends on her." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied while looking at Hong Xinxin. "What will you decide next? You already know some things about me, and if you are willing to accept me, you will learn even more."

Hong Xinxin seemed at a loss to answer Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since she was still furious at him for all his lies and deceit. She didn't deny that she enjoyed her time with him, but all of that made it difficult for her to forgive him.

Feng Yao directly spoke to her. "What makes you hesitate to decide? I know he has lied and deceived you, but deep down in your heart, you know that you would do the same thing if you were in his shoes. Shang Huaqiang caused his family members to suffer, and you want to control him using Huo Yaoshui's potion."

Hong Xinxin let out a regretful sigh as soon as Feng Yao mentioned the potion. If she hadn't done that, she definitely wouldn't be in such a situation. Even if she wanted to reject Zhang Xiaolong [3], she was sure that he wouldn't let her off so easily, especially since he had implanted his soul mark into her soul.

"Aunt Xinxin, I understand your disappointment with him, but you won't regret your decision if you choose to accept him." Shang Yumei then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "What if you let her meet Grandma Chen and the others? I'm sure she'll change her mind after meeting them, just like me."
"You can take her to our residence, and I will return to the Azure Sky Realm." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the gate to that realm and disappeared into it.
Sometime later, Shang Yumei brought Hong Xinxin to their residence, where Zhang Chen and several other women were waiting for them.
Zhang Fei had already explained the problem with Hong Xinxin to Zhang Chen, and he asked his grandmother to help convince her.
Hong Xinxin raised her eyebrows slightly when she saw all the women. In her opinion, they were too weak, and they hadn't broken through to the Soul Realm. "Which one is Zhang Fei's grandmother?"
"Let's go." Shang Yumei quickly dragged Hong Xinxin toward Zhang Chen. "Grandma Chen! Zhang Fei asked me to bring her here to meet you and the others."

Zhang Chen nodded and pulled Hong Xinxin in front of her, observing her from top to bottom. She then grabbed her arms and asked. "Do you want to spend a few days with us? I understand your issue with my grandson and your difficulty in accepting the truth. Therefore, I will help you get to know him better, and you can make a decision afterward."

"They are not his wives." Zhang Chen then introduced them to Hong Xinxin. "Qing Tan is his maternal aunt, and Zhang Hanzhi is his adopted daughter. Meanwhile, Sister Luotian is his step-grandmother, but she is half human and half winged-race."

"Eh?" Hong Xinxin turned to Dou Luotian in surprise. "Are you really half winged-race? I've met many of your race in the upper realms, but I don't really like them, especially since the majority of them are hypocrites."

Dou Luotian smiled bitterly upon hearing that. "I am indeed half winged-race because my father is a winged-race, but I do not have any characteristics of that race other than my light element. Actually, not only those who live in the upper realms are like that, but the members of that race who live in the lower realms are no different from them. They even intend to invade the human realm, but their efforts will not succeed because Zhang Fei will stop them to protect the ordinary humans."
"Hmm?" Hong Xinxin was a little surprised to hear that. "Why would a demon like him want to protect humans?"

"Apparently, my nephew hasn't explained the details to you." Hong Xinxin looked at Zhang Hanzhi. "Fei'er was born from human parents, so he is human like us. However, an accident turned him into a demon and a heavenly fox beast."
Hong Xinxin momentarily raised an eyebrow. "Did that mysterious woman turn Zhang Fei into both?"
"Yes." They nodded at her. "The woman's identity remains a mystery, and none of us, including Zhang Fei himself, know how she managed to transform him into both."

Hong Xinxin pondered for a while. "Honestly, I have cultivated for several thousand years, but I have never heard of or witnessed anyone being able to bring another person back from the dead. If my guess is accurate, the woman should originate from the realms beyond the upper realms. However, there is no information available about this place, and many cultivators are traveling to the Sun Tower in the Blossom Heaven Realm to discover the truth about their existence."

"Aunt Xinxin, the truth is that Zhang Fei told Murong Mengying about the Sun Tower, and Princess Feng Yao told her parents about it." Shang Yumei then pointed to the northeast. "If you fly into the sky, you can see the Star Tower in the center of this realm, and he has already completed all the challenges on the first floor of the tower."

Hong Xinxin nodded in understanding. "Actually, I have known about the existence of the tower for a long time, but I didn't expect that the tower held mysteries about those places, so I never checked it before."

"Fei'er is focused on his seclusion right now, and he will take us to the Star Tower after he breaks through to the Heaven Realm." Zhang Chen's words made Hong Xinxin realize the reason Zhang Fei was so eager to reach that stage. "If you want, you can join us later. However, we will not talk about that now, and we will help you to understand him."
"All right." Zhang Chen then invited Hong Xinxin to sit with her and the others, during which they shared a wealth of information about Zhang Fei.
"What about Qiuxue? Have you managed to concoct an antidote for her?" Wei Chou asked Nanfeng Yunxi.

Qu Qiuxue also looked at Nanfeng Yunxi with great expectation, especially since the pain had been tormenting her for more than a week, and the pain was getting more and more terrible with each passing day.
Nanfeng Yunxi shook her head. "I still don't know all the ingredients that Zhang Fei used to concoct the pill, so I haven't been able to find the antidote."
*Bam*
"That bastard!" Wei Chou cursed as he slammed the table. "If it weren't for that person from the Phoenix race, I would have killed him a long time ago."

"Heh!" Nanfeng Yunxi then mocked him. "If you think you can win against Zhang Fei, you can go to his shop and challenge him to a duel. Even without the help of those people, I dare to bet that you will die by his hands, and Qu Qiuxue will follow you afterward."
"Are you looking down on me?"
Nanfeng Yunxi just smiled and left the room. "If you are a man, you can go there and challenge him now, and I will wait for the result."
