chapters.title: Chapter 720: People's Decisions
paragraphs: "Senior Brother, you shouldn't go see Zhang Fei." Han Ling immediately spoke because Wei Chou's expression showed that he was infuriated by Nanfeng Yunxi's taunt. "He can kill Lao Yao, so you are not his match, and you will die by his hands."

Wei Chou frowned at Han Ling, but Qu Qiuxue hurriedly spoke to him. "Senior Brother, Han Ling is right about Zhang Fei, so I hope you will not go see him. As for my pain, it is unbearable, but I can endure it."

"I won't go to see Zhang Fei." Wei Chou was definitely not a fool, and he was fully aware of their situation. "Since Nanfeng Yunxi is having difficulty finding the antidote, I will take you back to our headquarters, Qiuxue. If our higher-ups check your condition directly, I'm sure they can find the antidote more quickly, and you can recover as before."
"When are we leaving?"
"Tomorrow morning."
Qu Qiuxue nodded. "Okay, I'll get ready now."

Nanfeng Yunxi was already sitting in front of her alchemy furnace, but she was pondering all the conversations she had with Zhang Lingxue in the past three days, which had shaken her loyalty to the Alchemy Union.

Nanfeng Yunxi tried to contact Zhang Lingxue, but she was out of reach because she was in the training space. She searched for Feng Yao's whereabouts and found her in the Zhou Kingdom, so she immediately contacted the Phoenix Princess.
Unfortunately, Feng Yao herself had no way to contact her while she was still in the training space, so she asked Nanfeng Yunxi to wait for Zhang Lingxue to contact her.

Nanfeng Yunxi let out a soft sigh. "Please forgive me, master. I owe you and our organization a great debt, but our organization will never be able to develop because of your past mistakes. My future is still very long, and Zhang Lingxue's offer was too good to pass up. Moreover, she and Zhang Fei have extensive connections, and I believe they can help me become a better alchemist, so I decided to accept their offer."

Nanfeng Yunxi quickly tidied up her alchemy equipment and stored everything in her storage ring. She then contacted Xiu Hanyu using the interspatial communication device, and she immediately left the shop without telling Wei Chou and the others. After that, she hurried to the Xian Kingdom to wait for Zhang Lingxue.

Zhou Xiaochuan stood by the bed with a serious expression, but his face looked pale because the condition of the empress and the five concubines had not improved. For five whole days, they had been unconscious, and the imperial physicians had examined them many times, but they still could not find a solution to cure them.

Although he was curious about Hong Xinxin's identity, Zhou Xiaochuan didn't bother to look for her, especially since his mind was filled with too many problems, including Jiang Tingxi and Zhou Shenxin's betrayal.

Zhou Xiaochuan then contacted his six sons, but only Zhou Tong and Zhou Fang responded, as Shang Yumei had captured his other four sons and locked them up in a safe place. "Where are they? Why aren't they replying to me?"

Zhou Xiaochuan tried to ask Zhou Tong and Zhou Fang about the whereabouts of his four sons, but both said they didn't know because they went their separate ways. He then summoned one of his subordinates to come to him, and Zhou Fenghu arrived in the room within a few minutes. "What about our army's preparations?"
"They'll be done in a week, and we can leave straight after."

Zhou Xiaochuan then contacted Zhou Fanzhi and ordered him to prepare some people from the Zhou Imperial Sect to lead his troops in attacking the Yun Kingdom first, especially since that kingdom was the closest. "You can go now."
"Yes, Emperor." Zhou Fenghu walked away with an evil smile.

Since Zhang Fei had enslaved him, Zhou Fanzhi naturally did not follow Zhou Xiaochuan's orders. Instead, he captured and locked up those who were still loyal to the Zhou Emperor according to his master's orders.

"Should I ask Kong Zhi for help in attacking the Xian Kingdom? If I only attack the Yun Kingdom, Xian Feng will definitely send his troops to help Yun Shang." After careful consideration, Zhou Xiaochuan immediately contacted him, but the old man rejected him without hesitation, likely due to Zhang Fei's orders. "Since that old bastard rejected me, I have to look for someone else who can lead my army, especially since I can't leave all my wives behind."

Zhou Xiaochuan then left the room and summoned some people to meet him as soon as possible, especially since he did not want to delay attacking the Yun and Xian Kingdoms. Unfortunately, the Zhou Emperor was still unaware that all of his important subordinates were already under Zhang Fei's control, and all his plans would never work because of it.
In the Xian Royal Palace, Xian Feng was talking to an old man. He was Bai Hunyao, who Huangfu Shou previously controlled. "Why did you suddenly ask me to come here, Emperor Xian?"

"Hunyao, I want you to return to the Bai Kingdom." Xian Feng's answer shocked Bai Hunyao. "The situation has changed, and all the major clans have united under my son-in-law. Xiong Niu and the others have cleared out all the clans loyal to Huangfu Shou, so the situation is safe now. However, you should avoid going to Bai Royal Palace and instead join Bai Zizhen or Bai Shushi."
"How—"

"Don't ask any questions and immediately return to the Bai Kingdoms. However, you must take a detour to avoid Huangfu Shou's spies within this kingdom." Bai Hunyao nodded and stood up from his seat, but Xian Feng suddenly told him something else. "Linghu Yincheng has returned, and she is living with her three children in a safe place now. However, I forbid you to contact or meet them, lest the evil emperor discover their whereabouts."
Bai Hunyao felt relieved after hearing the news. "Thank you for protecting me in the past few weeks, and I will return to the Bai Kingdom now, Emperor Xian."
Shortly after Bai Yunhao left, Shi Qingzhuang walked to her husband's side. "Sister Guo just informed me that Zhang Fei and Yun Xinyue will be getting married in less than a month."

"Oh?" Xian Feng turned to his wife in surprise. "I didn't expect their relationship to progress so quickly. Moreover, Yun Xinyue's cultivation is still at the Quasi-Divine Realm, so Zhang Fei doesn't need to delay his first night with her."

"En." Shi Qingzhuang replied with a nod. "Once Zhang Fei emerges from seclusion, he will launch a direct attack on Zhou Xiaochuan to seize control of the Zhou Kingdom, and he will marry Zhou Shenxin during that period. Additionally, Bai Tian'er and Bai Shouyi had already fallen in love with him, but unfortunately, he rejected them both. Instead, he seemed more interested in Bai Shushi than her daughter, or else he wouldn't help her regain her youth."
"Haha." Xian Feng laughed upon hearing that. "Do you want to regain your youth like Bai Shushi?"

Shi Qingzhuang shook her head. "It's good to be young again, but I don't want to want it. We're old now, so we should let everything go naturally. Rather than regaining my youth, I would rather have a grandchild as soon as possible. Unfortunately, it won't happen anytime soon because Xianwu and Yao'er are still in seclusion, and Xian'er still has to wait for Zhang Fei to break through to the Seven Divine Realm."

"We don't need to rush them, and they will definitely give us grandchildren when they are ready." Xian Feng then asked. "Who do you think the mysterious woman from before was? Based on her aura, I'm sure she's a cultivator from the upper realm, but I don't know Zhang Fei's purpose in bringing her to our realm, especially since he didn't tell me anything. Moreover, the other emperors and empresses must have also noticed her presence, including Huangfu Shou and Helian Yueyi."

Unfortunately, Helian Yueyi was unaware that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was also observing her, and he immediately thought of several ways to approach her.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] could have approached Helian Yueyi and obtained her by using his demon abilities, especially since she was much weaker than Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin. However, he had no intention of doing so, and he wanted the empress to bow down to him of her own accord.

Meanwhile, Hong Xinxin had already sat in front of Mai Xiaomeng and handed her a thousand bottles of Yang Qi. However, she was surprised by her friend's decision to bring all the members of the cat beast race to move near her residence. "Why did you suddenly bring your race members to this region?"

"Don't you already know the answer?" After drinking Yang Qi from one bottle, Mai Xiaomeng gave one to Mai Yuzhen, who was shocked by its power. "Xi Hongyan will not accept rejection, and she will attack my race if I reject her. Therefore, I deliberately brought them to this region, and it will be easier for us to cooperate if we stay here."

"Well, that's true." Hong Xinxin replied with a nod. "However, you should exercise caution as Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan have returned to this realm, and they may come for you once they discover your presence in this region."
Mai Xiaomeng smiled in a relaxed manner upon hearing that. "Now that we're allies, you'll protect me if Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan attempt to harm me, right?"

"I can't even win against them, so I can't possibly save you from them." Hong Xinxin then raised her eyebrows because Mai Xiaomeng was still smiling. "What's wrong with you? Why won't you stop smiling?"

Mai Xiaomeng then took out a crystal, and the image that appeared from it surprised Hong Xinxin. "You don't need to look at me like that, okay? We've known each other for a long time, so you should already know my character. My race members are spread throughout the regions, including this region. I'm curious about your lover, so I ordered some of them to monitor your Hong Clan, and the results surprised me. According to my memory, only one race, the Heavenly Fox Race, possesses the ability to create gates that connect multiple realms, indicating that your lover is a member of this race."
'Tch! I was too careless!' Hong Xinxin chose to admit it. "My lover is indeed a heavenly fox, but he is not one of them, and he is more special than them."
"Oh?" Ma Xiaomeng and Ma Yuzhen were surprised by that, especially since they knew for sure that all the Heavenly Foxes lived in the Heavenly Moon Realm.

"To be honest, I still don't know much about my lover's identity, and he actually came from the lower realms." Ma Xiaomeng and Ma Yuzhen were even more surprised by Hong Xinxin's explanation. "The sky and the walls have ears, so I don't want to talk too much about him. If too many people know about him, he will be in danger. In fact, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing sent their younger generations to capture him, but he was fortunate to have Feng Yao assist him in driving them out of his realm."
"Feng Yao?" Mai Xiaomeng momentarily raised an eyebrow. "Do you mean the Phoenix Princess?"
Hong Xinxin nodded to her. "I found out about their relationship today, and my lover took me to meet Feng Yao in another realm."
"Since your lover is in a relationship with Feng Yao, accepting your offer is the best decision of my life." Mai Xiaomeng said. "Can you take me to see him?"

"Haha." Hong Xinxin laughed as she realized her intentions. "You must not play with fire because my lover is not an ordinary man, and he will never submit to you. Instead, you will be the one submitting to him, and you will not be able to leave him again if that happens."

Mai Xiaomeng nonchalantly shrugged in response. "Your lover is a heavenly fox, so it doesn't matter to me if he subdues me, and I will gain many benefits from him. Although my cultivation has reached the 5-Moon Divine Transformation Realm, my cat race is far inferior to his."

"Well, that's true." Hong Xinxin nodded in agreement. "Actually, my lover only has a few female beasts by his side, and he needs more female beasts to help him evolve. If you don't have a problem with that, I can take you to see him. However, he won't necessarily be interested in you, and he will probably reject you."
Mai Xiaomeng confidently smiled and inquired. "Will he reject a beautiful and sexy woman like me?"

"You're still as narcissistic as ever!" Hong Xinxin then explained to her. "My lover is a dual cultivator, and he has a greater number of women by his side than you can possibly imagine. Even so, he is quite picky, and he doesn't like narcissistic women like you."
"In that case, you can take me to meet your lover, and we'll see the results later."

"We—"
"If you two want to beg us to spare them, you can forget about your wish." Mo Zifeng interrupted Jiang Yinghua.

"Yes, Master."
"Zhang Fei." Jiang Yinghua called out as she flew to his side. "Please, don't—"

"Don't beg me for useless things." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi. "After I have settled the Throne's subordinates, I will go straight to the Tian Realm, and I will kill anyone who dares to block my way. Therefore, you two had better return there now to warn Gabriel and the rebels' leaders, or else their members will fall victim to my wrath as well."

Jiang Yinghua wanted to say something to Zhang Fei [5], but Meng Tianshi immediately pulled him flying with her, leaving him behind. 'Yinghua! It's no use for you to persuade him! Jiang Yinghua released a heavy sigh, and the two women flew even faster before disappearing into the sky.
Sometime later, Zheng Mohei said. "Master, the birdmen are here."

chapters.title: Chapter 724: One Side Battle
paragraphs: Dozens of winged race members have already floated in Earth's skies. A golden-haired woman and five men led the group, but their expressions were truly shocked when they saw Zhang Fei [5] and the others. After all, they had never witnessed humans possessing the ability to fly, let alone doing so without wings.
'Who are they? Since when can humans fly? How can they fly without wings?' All the winged race members wondered.

Zhang Fei [5] gave a faint smirk when he saw four familiar faces among dozens of winged race members, especially since they were his slaves: Theo, Zachiel, Yofil, and Chiel. They were the winged races who were tasked with establishing relationships with the Amaris Twis and the three dead demon rulers in the past.
[Master! Daniella's strength and rank are equal to Jiang Yinghua's, and she was born with cultivation veins.] Mei informed Zhang Fei [5], who immediately looked at Daniella.

Like other women of the winged race, Daniella has an exquisite face. She also has an extremely tall and slender body, about 6'7", and her golden hair loosely flows down to her hips. She wore a golden full-body armor that accentuated her perfect figure, and two golden wings flapped behind her back. Her expression is gentle, and she has two wide eyes with golden pupils.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately told Zheng Mohei about Chiel and forbade him to kill her. Since he no longer needed Theo, Zachiel, and Yofil, he ordered them to kill the three.
"Who are you really? Why are you blocking us?" Moraes asked with a serious expression.
Instead, Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword, pointing it at those winged race members. "Kill all of them except for Chiel, the golden-haired woman, and the five men in front."
Daniella and the others were shocked to hear Zhang Fei [5] ordering his slaves, but before they could react, Zheng Mohei had already moved into the middle of their subordinates and slaughtered them.

The bodies of their subordinates glided down toward the ground in a matter of seconds, scattering their blood in several directions, shocking Daniella and the others to the point where their bodies trembled violently.
"You—" Joel was unable to speak, as Zheng Mohei immediately restricted them with his aura and brought them to Zhang Fei [5].

"You winged races have always been arrogant and thought of humans as inferior to you, but your arrogance ends here today. If you hadn't come down here, you would never have suffered this fate. Unfortunately, it's too late for you to regret it, especially since I will never spare my enemies." Daniella and the others trembled even more intensely when Zhang Fei [5] used his darkness element. "You have repeatedly invaded the Diyu Realm, resulting in the deaths of many of them. At first, I wanted to kill you all, but I thought death was the easiest punishment for you. Therefore, I changed my mind and decided to transform all of you into creatures that you detest the most."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] injected his darkness element into the bodies of the five winged race men and forced them to eat demon beast meat to speed up their transformation into demons.
The changes to the five men did not bother Chiel, as she was Zhang Fei [5]'s slave. Their white wings slowly fell off, and the white aura that enveloped their bodies quickly turned black.

In contrast, Daniella's body trembled violently as she watched her five friends transform into demons, her entire body drenched in sweat. They descended into the human realm with full confidence to take it over, but their situation changed drastically in a matter of seconds.

Daniella was even more shocked when the gate leading to the Diyu Realm appeared in front of her. Soon after Zhang Fei [5] summoned them, Oz the Second, Zygoz, and Tharnon emerged from the gate. The two male demons were no longer surprised by his actions, especially since he had done so much for their realm, and he managed to bring back Oz the First.
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei [5] pulled his darkness element back. He transformed Moraes, Joel, and the three other men into demons.
"How can you turn them into demons so quickly, kid? Usually, they will only turn into demons after several years of living in our realm." Zygoz asked Zhang Fei [5].
Oz the Second nodded in agreement. "Back then, Virgil took a year before he turned into a demon."

"I made a discovery about the darkness element some time ago, which aided in my understanding of the darkness elemental law." Zhang Fei [5] then sent Chiel and Daniella into the training space. He then threw the five new demons into the Diyu Realm. "Order your subordinates to imprison them, and we will go to the Tian Realm now."

The three demons were overjoyed to hear that, especially since the Tian Realm was their eternal enemy. Since they have the upper hand now, they want to settle the old grudge between them as soon as possible.

After Oz the Second contacted his subordinates, Zhang Fei [5] immediately closed the gate to the Diyu Realm and opened the one leading to the Netherworld Realm, especially since Virgil and Ursula lived there.

Virgil and Ursula were also overjoyed after Zhang Fei [5] informed them that they would be fighting the Tian Realm today; he also summoned the Amaris Twins out of the training space, especially since they were former demon rulers. "Mohei, you will also go with us, and you can kill those who get in our way."
"Yes, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate to the Tian Realm. "Get in! We will settle our affairs with those winged races today."
"Let's go!"

Upon their arrival, Zhang Fei [5] observed a multitude of winged races congregating around the tower. They were wearing full battle robes and holding their respective weapons, such as swords, spears, bows, and others.

Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately order them to attack those winged races. Instead, he checked them one by one, especially since Gabriel and Dou Haishang's subordinates wore different marks to identify their groups.

"Hmm?" Gabriel and Dou Haishang suddenly flew towards them at high speed, and Zheng Mohei prepared to attack them. However, Zang Fei [5] immediately stopped his slaves, especially since the two of them were on different sides of the Throne. "Why are you guys here?"
"Did you kill Moraes and the others?" Gabriel asked him.

"I killed their subordinates, and I turned those five men into demons." Gabriel and Dou Haishang sighed heavily, especially since becoming demons was the worst punishment for members of their race. "I haven't done anything to Daniella, but I will keep her."
Unlike Gabriel, who knew little about Zhang Fei [5], Dou Haishang immediately realized his intentions toward Daniella. After all, he had received many reports about him from his daughter and Micah.
Zhang Fei [5] pointed at the winged races around the tower. "Are those people your subordinates?"

"Yes." Both men nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "After we noticed their movements, we immediately alerted all our members, and we tried to stop the Throne's subordinates from invading the human realms. Unfortunately, they did not listen to us, and many of them have died in your hands."
Zhang Fei [5] did not care about that and checked the tower. "Have your people in the tower gone into hiding? If they are still roaming around, I'm afraid we will kill them too."
"They've all gone into hiding now, so only the Throne's subordinates are left in the tower." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "We sincerely hope that you guys will not slaughter them."

"As long as they don't fight us, we won't kill them, but vice versa." Zhang Fei [5] immediately flew towards the tower, followed by Zheng Mohei. Oz the Second, Tharnon, Zygoz, Ursula, Virgil, and the Amaris Twins immediately followed them.
The two men released heavy sighs as they looked at Zhang Fei [5] and the others. "I hope the members of our race in the tower don't act foolishly, or they will die at their hands."

"I hope so." Dou Haishang nodded to Gabriel. "Zhang Fei [5] himself is powerful, but the middle-aged man by his side is even more powerful. With Oz the Second and others joining him, our race is no match for them, and any foolishness will kill them."
Gabriel then flew away. "Let's go! We must reorganize our realm after this."

"Do you really think low-level winged races like you guys can fight us?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned Boitata, who was still resting inside the Beast Space. The Throne's armies cowered in fear as she appeared before them in her gigantic dragon serpent form. "If you want to die like dogs, you can fight us now. If you still want to live, you can leave this place."
Oz the Second also speaks to them. "Your race is our eternal enemy, but we are different from you, and we will spare any of you who surrender and leave."
"Why do you have to talk to them so much, husband?" Boitata asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Let's attack them, and I will eat them alive."
Zhang Fei [5]'s lips twitched upon hearing that. "Hey! Don't waste our time! Choose now! Life or death is up to you!"
In the end, the winged races on the first floor decided to throw away their weapons and leave the place in droves because they didn't want to die.

Zhang Fei [5] paid them no mind and led Boitata and the others to the second floor, where the Throne's other armies confronted them. Unlike on the first floor, those winged races immediately attacked them, but their resistance was meaningless.
Boitata immediately ate those who put up resistance with one attack. She chewed their bodies in front of the other members of the other winged races before spitting their bones out to them.

Boitata's action not only frightened the winged races, but it also frightened the Amaris Twins and the others. Fortunately, they were on the same side, or she would have chowed their bodies like that, too.
After witnessing Boitata's actions, the majority of the winged races fainted while the others frantically fled to save themselves.

Even though she was a winged race, Virgil showed no mercy to members of her former race. She used enhanced speed to speed up her movements, and she also used her curse inducement on them, causing them to die for no apparent reason.

"I think we'll face even fiercer resistance once we arrive at the fourth floor." Oz the Second said as he returned to his demon form, and his giant body caused the ground around them to shake every time he walked forward.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. "We'll face those middle-level winged races from the fourth to the sixth floor, but they're still too weak for us, so we won't have much difficulty fighting them."
"Let me take care of them, master."
"No need." Upon arriving at the end of the third floor, Zhang Fei [5] did not hesitate to go to the next floor, followed by Oz the Second and Zhang Mohei.

As anticipated, the middle-level winged races launched an immediate attack against them. Zhang Fei [5] immediately unleashed the demon king's roar, which simultaneously caused confusion and fear in all of them.

Afterwards, Zhang Fei [5] simultaneously employed the abyssal lightning tribulation, the hellflame incantation, and the demon claw technique. Within a matter of minutes, all the winged races on the floor had succumbed to their deaths.
"Why did you only use your demon abilities?" Oz the Second asked Zhang Fei [5].
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed before explaining. "I don't need to use my Qi to use my demon abilities, and my demon abilities are enough to deal with them."
Oz the Second nodded in understanding. "Your demon abilities become more terrifying once you reach the Duke Rank, and your abilities will increase again once you reach the Emperor Rank."

"Unfortunately, I still needed a few months or years to reach the Emperor Rank, so I didn't think too much about it and just went along with it." Zhang Fei [5] then enveloped Oz the Second and Zheng Mohei with his aura, and he brought the two of them to the fifth floor in the blink of an eye.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately blocked the attacks of those winged races and grasped the hilt of the demon extermination sword. "You want to see my cultivation technique, right? I'll show you some of my techniques so you pay close attention."

At that moment, the demon extermination sword glowed jet black, and Zhang Fei[5] immediately swung his sword horizontally. Suddenly, a giant horizontal Qi swept across the entire fifth floor, splitting many of the winged races in two, while some managed to escape by flying upwards.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head as he looked at them. He immediately disappeared from the sight of Oz the Second and Zheng Mohei. His adaptation to sixteen times heavier gravity made his speed simply too fast for all his enemies, tearing them in half in just a few moments.

Oz the Second released a heavy sigh as he watched Zhang Fei [5]'s action. 'Ever since he came to my realm the first time, his progress has been too fast. If I were to fight him now, I would definitely die before I could blink.'
"Follow me!" Zhang Fei [5] shouted as he flew toward the sixth floor.

Like on the fifth floor, Zhang Fei [5] had no difficulty slaughtering those winged races on the sixth floor, especially since they were too weak for the current him. However, he did not proceed directly to the seventh floor, instead waiting for Boitata and the others to catch up with him.

From the start, the winged races were indeed no match for Zhang Fei [5] and the others, so their fight was one-sided. However, the winged races who live on the seventh to ninth floors are more numerous and stronger than the previous floors.

Before long, Boitata and the others had arrived on the sixth floor, and Zhang Fei immediately led them to the seventh floor, where hundreds of thousands of high-level winged races were waiting for them.
Zhang Fei [5] indifferently pointed his sword at them. "Two choices: commit suicide or die in our hands."

chapters.title: Chapter 725: An Impostor
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5]'s words caused the high-level winged races to laugh out loud. One of them immediately mocked him. "Do you think you can defeat hundreds of thousands of us with your small numbers?"
"Arrogant asshole." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Not only are you the most hypocritical, but you are also the most idiotic beings in the entire universe."

The winged races immediately became alert as soon as a gate and portal appeared in front of them. Soon, Hong Xinxin walked out of the gate with Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen. From the portal, Shang Yumei led all of Zhang Fei's wives and partners. Additionally, he also summoned the thunderbird out of the beast space.

Unlike Hong Xinxin, who already knew Zhang Fei [5]'s true identity, Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen were shocked to see so many women present at that place. Furthermore, they had previously encountered him in the Azure Sky Realm, but now another him stood before them. They also felt the absence of Qi in the Tian Realm, confirming that they were in another realm.

"Do you think your numbers are useful in the face of absolute power?" Zhang Fei [5] turned to all his wives and partners. "All this time, you've trained so hard, but most of you have never fought real people. Show them the results of your training and kill them all."
"Let's go!"

Liu Hua and the others vanished from their positions in an instant. They spread out to various areas and attacked those winged races. Despite their cultivation being below the Earth Realm, their strength and speed were more than sufficient to fight those winged races. The thunderbird, Lei Que, also flew to attack the winged races flying in the air.

Of the demons of the Diyu Realm, only Virgil, Angela, and the Amaris Twins joined the battle. Zhang Fei [5] asked Oz the Second, Ursula, and Tharnon to stay where they were, as their strength was too overpowered to fight the high-level winged races.

Zhang Fei [5] also prohibited Boitata, Shang Yumei, Xian Xianqin, Qian Ying, Yun Xinyue, Zhou Shenxin, Ling Long, Dan Qingying, and Gu Hanshuang from moving. They are more experienced than his other wives and partners, and their cultivation is also too high to face those winged races.
Liu Hua and the Wen Twins were basically experienced assassins, and their movements were difficult for the winged race to predict, especially when they used the Vanishing Mirage Steps.

The fighting abilities of Liu Qingyu, Zhang Lingxue, Ye Lian, Shen Xueyi, Shen Yu, and Hu Yue were beyond doubt. Their experience, combined with the results of their training in the training space, made them too strong for those winged races.
Despite their lack of fighting experience, Chu Ying, Chu Qing, Zhao Ziqin, and Zhang Fei's partners were still experienced cultivators, so they had no difficulty fighting those winged races.

Zhang Lin, Qing Yi, Tang Ziyu, and Ru Xue often practiced using battle simulations and killed countless beasts. However, the way they fought was still stiff due to their lack of experience fighting against real people, and they still needed to adjust to such a fight.
Zhang Yue's ice element presented a formidable challenge to all those winged races. She easily froze them and shattered them into pieces.

"How did you train them?" Hong Xinxin asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Most of them are still in the Earth Realm, but their speed is incredibly fast. Even I am not confident that I can catch up to them, let alone these non-cultivator winged races."

"Despite their weaknesses, they are quite formidable, right?" Hong Xinxin nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "I haven't brought you there because you still have a lot of things to do, and I still need a lot of help from you. I will bring you there once everything settles, and I am confident that you can surpass Shang Huaqiang, even if your cultivation is still far below his."

Hong Xinxin appeared eager to train with them, particularly after observing Zhang Lin and the others' impressive fighting skills, especially their speed. "Where is their leader? Why did he let his subordinates be slaughtered like this?"

"Their leader is a coward who only dares to hide." Shang Yumei then pointed upwards. "The strongest among them is on the upper three floors, but that person is too shocked by our strength, so he doesn't dare to appear in front of us."
"Since their leader doesn't dare to appear, we just need to kill his subordinates, right?" Ling Long casually spoke.
Xian Xianqin nodded in agreement. "Actually, I don't want to fight with them, but they are our enemies."
"They are too arrogant and ignorant, so they just throw their lives away in vain." Zhou Shenxin commented with a shake of her head.

"Husband, I want to try something." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Yun Xinyue, who had already taken out her purple spear. After she injected her Qi into her spear, it instantly shot toward those high-level winged races, and the lightning field surrounding it immediately electrocuted them. "Hehe! I can finally use that technique, and I can fight from a long distance now."
'Husband? Are they all Long'er's wives?' Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen wondered as they stole glances at all the women.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately looked at the two women. "Xinyu and Yifen, this is the real me. All of them are my wives and partners."
"What do you mean by that, Long'er?" Shang Xinyu raised an eyebrow in question.

"My real name is Zhang Fei, and I'm not the 10-year-old kid. Instead, I'm 20 years old, and I disguised myself as Zhang Xiaolong because I wanted to destroy Shang Huaqiang." Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen were completely shocked after hearing Zhang Fei [5]'s revelation. "I know I've deceived both of you, and I've deceived others as well, but I have no choice. My strength is indeed high now, but I'm definitely not an opponent of Shang Huaqiang and his Shang Clan, so I have to use other means against them."

"I was also shocked and angry after he told me the whole truth, but I know more about him now, so I decided to forgive him and become his wife." Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen turned to Hong Xinxin, who immediately shared her memories of chatting with Zhang Chen and the others with them. "You two can see my memories, and you guys will understand why he deceived us all."

Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen immediately closed their eyes and saw Hong Xinxin's memories. They were quite shocked to hear that Zhang Fei [5] had died once as an ordinary human, and he could become a cultivator after being resurrected from the dead. They were no longer surprised by his identity as a fox beast and a demon, as they had known about both for a long time. However, they were surprised to discover that he was not a fox demon but rather a lust demon.

"Do you two understand now?" Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen nodded to Hong Xinxin. "You two can talk to him later, and we will focus on clearing up these winged races first. They're almost finished, and we will move to the next floor after this."

Sometime later, Li Hua and the others killed all the winged race on the seventh floor, and they immediately swallowed Qi recovery pills, especially since the Qi in their bodies was not as abundant as their husband's. Zhang Yue, having used the technique from the Ice Phoenix Scripture, swallowed three Qi recovery pills because her Qi was too thin.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately led them to the eighth floor, where many groups of winged races were waiting for them. However, they had already lost their will to fight, particularly after learning that all the members of their race downstairs were dead.

"Move!" All the winged races immediately opened the way for Zhang Fei [5] and the others. Since they were unwilling to fight, he forbade his people from killing them, and they proceeded straight to the ninth floor.

Upon reaching the ninth floor, they found the winged races already arrayed on both sides, their weapons resting on the ground. Zhang Fei [5] was relieved by their decision, especially since he didn't want to kill more winged races.

Once they reached the last stair, Zhang Fei [5] sent almost all of them back into the training space. Only the demons from the Diyu Realm, Zheng Mohei, and all the female cultivators with cultivation in the seven divine realms remained behind.
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Oz the Second. "After this, the human realm and the Diyu Realm will be peaceful, and I will focus on my personal affairs."
"Have you forgotten about the Xian Realm? They also have the ambition to rule the four realms, and the situation will never be peaceful as long as we have not conquered them."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "We will first meet the Seraph, and then I will send you to the Diyu Realm. As for the Xian Realm, I will bring Xinxin and the others there, and I will conquer them."
"Let's go in then."

chapters.title: Chapter 726: Mysterious Organization
paragraphs: If there is only a tower in the Tian Realm, there is only a flying island right in the middle of the Xian Realm. The island itself is not that big, but it is beautiful, with several waterfalls flowing down it, and there are so many colorful flower plants all over the area.

However, a horrific sight greeted them as soon as they landed on the flying island. The island's inhabitants had all perished, their bodies had dried up, and their corpses were piled up in the middle.
The gruesome sight made Shang Xinyu, Shang Yifen, Xian Xianqin, and several other women nauseous to the point of vomiting.
"We found the answer, Zhang Fei."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Oz the Second. "Did you see their leader's corpse?"

"His corpse is not among them." Oz the Second answered with certainty. "That guy is too resilient for a human, and he has many amazing abilities, so I'm sure he won't die so easily. The impostor probably kidnapped him and moved him to another realm."
Oz the Second, Ursula, Tharnon, and Zygoz then approached the pile of corpses, especially since those people were their old enemies.
"Why did the impostor kill them? Does that person no longer need them?" Zygoz wondered to himself.

Tharnon and Ursula looked disappointed to see the pile of corpses because they wanted to take revenge on those people, but they also harbored many questions about the deaths of the Xian Realm's inhabitants.

Hong Xinxin then spoke. "Apparently, the enemies you face this time are not ordinary enemies, especially since they can do many things for hundreds of years without others realizing it. Judging from the way these people died, and the previous person also had the darkness element, the perpetrators are obviously related to demons."

"You're right." Zhang Fei [5] crouched beside the pile of corpses and observed one of them. "The perpetrator utilized a technique nearly identical to mine and Ursula's, absorbing their life force completely."

"The perpetrator's abilities are more vicious than mine. Not only did he absorb their life force, but he also absorbed their flesh." Ursula said to Zhang Fei [5]. "However, I have never met a demon with abilities similar to mine in these four realms, so he probably came from another realm."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. "Whoever killed them did not come here using an avatar. Instead, he arrived here in his real body and fled as soon as the fake Throne's disguise became visible. However, I found it hard to understand why he killed them, especially since they were eager to attack the Diyu Realm in the past."

"The situation in both realms made me realize something." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Oz the Second. "If our guess is correct that the two impostors have ties with demons, I believe their main goal in wanting to take over my Diyu Realm is the ten demon lord seeds. Unfortunately, those seeds had already chosen my predecessor back then, so they worked together to attack us. Those winged races even used the white Amaris to do something to him, but he released those seeds from his body before he was sent to another realm by the artifact, and they disappeared without a trace since then."

"Only one of the ten demon lord seeds has appeared, and Lillea used it to give birth to Janette." Oz the Second gave Zhang Fei [5] a nod of approval. "If they are really after those seeds, they should still be in the Diyu Realm. Unfortunately, I still haven't managed to find them, even though I have searched the entire realm several times looking for them."
"What exactly are ten demon lord seeds?" Oz the Second immediately told Shang Yumei and the others about the history of those seeds. "Do you intend to have them, husband?"

Zhang Fei [5] first enveloped all the corpses with his aura and sent them to another realm. "I don't know what effect the ten demon king seeds will have on me, but I can feel their powerful aura from Janette's body. Oz the First became powerful after he ate those seeds, and I myself am a demon, so I want to get them to strengthen my demon form."
"I have a question for you." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Shang Xinyu. "You have three identities, but why do I feel that you prioritize the demon identity over your other two identities?"
Observing Zhang Fei's confusion, Shang Yifen also asked him a question. "Is being a demon more fun than being a human or beast?"

Zhang Fei [5] let out a sigh. "To answer your two questions, I cannot explain in words my choice between my three identities, but you might be able to understand if you have experienced death like me. I don't know how long I was dead at that time, but I experienced a change in mentality after I regained consciousness and transformed into a demon. From then on, I tended to choose my demon identity, and I focused more on my demon identity than my other two identities for some time before."

"I think I know your reason for preferring your demon identity." Ling Long said as she dotingly hugged Zhang Fei [5]'s arm. "You are a pervert by nature, so your demon identity best suits your character."
"Hahaha!" Xian Xianqin and the others laughed at that, and they agreed with Ling Long.

"You are right; I might indeed be a pervert by nature." Zhang Fei [5] did not deny it. "Anyway, since the perpetrator has already left, there's no reason for us to stay here any longer, and I can't find anything interesting here."
After that, Zhang Fei [5] first sent Shang Yumei and five other women back to the training space before sending Hong Xinxin, Shang Xinyu, and Shang Yifen back to the Azure Sky Realm.

Zhang Fei [5] then sent Virgil and Ursula back to the Netherworld Realm, but Oz the Second and two male demons decided to join them, especially since their realm was safe now. "Mohei, I want you to clear this island realm and try to find something hidden here."
"Yes, Master."

Zhang Fei [5] did not return to the elemental chamber; instead, he went to the Diyu Realm to look for the remaining nine demon lord seeds. To his surprise, he saw a black pillar soaring high into the sky as soon as he arrived in that realm, which came from the ancient demon castle.
[Master! That black pillar must have come from one of the nine demon lord seeds!]

"Damn! I checked there before but couldn't find the seed anywhere." In a few seconds, Zhang Fei [5] arrived in front of the ancient demon castle, and a new notification immediately appeared in his mind.
[Ding]
[Quest: Finding one of the ten demon lord seeds.]
[Quest rank: Medium.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Medium Gift Pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

"So it's true that the demon lord seed is hiding in this castle, huh? Now that I think about it, this appeared after I finished the quest in the Tian Realm and went to the Xian Realm." As he returned to his lust demon form, Zhang Fei [5] walked into the ancient demon castle, and the black pillars did not stop him. When he arrived at the main room of the castle, he saw not just one but eight seeds floating in the middle of it. "What a stroke of luck! I immediately found them all at once."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately approached the nine demon lord seeds, but only one of them moved and entered his body, causing his demon energy and aura to soar.
[Ding]
[You gained 20,000,000 demon essences.]
[Master, if you absorb the other eight, your demon rank will immediately rise to Archduke Rank.]

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately approached the other eight seeds, but they swiftly moved away from him. He tried to catch them all, but his efforts were in vain, even with his extremely fast speed. "I think they don't want me as their master."
[Master, try summoning eight female demons by your side.]

Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned Ilsath, Orith, Zilvora, Balena, Angela, Eve, Fyr, Leora, Ashreth, Nadea, and the Amaris Twins from the training space. Although Lillea had already found one, and Janette was born from one of the demon seeds, she still summoned them.
"What are those seeds?" Zilvora pointed at the eight demon lord seeds.
"Demon Lord Seeds!" The Amaris Twins and the female demons from the Diyu Realm exclaimed excitedly.

Since Ilsath, Orith, Zilvora, and Balena came from other demon realms, they didn't know anything about the ten demon lord seeds. Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained the ten demon lord seeds to the four female demons, which excited them. "One is in Janette's body, and one chose me. With only eight remaining, each of you can strive to earn their recognition. They have their own will and will only choose the worthy, so I hope those who don't make it won't be jealous."
"Yes!"
"Let me try it first." The black Amaris immediately approached those seeds, but they swiftly moved away from her. "Does this mean I failed?"
"You failed." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer disappointed the Black Amaris.
After that, the white Amaris also tried to obtain one of the demon seeds, but she also failed.
"Try it, Balena." Zhang Fei [5] somehow felt that the female whale demon would succeed in getting recognition from one of them.

Balena nodded and approached the eight demon lord seeds, and one of them immediately shot into her body. The demon aura in the seed caused her demon aura to increase rapidly, and her demon rank immediately rose to the duchess rank.
The Amaris Twins were jealous that Balena got one of the seeds, but they had to swallow their jealousy since the seeds had free will.
"I did it." Balena said to Zhang Fei [5] with a smile.

paragraphs: After they finished dinner and Zhang Fei [1] left them, Helian Yueyi went to the second floor with the fake Ruo Yanxi, but his previous words kept ringing in her mind. 'What would happen if he discovered that we had tried to capture his son? Is he going to destroy us? How is his strength compared to my husband's ancestors? Is he much stronger than them?'

Unfortunately, Helian Yueyi was still unaware that the two people she was thinking about were the same. She was also unaware that Zhang Fei [1] had already started his plans against her family by placing his people among them.

'I have to discuss this matter with my husband later. Although I don't know the exact strength of that man, we can't underestimate people from the upper realm, so we'd better not touch Zhang Fei.' After she looked at all the items on the second floor, Helian Yueyi only bought some mattresses and pills.
After that, Helian Yueyi and the fake Ruo Yanxi rushed back to the Huangfu Kingdom, but the unexpected situation weighed on her mind.
Zhang Fei [1] had already arrived at the Sky Jade Shop in the Xian Capital. He went straight to meet Zhang Lingxue and Nanfeng Yunxi in the back room.
"Did you kill them?"

"I killed Wei Chao, but I only enslaved Han Ling and sent him to another realm. I didn't kill Qu Qiuxue, and I imprisoned her in a special place." Zhang Fei [1]'s answer was quite a relief to Nanfeng Yunxi. "I want you to handle my shop in the Yun Capital, and Lingxue will meet you for the next few days to share some pill recipes. This way, you can concoct all the pills we sell in our shop, and you can share with her if you have better pill recipes."

"I have given Linxue some pill recipes so you two can learn to concoct them. As for your shop in the Yun Capital, you can leave the matters there to me." Nanfeng Yunxi then asked. "What about the Alchemy Union? Do you think they will come here?"

"Feng Yao sent Feng Xishui to them before, so I believe that Huoyun Zhiyan will not dare to come here. Even if they dare to come here, they will not be able to do anything to you, and I will ask Shang Yumei to kill them directly." Zhang Fei [1] then handed dozens of bottles of Yang Qi to Nanfeng Yunxi and gave her a dual cultivation technique, causing her to frown. "I gave my Yang Qi to all members of my group, and you are part of us now, so I also give it to you. You may be skeptical, but after drinking my Yang Qi, you will realize its benefits."
Nanfeng Yunxi nodded in understanding. "I'll think about it first before drinking it."
"It's okay." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a nod. "You can return to the Yun Capital now, and I will take Lingxue back into seclusion."
"All right." After that, Nanfeng Yunxi rushed back to the Yun Royal Capital, and Zhang Fei [1] brought Zhang Lingxue back to the training space.

Even though Nanfeng Yunxi had already decided to become a member of his organization, Zhang Fei [1] was unsure about the depth of Nanfeng Yunxi's loyalty, leading him to decide against bringing her into his training space.

Upon Zhang Fei [1]'s arrival at the portable mansion, Yan Luan'er and Xi Zihua immediately pulled him into their room, pushing him to sit at the foot of the bed. "We talked to Big Sis Zhixiu earlier, but she seemed hesitant about being your partner, so we thought you should use force to take her as your partner."

"Do you guys realize that you are more impatient than me about Yan Zhixiu?" Zhang Fei [1] then pulled them into his lap. "She has obtained one of the ten demon lord seeds now. The demon seed in our bodies has already bound her and the other eight to me, preventing her from ever leaving my side. Therefore, you two don't need to be impatient, as she will eventually become my partner."
"Is that true?"

Zhang Fei [1] nodded at them. "The ten demon lord seeds are actually one unit, and the main one has become one with my body. Unlike when they chose Oz the First, they actually split up and chose ten different people, and their power could only be used if nine of them were present by my side."
Both women nodded in understanding. "In that case, we'll wait until Big Sis Zhixiu is completely ready, and we'll have fun together then."
Zhang Fei [1] then called all his partners to gather in his room, where they began their usual activities.

When another day came, Zhang Fei [4] had finished reading all the ancient records in Heaven's library. He then went to see Gabriel and Dou Haishang. "I believe that mysterious person will return here one day, and Han Ling is my slave, so I purposely placed him here to protect you. As for Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi, they have already decided to be my women, so I sent them to my private place."
Gabriel was not surprised by the two women's decision. "I still can't believe that the person who controls the Xian Realm is so terrifying, and he slaughtered everyone in the realm."

"I myself didn't expect such a result, but they are already dead, and we can't do anything to change it." Both men nodded to Zhang Fei [4]. "However, I am still curious about that person's motivation for slaughtering them, so I placed one of my slaves there. At least the four realms are safe now, and those people won't be able to cause trouble anymore."

"Are we really safe now?" Dou Haishang asked skeptically. "We don't know the true strength and intentions of those people, and the four realms might face even greater danger if the two impostors come with their group members."

"Even if they come with their entire group, I am confident in destroying them, so you don't have to think too much about them." Although Zhang Fei [4] said it like that, Dou Haishang still looked uneasy. "As for their true purpose, I suspect that it had something to do with the ten demon seeds. Unfortunately, it would be too late if they were to come here again, especially since those seeds have already fallen into my hands."
"Eh? Are those demon seeds really in your hands now?"

"Do I need to lie to you two?" Zhang Fei [4] then opened a portal to the training space. "Han Ling can definitely protect this realm, so I will leave everything to him, and I will only come here if the situation is critical."

After Zhang Fei [4] disappeared, Dou Haishang said to Gabriel. "In the past, both our realm and the Xian Realm attempted to become the sole ruler of the four realms, but they failed miserably, and that kid emerged as the victor. Although he has no interest in becoming the sole ruler, we can't deny that he rules them now."
"You're right." Gabriel then looked at the top of the tower. "What truly happened to the real Throne? Did those people kill him? Or did those people kidnap him and hide him in another realm?"

"Unfortunately, we can't do anything to investigate them because they came from other realms, and we can only wait for that kid to capture one of those people." Dou Haishang then turned to the few people flying toward them. "Our realm is still chaotic right now, so we don't need to think about anything else, and we should focus on rearranging everything for a better life."
"Let's go."
Unlike the two men, Zhang Fei [4] had already arrived at the portable mansion, where he began his activities with Orith, Ilsath, and Zilvora.
"What are you thinking about, Ling'er? Why is your expression not good?" Zhang Fei questioned Xu Ling'er immediately upon entering her room.

"Big brother, I just had a strange dream, and it made me feel like something was missing from inside me." Zhang Fei immediately moved onto the bed and lifted Xu Ling'er onto his lap, but the girl's body trembled slightly, confusing her. "I dreamed of a place filled only by white light, and I felt so familiar with that place, but I've never seen such a place before. Moreover, there was nothing there, but I could hear many people singing accompanied by the sound of trumpets."
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow after listening to Xu Ling'er's explanation. He remembered one place that fit his dream, but he thought it was impossible. "What else did you see in your dream?"

"There's nothing else." Xu Ling'er replied, shaking her head. "As soon as I opened my eyes, I felt a deep emptiness in my heart, as if something was missing. I immediately asked you to come here, especially since I can only feel calm when I'm with you."
Zhang Fei directly pulled Xu Ling'er down to the bed and hugged her. "I'm here now, so you don't need to be afraid of your dream."
"Yeah." Xu Ling'er closed her eyes again and snuggled into Zhang Fei's arms.
[Master, three gift packs are waiting for you.]
'Open them, Mei.'
[You obtained 1 Heaven Grade Titan Gauntlet.]
[You obtained 1 Heaven Grade Eclipse Scythe.]
[You obtained 1 Divine Grade Holy Radiance Crown.]

Zhang Fei was shocked by the third notification, and he immediately read the description of each item. 'Titan Gauntlet is more suitable for Tang Ziyu because he has the earth element, and it will increase his attack power. Eclipse Scythe is more suitable for Janette because her attribute is darkness, and it can devour the light element.'

Zhang Fei was more curious about the Holy Radiance Crown, so he took it out of the inventory. However, something unexpected happened, and the crown floated up before releasing a golden light, brightening the room.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned when the golden light enveloped Xu Ling'er's body, and she slowly floated up. He frowned even more when the crown perched above her head, and her body glowed brighter. "What happened to Ling'er, Mei?"
[Master, the Holy Radiance Crown seems to be a soul equipment, and it chose Xu Ling'er as its master.]
Zhang Fei was shocked when Xu Ling'er's body slowly changed, but he could feel a calming and immaculate aura radiating from her.
Within minutes, Xu Ling'er had become a mature woman, and her long black hair had turned golden. Zhang Fei swallowed his saliva as her small clothes tore to pieces, revealing her naked body.

Xu Ling'er's new appearance is truly seductive and ravishing. Her face is flawlessly beautiful, and her lips are thick and sensual; even Boitata and the others can't compare to her. Her body was statuesque, and her skin was as white as snow. The most important features were the two massive mounds hanging on her chest, her perfect curves, her wide hips, and her prominent buttocks.
Xu Ling'er slowly opened her eyes, and her golden eyes seemed to pull Zhang Fei's soul out of his body, leaving him in a deep daze.
"A human, a heavenly fox, and a lust demon." Xu Ling'er's voice became so soft and melodious. "I didn't expect to meet a living creature as unique as you when I woke up from my deep slumber."
Zhang Fei immediately came back to his senses and asked. "Who are you? How did you get inside Ling'er's body?"

"My past name was Tian Huangjin, but my current name is Xu Ling'er." Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows because he couldn't recognize the woman's identity, but he felt familiar with her, and he felt like he had seen her before. "I want to talk to you more, but I don't have much time because she hasn't gotten my memories yet. If I appear for too long, it will only harm her body. If you want to see me again, you have to look for all the parts of the Holy Radiance equipment because they are the key to accessing my past memories, and she will be me at that time. Unfortunately, I've been dead for too long to know where the other parts are, so you'll have to search for them on your own."
After she said that, Xu Ling'er's body immediately shrank and returned to its original form, but the little girl seemed unaware of what had just happened because she was already fast asleep.

'All this time, I felt that Ling'er was much more mature than most of my women, but I didn't expect that she was the reincarnation of such a woman.'
[Master, if I'm not mistaken, there is a picture of Tian Huangjin in that place.]

Zhang Fei arched his brow, recalling the location known as the Era of the Beginning. 'You're right, Mei. I remember seeing a picture of Tian Huangjin at that place, and she was among the ancient humans. Do you have information about the other parts of the Holy Radiance equipment?'

[Unfortunately, I have no information about them, Master. The only way to find them is to have Xu Ling'er by your side whenever you go to other realms, and her presence will probably attract the other parts to her. Unfortunately, it would only harm her, especially with her low cultivation.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with that. 'Since we have no information about them, I can only search for them slowly, and I think Ling'er will become truly powerful if I manage to find them.'

After that, Zhang Fei went to Ru Xue's room and informed her about Xu Ling'er's situation, which left her in shock and disbelief. He then shared his memories of the event with her and told her about Tian Huangjin's identity.
"Do you think Ling'er will change when she becomes that woman in the future?" Ru Xue asked in a worried tone.
Zhang Fei hugged her directly. "I know your worries, but I believe that our Ling'er will never change, and she will always be herself even after she gets all of Tian Huangjin's memories."
"I hope so, because I don't want Ling'er to change." Ru Xue hugged him back tightly.

"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed at her worries. "Everyone will change as they grow up, including Ling'er. I'm sure her character will never change, but she will become more mature than she is now, and she will also become very strong. Anyway, how do you feel after you killed so many winged races?"

"Terrible!" Ru Xue immediately released herself from Zhang Fei's embrace and raised both hands. "I am a doctor, and I always use my hands to treat my patients. I have indeed killed too many beasts, but those winged races are different from them, and they are humans like us. Unfortunately, I cannot avoid killing them because they are enemies, and I may kill more people in the future, or else I will continue to hide under your protection."

Zhang Fei held Ru Xue's hand. "Honestly, I don't want your hands or any other hands to be stained with blood, and I prefer to kill our enemies by myself. However, I want you guys to live more freely when we go to the upper realms, but you must be able to protect yourselves for that."

"I know." Ru Xue replied with a nod. "Killing those winged races is my first experience, so I'm not used to it. However, you don't have to worry about me or the others, and we will try our best to protect ourselves. We are your wives, and husbands and wives should support each other through thick and thin. We do not want to continue hiding under your protection, and we will stand by your side to face our enemies."

Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction when he heard that. "You are my first woman, but your cultivation is still at the Soul Realm, so I will first help you break through to the Earth Realm before helping the others, and you will be able to fight better after that."
"Let's do it then."

chapters.title: Chapter 730: Two Kingdoms Troops
paragraphs: "Are you sure Zhang Fei is really that man's son?" Huangfu Shou doubtfully asked his empress.
"I heard it from his mouth directly, so it can't be wrong, and Zhang Fei is really his son." Helian Yueyi then asked him back. "Has Senior Tiannan given you the answers?"
"Senior Tiannan doesn't know Mai Xiaomeng, but he has heard of those clans, and they lived in the Red Sun Realm."
"Did he tell you the name of their leader?"

"Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan lead the Shang Clan. Murong Qianying leads the Murong Clan. Hong Quan leads the Hong Clan, and Hong Xinxin is their young miss." Huangfu Shou's answer caused Helian Yueyi to frown, as she didn't expect Zhang Fei's connection to be that high. "I asked him to contact the Shang Clan, but he refused because they are too powerful, and my ancestors' Huangfu Clan is nothing compared to them."
"Even if those people were willing to help us, they'd just trample on us and use us as tools." Huangfu Shou agreed with Helian Yueyi. "What about the other two realms?"

"Senior Tiannan doesn't know about the Netherworld Realm, but he told me that the Abyssal Realm is a demon realm. The demons in that realm, particularly their Demon Emperor, are even more powerful than those of the Shang Clan." Helian Yueyi was confused about how Zhang Fei could have a relationship with demons from that realm. "By the way, he told me that he was already on his way back, and my ancestors sent someone to cure our daughters."
"That's great!" Helian Yueyi then stood up and left the room. "Husband, you can go to Sister Yanxi or your other concubines, and I will accompany our daughters tonight."

Instead, Huangfu Shou lay on his bed, his mind constantly mulling over various strategies to win Zhang Fei over to his side. "If he were really the son of that mysterious man, it would be wonderful if he were willing to join me. How can I persuade him? Should I go and meet him?"
Helian Yueyi had already arrived at her two daughters' room, but she was confused to see Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei sleeping so soundly without feeling the slightest pain.
Helian Yueyi immediately sat down by the bed and checked on her two daughters. The results surprised her, especially since their pulses were much more stable.

"How did they suddenly become this calm?" Helian Yueyi tried to wake Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei up, but they did not give her any reaction. "At least their condition is much better now, and they are not in pain. Moreover, Senior Tiannan is on his way back to this realm with someone from the Huangfu Clan, and I am sure that person can cure them."

Helian Yueyi leaned against the bedpost and closed her eyes, but she immediately remembered Zhang Fei's actions and words at the restaurant. "I hope Senior Tiannan has a way to save us from that man because I really don't want to see my family destroyed."
As per Zhang Fei's order, Ling Baozi immediately met Huangfu Lian, Huangfu Ziyuan, and the fake Ruo Yanxi as soon as he arrived at the Huangfu Royal Palace.

Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Ziyuan could only sigh after they learned that the old man had also fallen into Zhang Fei's hands. On the other hand, Ling Baozi stared at the fake Ruo Yanxi with disbelief, especially since his master had told him that she used to be a man.
"What does he want from us?" Huangfu Ziyuan asked.

"Nothing." Ling Baozi's answer confused the three of them. "Zhang Fei asked us not to do anything, and he is waiting for Li Tiannan to return. Once that person returns, he will give us new orders, but I think we should do something to smooth his plan."
"What can we do, Grandpa Ling?" Huangfu Lian asked.
Ling Baozi turned to the fake Ruo Yanxi. "What kind of poison did you give Huangfu Shou?"

"I gave Huangfu Shou the Phantom Severing Poison, but its effects don't work immediately, and it will gradually affect his mind to the point of memory loss." The three men stared at the fake Ruo Yanxi in shock. "After the poison completely affects him, he will no longer be able to use his cultivation or techniques, and he will go insane. However, I am afraid that Li Tiannan will notice my poison, and he might be able to neutralize it."

Ling Baozi nodded in understanding. "Li Tiannan comes from the upper realms, and we don't have much information about cultivators from those places, so he may have the ability to neutralize your poison. Do you have other poisons?"

The fake Ruo Yanxi immediately took out two bottles and handed them to Ling Baozi. "The brown bottle contains the Thousand Screams Poison, and its effect will make people hallucinate. The black bottle contains the Silent Veins Poison; it will spread to our veins and paralyze our nerves, and people who are exposed to it will lose control of their bodies."
Ling Baozi thought about the two poisons for some time. "Give me more of this Silent Veins Poison, and I will use it on Huangfu Shou's generals to put his troops out of action."

"Sure." The fake Ruo Yanxi immediately handed several bottles of Silent Veins Poison to Ling Baozi. She also gave him a few bottles of the Thousand Screams Poison, just in case he needed it for something else.
After taking everything in, Ling Baozi immediately left the room and headed to the private residence of Huangfu Shou's generals.

The fake Ruo Yanxi tried to seduce the two men, but Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Ziyuan immediately ran away from the concubine, especially since they knew her true identity. Instead of going to see Huangfu Shou, she went to visit his other concubines, as Zhang Fei had instructed her to administer his pills to them.
Yun Aoxian, who had arrived at the Zhou Kingdom with his troops, was a little surprised by the appearance of Zhou Fang. "Did Zhang Fei order you here?"

"Yes." Zhou Fang nodded at Yun Aoxian. "My master said that you would need my help, so he sent me to guide you to the strategic places of Zhou Xiaochuan's troops, and he has also ordered others to stop his troops."

"What exactly is your father's plan?" Zhou Fang informed Yun Aoxian about Zhou Xiaochouan's plan to attack the Yun Kingdom in a week but reassured him that he didn't need to worry about them. After all, their leaders, Zhou Fenghu and Zhou Fanshi, were Zhang Fei's slaves. "Lead us to the nearest place first, and we will take it over."
"Follow me."

Yun Qinghai, who was leading his troops to move to the Zhou Kingdom, raised his eyebrows as soon as Zhou Tong appeared in front of them. His troops quickly prepared to attack the Zhou Prince, but he immediately stopped them. "Did Zang Fei send you here?"

"Isn't that obvious?" Zhou Tong coldly asked him back. "Compared to Yun Aoxian, you are too weak and inexperienced, and you won't be able to lead them properly. If it weren't for my master's slave mark in my soul, I wouldn't have bothered to help you."
Yun Qinghai clenched his fists tightly, but he did not argue with Zhou Tong and lead his troops. "Move! We must arrive at the Zhou Kingdom before sunrise."
"Yes, Prince!"

Zhou Tong followed Yun Qinghai and his troops from behind as he continued to release heavy sighs. He was the crown prince of the Zhou Kingdom, and he was Zhou Xiaochuan's main successor, but his situation turned 180 degrees. He had become Zhang Fei's slave now, and his master intended to push Zhou Shenxin to the throne to replace their father. 'If he had never appeared in this realm, my fate would not have ended this tragically.'

Since his main body and other clones were busy, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Xian Imperial Sect, especially since several groups of troops from the Xian Kingdom had already gathered there. If he did not assist them, they would have to spend a significant amount of time traveling to the Zhou Kingdom, as their kingdom was located in the south and their target was situated far to the north.

Xian Qifeng, Luo Qinglin, and some of Chao Yuanfeng's disciples, including Bai Tian'er, who had previously returned to the Bai Kingdom, had also gathered there. However, Ximen Chuixue and Yuan Luo did not join them because their wedding was approaching, and they still had a lot of preparations to make.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened a portal to the Zhou Kingdom. "Once you arrive at the kingdom, Zhou Fanshi and some of Zhou Xiaochuan's subordinates will meet you. They will lead you to some of the most strategic locations in the kingdom, and your first task is to take them over. After that, you can begin capturing nearby locations until you control the entire kingdom area. However, I strictly prohibit you from approaching the Zhou Royal Capital. Do you all understand?"
"Yes!"
"Enter the portal now."
Xian Qifeng, Luo Qinglin, and some of Chao Yuanfeng's disciples immediately led groups of troops from the Xian Kingdom to enter the portal according to Xian Feng and Xian Luo's arrangements.
Xian Feng then questioned Zhang Fei [5]. "Are you really going to wait six months to take over the Zhou Kingdom?"

"Essentially, I already control the Zhou Kingdom, and we can seize it at any time. However, I don't want to do it too soon, and I want Zhou Xiaochuan to experience despair first." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer made Xian Feng and Xiao Luo smile bitterly, especially since they had never dared to go against the Zhou Emperor in the past, but the situation was on their side because of his presence. "Ling Baozi, Huang Ziyuan, and Huangfu Lian are my slaves now. Unfortunately, there is still Li Tiannan on Huangfu Shou's side, and his ancestors are powerful, so we cannot act rashly against them. I have also eliminated the members of the Alchemy Union in the Yun Kingdom, so I have one less enemy. I will handle that branch of the organization in the Zhou Kingdom after Zhou Shenxin ascends to the empress, and I will eliminate them if they are not willing to submit to me."
Xian Feng and Xian Luo were shocked to hear that Zhang Fei [5] had already eliminated the Alchemy Union from the Yun Kingdom. "So, what are your plans now?"
"I will pick up the Meng Clan from my home realm and bring them to this realm, so I hope you can help me take care of them, father-in-law."
