chapters.title: Chapter 735 735: Talk With Zhou Xiaochuan
paragraphs: "What do you want from me so that you will be willing to heal all my wives?" Zhou Xiaochuan respectfully asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] pretended to think for a while. "Honestly, nothing is interesting in this realm, as it's merely a middle realm, and I can find more interesting things in the upper realms. However, I have heard and seen many unusual things about this kingdom, one of which is that the men here never respect women, including you. You guys never give talented women a chance to develop themselves, and you only regard them as tools to fulfill your ambitions."

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s bold statement left Zhou Xiaochuan speechless, especially since it had been going on since his ancestors' era. He grew up in such a situation, and it shaped him to apply the same treatment to women in his generation or below.

"From your expression, I can tell that you are more concerned about your throne and power than your wives." Zhou Xiaochuan wanted to refute that, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] waved his hand to stop him. "To tell you the truth, I also used and exploited many women to achieve my ambitions. Unlike you, I will never use the women in my family as tools to achieve my ambitions, and I will only use those who are my enemies. Thus, if you exchange your throne and power for their lives, I will heal them immediately."

Zhou Xiaochuan responded with a dark face. As Zhang Xiaolong [3] said, the throne, power, and ambition were the most important to him. He would never trade them for anything, including the lives of all his wives.

Hong Xinxin laughed in her heart as she looked at Zhou Xiaochuan's expression. 'Haha! I truly pity this foolish emperor! Zhang Fei caused all his wives to fall ill, but he innocently led this guy to make the most difficult decision of his life. Unfortunately, life is never fair to anyone, and he had to deal with the most cunning fox I have ever met.'
Zhou Hanling, who was standing behind Zhou Xiaochuan, also laughed in his heart after listening to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s conditions.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke again. "You don't need to decide now, and you can think things over first. If you truly love all your wives and want them to be safe, you can come to me again. If you agree to my conditions, I will go straight to your royal palace to heal them. Otherwise, let them die and force other women to replace them, just like you forced them to be your wives."

Zhou Xiaochuan said nothing and hurriedly left the residence, followed by Zhou Hanling, who kept smiling to himself because no one had ever been able to put the Zhou Emperor in such a situation before.

"Hahaha." Hong Xinxin burst into laughter after they left. "You put that foolish emperor in an incredible dilemma, you know? He is clearly an ambitious man, and he wants everything in his hands, but you are asking him to choose between his ambitions and all his wives. Unfortunately, your efforts will be unsuccessful, especially since a man like him would never be willing to give up on his ambitions."

"I know that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. "In fact, I never expected Zhou Xiaochuan to agree to my conditions, and I intentionally gave him such conditions just to play with his emotions. Every time he sees his wives, he will keep thinking about my condition. However, that foolish emperor might take extreme measures if he reaches a dead end, and he might let them die, or he might even kill them himself."
"Do you really believe that he would take such extreme measures by killing all his wives?" Hong Xinxin doubtfully asked.

"All that was just my guess after I peeked into his soul, and we'll get the answer in the near future." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then rose to his feet. "I'll go somewhere else to meet someone, and I'll start to temper my body again once I get back."

After Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, Hong Xinxin shook her head. She could immediately guess his destination and the identity of the person he was referring to. 'He is so young, but he is already so cunning, and he repeatedly plays with people's feelings. I can't imagine that if he had lived for thousands or tens of thousands of years, all the living beings in this universe would probably be fooled by him.'

Zhou Xiaochuan had arrived in the room and looked seriously at his wives, who were still lying unconscious. As Zhang Xiaolong [3] expected, their previous conversation had disturbed his mind quite a bit. He did regard all his wives as tools, but he also cared about some of them, especially Dong Feiling. In his eyes, they were the best women, and there was no one better than them in his kingdom, so he couldn't let them die.

'That bastard! Just because he came from the upper realm, he asked me to choose between my throne and all my wives.' Zhou Xiaochuan clenched his fists so tightly that his palms bled. "Hanling, go to the border with the Yun Kingdom now! If you guys fail to capture the kingdom, I will sentence you all to death."
"Yes, Emperor." Zhou Hanling faintly smiled as he walked out of the room. He immediately contacted Zhang Xiaolong [3] and informed him about it.
Zhou Xiaochuan himself also left his six wives' room to go to his study, where he continued to think about his conversation with Zhang Xiaolong [3] earlier.
After his two wives returned, Huangfu Shou inquired. "Did you get any important information on their wedding? Did anyone recognize you two there?"
"Husband, you can talk to Sister Yueyi, and I will go see your other concubines."

After the fake Ruo Yanxi left, Helian Yueyi immediately sat down beside her husband. "No one recognized our disguise, but Zhang Fei was really their son. That guy and Hong Xinxin were present at their wedding, and they were close to the royal members of the Xian and Yun Kingdoms. Moreover, Senior Tiannan had already said that the Hong Clan is powerful, so we must forget our desire to annex the two kingdoms. Otherwise, we will face them, and we will be the ones destroyed."

"You are right." Huangfu Shou replied with a serious expression. "Since we cannot attack the Yun and Xian Kingdoms, and the Bai Kingdom is already in our hands, our last choice is the Zhou Kingdom. I have received news that Zhou Xiaochuan's troops have been on standby at the border with the Yun Kingdom for the past two weeks, but they still haven't attacked them."
"Do you intend to attack the Zhou Kingdom now?"

Huangfu Shou nodded at her. "I have asked Old Ling to prepare our troops, and I have also asked Ziyuan to prepare to lead them together with the generals. However, I have not asked them to move yet, and I will wait for Senior Tiannan to arrive in two weeks to discuss this matter. If he agrees with my idea, I will order them to attack the Zhou Kingdom directly."

"I think waiting for Senior Tiannan is the correct decision, and our chances of defeating Zhou Xiaochuan will be much greater if he helps Huangfu Ziyuan and the others." Helian Yueyi then got up from his seat. "I feel strange about our daughters' situation because they've been sleeping for over three weeks, and I had to force-feed them during that time, so I'm going to check on their condition now."
After his empress left, Huangfu Shou also left the room. He contacted Ling Baozi, Huang Ziyuan, and several others to meet him in the meeting room.

On her way to her daughter's room, Helian Yueyi passed by the room of one of Huangfu Shou's concubines. She heard moaning from inside, so she peeked in and found the fake Ruo Yanxi having fun with another concubine. 'Why do I feel like Sister Yanxi is getting hornier now? She also has many unconventional ideas, such as using the dildo on our husband, which causes him to become angry. Fortunately, he didn't punish her; otherwise, she would have suffered.'

Helian Yueyi did not disturb the two women and hurried to her two daughters' bedroom, but she let out a heavy sigh when she got there, especially since Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomeng still had not woken up.

Helian Yueyi sat by the bed and checked their conditions, but she still couldn't find any changes in their bodies. Despite their calm expressions, she knew that the black liquid was continuing to corrode their bodies, which made her afraid that they would become disabled.
"Are you worried about them?"
The question shocked Helian Yueyi, and she immediately turned to face the voice's owner, Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How did you manage to infiltrate this palace?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and stroked Helian Yueyi's cheek. "You've seen a small part of my abilities, so you shouldn't be surprised if I can break through the small barrier in this palace, right? By the way, you are more attractive without your disguise, and you look a little younger than before."

Helian Yueyi wanted to slap Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hand, but he moved faster and held both her hands above her head. Her eyes widened as soon as he kissed her for the second time, and the first was that night at the river more than three weeks ago.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn't kiss Helian Yueyi for too long and immediately separated their lips. "Your lips are also softer and wetter than when I kissed you the first time."
"You... You..." Helian Yueyi stuttered without being able to finish her words due to her overflowing anger.

"You what? Do you want to kiss me again?" Helian Yueyi covered her mouth with her hands and shook her head like a little girl, making Zhang Xiaolong [3] smile in amusement. He then looked at Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomeng. "This is the second time I have infiltrated this palace, and I came here again because I was curious about their condition."

Helian Yueyi immediately asked. "Can you cure my two daughters? They were exposed to this black liquid in the Star Tower two months ago, and their condition has been deteriorating ever since. They have been in a deep sleep like this for the past three weeks, and I am afraid they will never wake up again."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed in his heart when he heard that, especially since he deliberately made Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei fall asleep using his dream imprisonment ability. To be honest, I have never seen this black liquid before. I had already taken a sample of it some time ago, but I had not found a way to remove it from their bodies."

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer disappointed Helian Yueyi, but she was aware that the Star Tower was too mysterious, and no cultivator had yet managed to solve the mysteries within it. "Actually, my husband has already sent someone to another realm, and he is on his way back with someone from that realm."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows.

Helian Yueyi then continued. "He said that person might be able to cure my two daughters, but I am skeptical that person can cure them, especially since everything in the Star Tower is too mysterious."
"I've entered the Star Tower before, and I discovered too many mysteries there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her. "Who was the person your husband's subordinates picked up?"
Helian Yueyi shook her head. "I don't know that person's identity yet, but they will arrive in two weeks, so I can only wait until they arrive."

paragraphs: "Husband! Stop the plan to attack the Zhou Kingdom!" Huangfu Shou, who was in the middle of a meeting with Ling Baozi and Huang Ziyuan, immediately frowned at Helian Yueyi. She hurriedly went to her husband's side and told him about her conversation with Zhang Xiaolong [3] earlier, which greatly shocked him.

Naturally, Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi were not surprised to hear that because they were Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s slaves. Additionally, they already knew that he had access to their palace through Huangfu Lian's room.

"I don't know how he managed to infiltrate our kingdom, but he claims to have infiltrated here twice." Helian Yueyi shared with Huangfu Shou the memories she had gotten from Zhang Xiaolong [3] about his conversation with Zhou Xiaochuan. "Dong Feiling and the others are clearly in terrible shape right now, and he intends to take advantage of their condition to bring down the Zhou Kingdom."

"I suspect that guy is the mastermind behind the situation of Dong Feiling and the others, and he deliberately played tricks on Zhou Xiaochuan to take over his kingdom. He has also done something terrible to my generals." Helian Yueyi just realized that none of Huangfu Shou's generals were present at their meeting. "I summoned them for a meeting, but none of them came. Old Ling contacted their families one by one, but their families said that they couldn't control their bodies, and they couldn't come here because of their condition."

After hearing that and remembering her conversation with Zhang Xiaolong [3] in his restaurant more than three weeks ago, Helian Yueyi's feelings became chaotic. She finally realized that he already knew her family was one of his 'son's' enemies. 'Damn it! Does he really want to destroy my family? Why did he repeatedly seduce me if he wanted to destroy us? Is he thinking of using me against my husband?'

Unfortunately, until now, Helian Yueyi had not realized that Zhang Xiaolong [3] and his 'son' were the same person. However, she had mistaken his intention to approach her, especially since he had no intention of using her to fight Huangfu Shou.

Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozhi really wanted to tell Huangfu Shou and Helian Yueyi the truth, but unfortunately, they couldn't do so because of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s slave mark in their souls. 'Sooner or later, this kingdom will fall into our master's hands, and the two of them will definitely suffer at his hands. Not only this kingdom, but the Zhou Kingdom will also fall into his hands in the future, especially with Zhou Shenxin by his side.'
What are you thinking, wife?"

Huangfu Shou's inquiry brought Helian Yueyi back to reality. "I'm thinking about how we should resolve this issue without causing harm to us, especially since that guy clearly wants to take over all the kingdoms on this island, including our kingdom. He already has a good relationship with the Beast and Natural Races Kingdoms; if he also controls the five human kingdoms, that means only two demon kingdoms are left. If their kingdoms also fall into his hands, he will become the sole ruler of this realm, and no one will be able to oppose him anymore."

"Do you think I should contact my ancestors and ask them for help?" Helian Yueyi looked at Huangfu Shou with raised eyebrows. "That guy has the support of Hong Xinxin and her Hong Clan, so we will never win against him with our strength. Therefore, the best solution is to contact my ancestors, and they will definitely be willing to send strong cultivators from the Huangfu Clan to help us."

Helian Yueyi agreed with her husband that it was indeed the best solution they had right now. However, they did not have accurate information about the Hong Clan's strength. Furthermore, she remembered Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Hong Xinxin talking about other people, such as Mai Xiaomeng and Murong Qianying. She wasn't sure if the Huangfu Clan would be able to face so many powerful cultivators combined. "I think you shouldn't contact them yet, and we should wait for Senior Tiannan to arrive in this realm. Moreover, he brought someone from your ancestors' clan, and we will discuss this with the two of them first."
"Don't you think it will be too late?"

"No." Helian Yueyi shook her head in refusal. "That guy is clearly targeting Zhou Xiaochuan for now, and I think he is stalling for time against him. Therefore, I believe he will not attack us yet, and we still have plenty of time to plan the best strategy to counter his plans. If we are too hasty in making decisions, he and Hong Xinxin might attack us directly, and we won't be able to stop them with our strength."
Huangfu Shou said nothing, but deep down, he knew that Helian Yueyi's words were true. He was annoyed and frustrated by the situation.

For decades, Huangfu Shou had planned everything to rule over the human island, but he never dared declare open war on the other kingdoms. He always thought that gradually suppressing them was the best decision to reduce his losses. However, the situation slowly began to change when Zhou Xiaochuan established relations with the two demon kingdoms, which made their strengths equal.

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s arrival four months ago further tangled Huangfu Shou's plans. It started with his relationship with Xian Xianqin and then his relationship with Yun Xinyue. In addition, he had several powerful backers whose strength exceeded his own, thwarting all his plans against the Xian and Yun Kingdoms.

Helian Yueyi hugged Huangfu Shou from behind. "I can feel your disappointment, especially since I also feel disappointed with our situation. However, we would rather step back than force ourselves to move forward, especially since it would only destroy our family. At least, we should think of something to prevent that guy from attacking our kingdom, but we can't do it alone, so we'll discuss it with Senior Tiannan and the man from the Huangfu Clan first."

"You two can leave." Once Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi left, Huangfu Shou pulled Helian Yueyi forward and sat her down at the table. "If the situation becomes unfavorable for us, I will ask Senior Tiannan to release that thing from the seal, and it will immediately destroy this entire island or even this realm, especially since it has been confined there for millennia. That way, both parties will gain nothing, and we can ask the person from the Huangfu Clan to take us to the Grand Royal Realm. We will start our new life, and we will forget this realm."

Naturally, Helian Yueyi knew about the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast that was sealed under the Bai Royal Palace. Although she didn't want to release the beast because the casualties would be too heavy, she thought that it was the best way to crush Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s ambitions, and she hoped that he and those closest to him would die at the hands of the beast.

Unfortunately, Helian Yueyi's anger had already affected her mind and clouded her judgment, causing her to forget that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had the ability to move between realms. Even if Huangfu Shou and Li Tiannan released the beast from the seal, it would not affect them in the slightest. "All right, we will make a decision after we discuss it with Senior Tiannan and the people from the Huangfu Clan."
"Yeah." Huangfu Shou immediately took off their clothes and started having fun with Helian Yueyi in the meeting room.

Zhang Fei immediately summoned the thunderbird out of the beast space. Lei Que immediately took him away to the sky, which was quickly darkening, especially since his lightning tribulation was about to begin.
Feng Yao only watched Zhang Fei's breakthrough from a distance and did not approach him.
[Master, that kid has broken through again, although his last breakthrough was about a month ago.]

Feng Yao nodded in response to Huo Ling. "The flow of time inside Zhang Fei's training room is two times faster than the outside world, so he can stabilize his cultivation much faster than other people. Furthermore, he doesn't need to spend special time to stabilize his cultivation, and he usually stabilizes it when he dual cultivates with all his wives. Furthermore, he has five clones, so such things are natural for him."

[Zhang Fei's actions may be natural for us, but all his actions are too absurd for other cultivators, including cultivators from the upper realms. If his cultivation continues to increase at this rate, he might be able to go to the Paradise Realm faster than we expect. He must first pass all the Paradise Realm hurdles to reach our realm, which is difficult. If he fails to get past them, he will never be able to go there, and we will have to look for someone more worthy than him.]

"If Zhang Fei, who has so many advantages, is not worthy of our realm, then no other living being is worthy of going there." Huo Ling could only hear that because Feng Yao trusted him too much. "Hong Xinxin is in this realm now, and she is enough to protect him, so I will go to the Beast Kingdom and enter seclusion."
After informing Long Huang and Long Baiyun of her plans, Feng Yao flew toward the Beast Kingdom. She asked them not to disturb her seclusion within the volcano, and they readily agreed.

Upon arrival, Feng Yao immediately returned to her phoenix form and entered the volcano, which was filled with hot lava and rich fire elements. Although the place was scorching for other cultivators, the heat was meaningless for a Fire Phoenix like her.

A few hours later, Zhang Fei had already completed his lightning tribulations. Although his lightning tribulations grew stronger every time he broke through to the next stage, he had no significant problems dealing with them. Instead, his lightning tribulations truly benefited him, especially his lightning body cultivation technique, which was getting closer to the perfection stage.

As a lightning element beast, the thunderbird also reaped enormous benefits from Zhang Fei's lightning tribulations. His lightning tribulations not only tempered the beast's body to become stronger, but they also helped his cultivation continue to increase significantly, and his cultivation will soon reach the Earth Realm like his master's.
"Master, I will break through to the Earth Realm once you break through to the 6-Star Earth Realm, and I am looking forward to it." Lei Que said.

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Perhaps I will break through to the 6-Star Earth Realm next month, so you can focus on cultivating in the beast space while waiting for the time to come. Once I am ready to break through, I will summon you out as usual, and you can break through then."
"Yes, Master."
After he sent Lei Que back to the beast space, Zhang Fei immediately went to see Gang Zhishou at his shop in the Xian Royal Capital.

"You, kid! I haven't seen you for quite a while, but your cultivation has already reached the 5-Star Earth Realm." Zhang Fei simply smiled at that, causing Gang Zhishou to let out a helpless sigh. "Moreover, you are no longer a man without backers in this realm; you have become the son-in-law of the Xian and Yun kingdoms now. How about your blacksmithing? Have you managed to forge an Earth Grade Equipment?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I've tried forging an Earth-Grade weapon once, but the result was too bad. Moreover, I still need to improve myself in other aspects, so I chose to put blacksmithing aside for the time being. However, I'm confident of defeating the Divine Flame Realm's younger generation, so don't worry."

"I am sure you will win against them." Gang Zhishou then handed over the newest weapon design to Zhang Fei. "My master said that this is the best design he could think of, and he will start working on it if this weapon model satisfies you."

Zhang Fei immediately looked at the weapon, but he was quite surprised by its shape. "A gunblade, huh? I didn't expect Senior Duan to have such an interesting imagination, but I really like this weapon design. This way, I can use a sword and a gun at the same time, and my enemies definitely won't expect that."

Zhang Fei immediately returned the weapon design to Gang Zhishou. "Since you like the design, I will contact my master now so he can start working on it. Unfortunately, he still hasn't gotten the Luminous Qi Crystal, so you'll have to wait a little longer to be able to use your new weapons."

"That's not a problem because I still have the demon extermination sword and my other weapons, so I'm not in a rush to use my new weapon." Zhang Fei then asked. "Where will the blacksmith competition be held?"

"At my master's residence, so you must go there in three days." Gang Zhishou immediately put away the weapon design and led Zhang Fei out of his shop. "I must go see my master now, and we will wait for you there."
"Let me take you there."

He then sent Huang Rong, Hong Yao, and Qiu Mei back to their country. After all, the seven women had been absent for two weeks based on Earth time, so they had to go back to take care of everything.

After he finished setting everything up, Zhang Fei handed over all of the restaurant's needs to Han Bingxing, starting with spices, beast meat, and various other items. He also asked some women from the Demon Fox group to help her in the restaurant.

"I came here to see you, Shushi." Zhang Fei replied with a relaxed smile.

Zhang Fei's two hands immediately moved to Bai Shushi's buttocks. He squeezed and massaged them, igniting her lust that had been dormant for so many years. 'Ugh! This shameless guy! "You are too terrible at women's affairs, and you never hold yourself back from getting more women." Bai Shushi then asked him again. "Why do you differentiate between your official women and clones' partners? After all, your clones are still you, right?"

"You're right. My clones are still me because we share everything and have one mind and soul." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "However, not all women are worthy of becoming members of my official harem, and I only choose the best ones to become my official harem. You are one of them, and I will take you as a member of my harem when you are ready."
"What about my daughter? Is she not worthy of being a member of your harem?" Bai Shushi asked with narrowed eyes.

Zhang Fei shook his head, much to Bai Shushi's disappointment. "I've read all of Bai Tian'er's memories, so I can say that she doesn't deserve to be a member of my harem. However, I haven't made a decision about her, but the outcome depends on her. If she can convince me that she's worthy, I might change my mind, and I might take her as a member of my harem."

"Honestly, I am disappointed about your assessment of my daughter, but I myself have yet to meet your other women besides Senior Shang Yumei, so I still don't know your criteria for your harem members." Huang Rong and the others were completely satisfied with living in the Nine Stars Realm, especially after they had stayed there for almost two months and spent a lot of time with Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei did not stay long on Earth, and he immediately returned to the Nine Stars Realm after he took all the stock items from their warehouses in various countries.

"I came here to see you, Shushi." Zhang Fei replied with a relaxed smile.
Bai Shushi's lips twitched at Zhang Fei's shamelessness, especially since she had not agreed to be his woman.

Zhang Fei then lifted Bai Shushi to her feet and rubbed her cheeks.

Bai Tian'er is indeed beautiful, but your charm is different from hers.
You are mature and reserved, but she is playful and emotional, and I like you more than her."
Bai Shushi wanted to refute him, but Zhang Fei suddenly hugged her and sealed her lips, causing her eyes to widen in shock.
He immediately gave her a French kiss, which made her flustered.
Zhang Fei's two hands immediately moved to Bai Shushi's buttocks.

paragraphs: "What happened? Why is your expression so serious?" Fei Qinyuan asked her husband.
Shang Huaqiang immediately told his wife about Cheng Gaoji. "He told me that he had arrived at the Sky Jade Realm yesterday, but I couldn't contact him after that."

"If I remember correctly, Feng Yao's cultivation should still be at the Divine Manifestation Realm, so she shouldn't be able to do anything to Cheng Gaoji." Fei Qinyuan paused and thought about some things. "The only thing I can think of is that she called someone else from the Phoenix Race to help her after she destroyed our portal, and that person is stronger than him. If that's true, our plan will fail once again if we move too hastily. Therefore, we have to send some people to that realm to monitor the situation, and we will order those four people to move if the situation permits."
Shang Huaqiang nodded in agreement. "I've thought about it, and I've already selected two people to go to that realm. I'll contact them now, and I'll ask them to leave directly."
"Who are those two people?"

"Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei." Fei Qinyuan was surprised to hear those two names from Shang Huaqiang. "The Wang and Dai clans have decided to side with us, and I asked them to prove their loyalty to me, so Wang Jinghsan and Dai Guowei sent their sons. Although they are not their strongest sons, they should be enough to check the situation there, and Feng Yao will never realize that they are our people."

"I hope Feng Yao really won't recognize them." Fei Qinyuan then looked for someone in their clan, but she couldn't find that person. "Where did Ziyuan go? I never saw her again after she visited the Ren Clan."

Shang Huaqiang released a soft sigh. "Since the people she sent still couldn't find Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, Ziyuan decided to go look for them herself. She suspected that they had gone to the lower realms, so she looked for them there."
"The lower realms?"

"Yes." Shang Huaqiang nodded and explained. "Shang Baishi is not stupid; Ziyuan is certain that he would not take her daughter to another realm in the middle or upper realms, especially since we can find them more easily. Therefore, his best choice was to take Shang Xiaoyin to the lower realm, especially since we wouldn't expect the two of them to go there. Moreover, the lower realms are not as extensive as the middle or upper realms, and she is confident she can find them by herself."

"The lower realms are not as extensive as the middle or upper realms, but I'm sure Ziyuan won't be able to find them by herself. I think we should send some people to help her, or she will waste a lot of time looking for them, which would slow down our plans." After her husband agreed, Fei Qinyuan contacted several people to help Shang Zhiyuan. "What about Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei?"
"They will leave today using the best artifacts their clans have."
"That's good." Fei Qinyuan then stood up. "I will return to my Fei Clan for a few days, and I will prepare them to carry out our other plans."
"All right."

At the Murong Clan, Ai Weiren came to Murong Qianying in her private room. "Qianying, I still want to stay here, but I have other matters to attend to, so I have to leave now. However, I will come back here again after my matters are finished, but I don't know how long it will take to finish, so you should think about your own safety."
"You can leave if you have important business, and I have a plan to protect my clan." Murong Qianying then asked. "Are you bringing Shang Xiaojuan with you?"

"No." Ai Weiren replied with a shake of her head. "Xiaojuan got information about the Sun Tower from people in the Wasteland Realm, and he left for the Blossom Heaven Realm a week ago. I've contacted him just now, and he'll likely be there in a few days."
"Oh?" Murong Qianying was surprised to hear that, and she didn't even know about it. "Did he go there by himself?"
Ai Weiren nodded at her. "Xiaojuan is too stubborn, and he is eager to meet your second daughter, so he rushed there by himself."

"I see." Murong Qianying nodded in understanding. "Unfortunately, Xiaojuan was too stupid, and his efforts would only end in vain. The Sun Tower was not as simple as he thought, and there were many tough challenges in it. In fact, my second daughter went there with Senior Hun Di, Senior Xia Tian, and the others."
"Oh?" This time, Ai Weiren was surprised because she knew nothing about the Sun Tower. "Do you know about the challenges in the tower?"

Murong Qianying shook her head in response. "I only know the outline of the Sun Tower, but I don't have any specific information about the tower, and we suspect that the tower is the key to going to the realms beyond these upper realms. Therefore, Senior Hun Di and Senior Xia Tian wanted to check it out in person, and they brought some of our younger generation with them, including my niece, son, and second daughter."
"Why don't you join them?"

"Can I leave with my clan's situation like this?" Murong Qianying turned to ask with a soft sigh. "Honestly, I was curious about the Sun Tower, and I wanted to try facing those challenges. However, Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan would directly attack my clan if I went there, so I abandoned my wish."
Ai Weiren fell into contemplation for quite a while, but she immediately stood up. "Hey, I'll use your clan portal to go to the Wasteland Realm."
"Are you thinking of going to the Blossom Heaven Realm? What about your business?" Murong Qianying asked with a frown.
Ai Weiren raised both hands. "My business is not more important than the realms beyond these upper realms, so I want to go to the Blossom Heaven Realm to check out that tower."

"You can go to the back because my clan's portal is there." After Ai Weiren left, Murong Qianying immediately gathered her clan members and ordered them to pack up all the valuables in their clan. 'Sigh! I don't want to do this, but my best option is to move them to the Hong Clan, and we will be safe there.'

Murong Qianying then took out her interspatial communication device and contacted Hong Xinxin, who now lives in the Nine Stars Realm. She also contacted Cai Yinzhi to inform her of her plans, which she immediately agreed to.

In the bathroom, Hong Xinxin told Zhang Xiaolong [3] about Murong Qianyung's decision to bring her Murong Clan to her Hong Clan. "Sister Qianying decided it like that because Ai Weiren decided to go to the Blossom Heaven Realm, and she doubted that my two seniors were enough to protect them from Shang Huaqiang."

"Retreating does not mean losing, and we can make a better plan to strike back, so Murong Qianying has made the right decision about that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her. "Do you want to go back to the Hong Clan now?"

Hong Xinxin nodded at him. "I think I should go back there, and then I will go straight to the Murong Clan so I can help Sister Qianying directly. However, it will probably take a few days, so I can't help you to temper your body for the time being, and you can use all the Jiashen Liquid I gave you."

"That's not a problem." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the portal to the Hong Clan. "Inform me if Murong Qianying wants to see me, and I will bring Lianzhi and the others back to the Azure Sky Realm to avoid arousing her suspicion."

"Anyway, give me some more of your Yang Qi, especially since it's been almost a month since I last gave it to Mai Xiaomeng." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave her a thousand bottles, Hong Xinxin immediately disappeared into the portal. He then closed his eyes again and continued to absorb the Jianshen Liquid inside the wooden tub. "As long as the matter with the Shang Clan is not settled, I will never be able to rest easy. Unfortunately, they are still too strong for me, so I must find other ways to destroy them gradually."

As she had originally planned, Hong Xinxin went straight to Mai Xiaomeng to hand over Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s Yang Qi to her. After that, she went to the Murong Clan to help Murong Qianying, but the female cat beast decided to go with her.

After he asked the salamander and the dark fairy to return to his body, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the elemental chamber and went to the border of Yun Kingdom, where he met Zhou Hanling, Zhou Fanzhi, and Zhou Fenghu.
Zhou Hanling then asked him. "What should we do next, Master? Zhou Xiaochuan threatened to kill us if we didn't attack the Yun Kingdom."

Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly before opening the map. He looked for an empty location to move Zhou Xiaochuan's troops, especially since their numbers were so large. "There is an empty island to the east of the Yun Kingdom, and it is quite large, so you guys can move these troops there for the time being. Once everything is ready, the three of you will bring them back here, and we will immediately take over the Zhou Kingdom from his hands."
"How are we going to go there without passing through the Yun Kingdom, Master?" Zhou Fenghu asked.

"Wait here first." Zhang Fei [5] immediately disappeared from going to the empty island. After he installed half of the teleportation device there, he returned to Zhou Fenghu and the others, and he installed the other half in the forest not far from the location. "You guys can lead them there using this device, and you can come back here to buy additional supplies for them later."
"Yes, Master."

Although Zhou Xiaochuan's troops were confused by the three men's decision, none of them dared disobey their orders. They immediately followed their orders to use the teleportation device to reach the empty island.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately return to the elemental chamber but infiltrated the Zhou Royal Palace. He found Zhou Xiaochuan in his six wives' bedroom with a gloomy expression, but he did not meet him and went to several places there. He used his plant generation ability to create several things, leaving them in those places. 'Gradually, that guy will suffer from their effects, and I can deal with him more easily.'

After that, Zhang Fei [5] returned to the elemental chamber and began to absorb the four elements inside. Naturally, the salamander and the dark fairy came out of his body, and both absorbed the fire and darkness elements in that place.

Quickly, three days passed, and today was the day the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm arrived. However, Zhang Fei had no intention of coming out of his seclusion, and he used his fifth clone to go to Duan Zhao's residence.

When Zhang Fei [5] arrived there, Duan Zhao was gathering with Gang Zhishou and his other disciples. However, the presence of another man surprised him, and he was Duan Lingtian, the shop owner he first met when he arrived at Xian Royal Capital. "I didn't expect to meet you here, Old Duan."

"Hahaha." Duan Ling Tian laughed upon hearing this. "Old Zhao is my brother, and the blacksmith competition is important to him and his disciples, so I don't want to miss it. However, I didn't expect that the kid I met more than four months ago has improved so much in several aspects, and you are now the son-in-law of the Xian and Yun Kingdoms. Furthermore, I have heard from my brother about all your actions in the Bai and Zhou Kingdoms, and I guess you have also done something to the Huangfu Kingdom. In addition, I heard that you have eliminated all the Alchemy Union branches in the four kingdoms."

"You're right, Old Duan. The Alchemy Union no longer exists in this realm, and I took over their last shop in the Zhou Kingdom four days ago. Luo Xuejia, Yi Zuoli, and Pei Yun are my subordinates now. As for the three kingdoms, I haven't done too much against them, but I've made some plans against them, and I'll execute them all when I'm truly ready." Duan Lingtian nodded in understanding while stroking his beard. Zhang Fei [5] then sat down in front of them before asking Duan Zhao. "So when will those people arrive here, Senior?"

"Their leaders informed me that they are not far from this realm, and they will arrive here in about six hours, so we can only wait for them to arrive. Moreover, the competition will only start tomorrow morning, so we don't need to rush." Duan Zhao then took out the weapon design. "Are you sure you want to create this weapon?"

"Even though I'm not a swordmaster, my main weapon is a sword, so I think your idea for my new weapon is really interesting, and I want to make it." Zhang Fei [5] then gave a storage ring to Duan Zhao. "There are ten million blue jewels inside, so you can use them to pay for the Luminous Qi Crystal, Senior."

Duan Zhao was really surprised to hear that Zhang Fei [5] had collected so many blue jewels in less than two months. However, he remembered about all his shops, so he accepted it without asking anything. "My old friend will arrive tomorrow evening to deliver the Luminous Qi Crystal, and I will start crafting your new weapon after the blacksmith competition is over."
"How long will the competition last?"

"I can't say for sure." Duan Zhao then looked at his four disciples. "Usually, the competition will last for three days, but that only applies if only four of them are competing. This time, their disciples will also be competing with the younger generation of the Divine Flame Realm, so the competition might last a little longer."

Zhang Fei [5] then opened the map and looked for the disciples of Duan Zhou's three disciples. He found them not far from the residence, and they were making final preparations to face the competition.

"Zhang Fei, can we test your strength?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately turned to Lu Zhong and Ah Hu. "We are not looking down on you, and we are just curious about your true strength. Moreover, your cultivation has broken through several minor stages since Xian Xian last met you, so we want to test it out."

Xian Xian shook her head before speaking to Zhang Fei [5]. "I have warned them not to do so, but they are basically curious people. Therefore, you can show them your strength, but you must hold back, or they'll get injured and can't compete tomorrow."
"Hey! Why are you looking down on us, Xian? The four of us are of equal strength, so we are confident that his attacks will not injure us." Lu Zhong and Ah Hu immediately protested.
"It's up to you two then."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled at the two men's behavior and immediately agreed with them. As soon as they stood face to face, he attacked them, but he did not use his full strength.
*Bam... Bam...*
"Guah!" Lu Zhong and Ah Hu screamed in pain as they rolled on the ground. "It fucking hurts!"
"Hahahaha!" Xian Xian laughed out loud. "I told you two that his attacks are too painful, but you guys are stubborn!"

sentences.text: "What happened?
Why is your expression so serious?" Fei Qinyuan asked her husband.
Shang Huaqiang immediately told his wife about Cheng Gaoji.
"He told me that he had arrived at the Sky Jade Realm yesterday, but I couldn't contact him after that."

"If I remember correctly, Feng Yao's cultivation should still be at the Divine Manifestation Realm, so she shouldn't be able to do anything to Cheng Gaoji." Fei Qinyuan paused and thought about some things.
"The only thing I can think of is that she called someone else from the Phoenix Race to help her after she destroyed our portal, and that person is stronger than him.
If that's true, our plan will fail once again if we move too hastily.
Therefore, we have to send some people to that realm to monitor the situation, and we will order those four people to move if the situation permits."
Shang Huaqiang nodded in agreement.
"I've thought about it, and I've already selected two people to go to that realm.
I'll contact them now, and I'll ask them to leave directly."
"Who are those two people?"
"Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei." Fei Qinyuan was surprised to hear those two names from Shang Huaqiang.
"The Wang and Dai clans have decided to side with us, and I asked them to prove their loyalty to me, so Wang Jinghsan and Dai Guowei sent their sons.
Although they are not their strongest sons, they should be enough to check the situation there, and Feng Yao will never realize that they are our people."
"I hope Feng Yao really won't recognize them." Fei Qinyuan then looked for someone in their clan, but she couldn't find that person.
"Where did Ziyuan go?
I never saw her again after she visited the Ren Clan."
Shang Huaqiang released a soft sigh.
"Since the people she sent still couldn't find Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, Ziyuan decided to go look for them herself.
She suspected that they had gone to the lower realms, so she looked for them there."
"The lower realms?"
"Yes." Shang Huaqiang nodded and explained.
"Shang Baishi is not stupid; Ziyuan is certain that he would not take her daughter to another realm in the middle or upper realms, especially since we can find them more easily.
Therefore, his best choice was to take Shang Xiaoyin to the lower realm, especially since we wouldn't expect the two of them to go there.
Moreover, the lower realms are not as extensive as the middle or upper realms, and she is confident she can find them by herself."
"The lower realms are not as extensive as the middle or upper realms, but I'm sure Ziyuan won't be able to find them by herself.

I think we should send some people to help her, or she will waste a lot of time looking for them, which would slow down our plans." After her husband agreed, Fei Qinyuan contacted several people to help Shang Zhiyuan.
"What about Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei?"
"They will leave today using the best artifacts their clans have."
"That's good." Fei Qinyuan then stood up.
"I will return to my Fei Clan for a few days, and I will prepare them to carry out our other plans."
"All right."
At the Murong Clan, Ai Weiren came to Murong Qianying in her private room.
"Qianying, I still want to stay here, but I have other matters to attend to, so I have to leave now.
However, I will come back here again after my matters are finished, but I don't know how long it will take to finish, so you should think about your own safety."
"You can leave if you have important business, and I have a plan to protect my clan." Murong Qianying then asked.
"Are you bringing Shang Xiaojuan with you?"
"No." Ai Weiren replied with a shake of her head.
"Xiaojuan got information about the Sun Tower from people in the Wasteland Realm, and he left for the Blossom Heaven Realm a week ago.
I've contacted him just now, and he'll likely be there in a few days."
"Oh?" Murong Qianying was surprised to hear that, and she didn't even know about it.
"Did he go there by himself?"
Ai Weiren nodded at her.
"Xiaojuan is too stubborn, and he is eager to meet your second daughter, so he rushed there by himself."
"I see." Murong Qianying nodded in understanding.
"Unfortunately, Xiaojuan was too stupid, and his efforts would only end in vain.
The Sun Tower was not as simple as he thought, and there were many tough challenges in it.
In fact, my second daughter went there with Senior Hun Di, Senior Xia Tian, and the others."
"Oh?" This time, Ai Weiren was surprised because she knew nothing about the Sun Tower.
"Do you know about the challenges in the tower?"
Murong Qianying shook her head in response.
"I only know the outline of the Sun Tower, but I don't have any specific information about the tower, and we suspect that the tower is the key to going to the realms beyond these upper realms.
Therefore, Senior Hun Di and Senior Xia Tian wanted to check it out in person, and they brought some of our younger generation with them, including my niece, son, and second daughter."
"Why don't you join them?"
"Can I leave with my clan's situation like this?" Murong Qianying turned to ask with a soft sigh.
"Honestly, I was curious about the Sun Tower, and I wanted to try facing those challenges.
However, Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan would directly attack my clan if I went there, so I abandoned my wish."
Ai Weiren fell into contemplation for quite a while, but she immediately stood up.
"Hey, I'll use your clan portal to go to the Wasteland Realm."
"Are you thinking of going to the Blossom Heaven Realm?
What about your business?" Murong Qianying asked with a frown.
Ai Weiren raised both hands.
"My business is not more important than the realms beyond these upper realms, so I want to go to the Blossom Heaven Realm to check out that tower."

"You can go to the back because my clan's portal is there." After Ai Weiren left, Murong Qianying immediately gathered her clan members and ordered them to pack up all the valuables in their clan. 'Sigh!
I don't want to do this, but my best option is to move them to the Hong Clan, and we will be safe there.'
Murong Qianying then took out her interspatial communication device and contacted Hong Xinxin, who now lives in the Nine Stars Realm.
She also contacted Cai Yinzhi to inform her of her plans, which she immediately agreed to.
In the bathroom, Hong Xinxin told Zhang Xiaolong [3] about Murong Qianyung's decision to bring her Murong Clan to her Hong Clan.
"Sister Qianying decided it like that because Ai Weiren decided to go to the Blossom Heaven Realm, and she doubted that my two seniors were enough to protect them from Shang Huaqiang."
"Retreating does not mean losing, and we can make a better plan to strike back, so Murong Qianying has made the right decision about that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her.
"Do you want to go back to the Hong Clan now?"
Hong Xinxin nodded at him.
"I think I should go back there, and then I will go straight to the Murong Clan so I can help Sister Qianying directly.
However, it will probably take a few days, so I can't help you to temper your body for the time being, and you can use all the Jiashen Liquid I gave you."
"That's not a problem." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the portal to the Hong Clan.
"Inform me if Murong Qianying wants to see me, and I will bring Lianzhi and the others back to the Azure Sky Realm to avoid arousing her suspicion."

"Anyway, give me some more of your Yang Qi, especially since it's been almost a month since I last gave it to Mai Xiaomeng." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave her a thousand bottles, Hong Xinxin immediately disappeared into the portal.
He then closed his eyes again and continued to absorb the Jianshen Liquid inside the wooden tub.
"As long as the matter with the Shang Clan is not settled, I will never be able to rest easy.
Unfortunately, they are still too strong for me, so I must find other ways to destroy them gradually."
As she had originally planned, Hong Xinxin went straight to Mai Xiaomeng to hand over Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s Yang Qi to her.
After that, she went to the Murong Clan to help Murong Qianying, but the female cat beast decided to go with her.

Although Zhou Xiaochuan's troops were confused by the three men's decision, none of them dared disobey their orders.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately return to the elemental chamber but infiltrated the Zhou Royal Palace.
He found Zhou Xiaochuan in his six wives' bedroom with a gloomy expression, but he did not meet him and went to several places there.
He used his plant generation ability to create several things, leaving them in those places. 'Gradually, that guy will suffer from their effects, and I can deal with him more easily.'

"Old Zhao is my brother, and the blacksmith competition is important to him and his disciples, so I don't want to miss it.
However, I didn't expect that the kid I met more than four months ago has improved so much in several aspects, and you are now the son-in-law of the Xian and Yun Kingdoms.
Furthermore, I have heard from my brother about all your actions in the Bai and Zhou Kingdoms, and I guess you have also done something to the Huangfu Kingdom.
In addition, I heard that you have eliminated all the Alchemy Union branches in the four kingdoms."

The Alchemy Union no longer exists in this realm, and I took over their last shop in the Zhou Kingdom four days ago.
Luo Xuejia, Yi Zuoli, and Pei Yun are my subordinates now.

As for the three kingdoms, I haven't done too much against them, but I've made some plans against them, and I'll execute them all when I'm truly ready." Duan Lingtian nodded in understanding while stroking his beard.
