After they had waited for a few hours, Zhang Fei [5] and the others detected a flying artifact flying towards them quickly. Duan Zhao and the others immediately came out of the residence to greet the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm, who would be their opponents in the competition.

In a few minutes, a luxurious red flying artifact with golden flames painted on both sides landed in front of the residence. An old man and an old woman led eight other men to descend from it, but their expressions were clearly condescending as they looked at Duan Zhao and the others.
'These guys are arrogant pricks!' Zhang Fei [5] inwardly muttered as he observed those people from inside the residence.
[Master, their two leaders most likely came from the upper realms, especially since their cultivation has already reached the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm.]

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement with that. 'Feng Yao once said that there were rarely any cultivators at the Divine Manifestation in the middle realms, and they would ascend to the upper realms after they reached that stage, so these two clearly came from the upper realms.'
"Why didn't the young man inside come out to greet us, Old Duan?" The old woman asked Duan Zhao.
Unlike the old woman, the old man immediately released his aura to suppress Zhang Fei [5] and force him out to meet them. "Come out now! Otherwise—Guah!"
*Bam!*
Before the old man could finish his words, his body was already smashed into the flying artifact. The sudden incident not only shocked the old woman; it also shocked the eight men who came with them.

Duan Zhao and the others could only shake their heads at the scene, especially since they knew the old man's character quite well. Unfortunately, the old man didn't know anything about Zhang Fei [5]'s character and actions, and he was too arrogant to want to suppress him.
"Old Yuan Kong!" The old woman immediately flew to the old man's side and helped him up. "Are you okay?"
"Cough... Cough..." The old man coughed hard as he glared toward the residence. "I'm fine."
"The blacksmith union dares to be this arrogant, huh?"

The old man and the old woman frowned after hearing a woman's question, but their expressions changed to shock once Shang Yumei walked out from inside the residence, hugging Zhang Fei [5]'s arm. 'This woman's cultivation is equal to ours!'

Xian Xian and the others held their breath as they looked at Shang Yumei. They knew that Zhang Fei [5] had many strong people on his side, but they did not expect that there was one who could fight back against Yuan Kong. Unlike them, Duan Zhao and Gang Zhishou had met her and Feng Yao twice, so they were no longer surprised by her sudden appearance.
Shang Yumei unexpectedly moved in front of Yuan Kong and the old woman, shocking them. 'Her speed is incredibly fast!'

Shang Yumei sent the old woman flying to the side before lifting and choking Yuan Kong by the neck. "Do you think I will let you suppress my husband, Old Man? Your blacksmith union is indeed strong, but my Shang Clan from the Red Sun Realm is still stronger than them. Even Ji Changlan wouldn't dare to be arrogant in front of us, yet you dare to pompously suppress my husband."
"Shang... Shang Clan!" Yuan Kong and the old woman were completely shocked to hear that.

The old woman immediately stood up, walked to their side, and cupped her hands to Shang Yumei. "Young Miss Shang, Old Yuan was indeed rash, but he did not cause any harm to your husband, so I beg you to let him go."
"Why don't you beg my husband? If he wants to spare this old man, I will let him go. If he doesn't agree, I will kill him right here and now." Shang Yumei indifferently spoke.

The old woman turned to Zhang Fei [5], but he spoke first. "Usually, I will never spare anyone who dares to pressure me, but your arrival in this realm is important to Senior Duan and the others. Therefore, I will spare this old man once, but I will not spare him just like that, and he must accept a little punishment from me. If any of you object to it, this realm will become a grave for all of you."

"Aren't you going too far, Young Master?" The old woman frowned as she posed this question. "We are afraid of the Shang Clan, but we can still kill you two right now, and we will meet them to take responsibility for it after we return."
"Are you sure about that, old woman?"

As soon as Zhang Fei [5] released his killing intent, the old woman staggered backward, and her body trembled tremendously. Even Yuan Kong and the other eight men looked so shocked when they sensed his killing intent.
'This kid! His killing intent is too suffocating, even though he didn't use it on us!' Ah Hu and the others screamed in their hearts as they wiped their sweat.
"Do you still think I need to rely on others to finish all of you off?" Zhang Fei [5] suddenly received a long-distance message.

Yuan Kong's and the old woman's eyes widened when Zhang Fei [5] opened a gate, and the two of them grew even more frightened once Hong Xinxin and Mai Xiaomeng walked out of it. After all, their cultivation was several major stages above them, which greatly shocked them.
Zhang Fei [5] frowned when he saw Mai Xiaomeng. "Why did you bring her here, Xinxin? Is Murong Qianying's business finished?"

Mai Xiaomeng's lips curled upwards hearing that, but she did not immediately respond to Zhang Fei [5]. Instead, she paid attention to the people from the blacksmith union, especially Yuan Kong, who was still in Shang Yumei's grip. 'These idiots! They don't know with whom they're dealing!'

"I didn't want to bring Xiaomeng to this realm, but she insisted on coming with me because she wanted to meet you. Sister Qianying and her Murong Clan have moved not far from my Hong Clan, and they are arranging their new residence now." Yuan Kong and the old woman were even more frightened when they heard the two clans from Hong Xinxin's mouth, and they tensed up when she looked at them. "Hmm? You two are Ji Changlan's subordinates, right? I didn't expect old people like you two to be so stupid and idiotic! You guys even dare to pressure and threaten my future husband! Even Old Ji wouldn't dare say anything to us if you all die here today."
*Thud!*
The old woman fell to her knees and begged Hong Xinxin directly. "Please forgive us, Young Miss Hong. We... we didn't know that this young man was your future husband."

"Even if he wasn't my future husband, do you think you two can be arrogant and oppress the younger generation? You guys are senior cultivators, and you are already so old, but your behavior is so embarrassing." Hong Xinxin scolded the old woman instead, and she then spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "You can kill them if you want, and I will take care of the higher-ups of the blacksmith union later."
The faces of the old woman, Yuan Kong, and the eight men turned deathly pale as soon as Hong Xinxin said that.

"Old Duan and the others still have to compete with them, and they haven't done anything excessive to me, so I won't kill them." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Shang Yumei, who immediately brought Yuan Kong before him. "However, I still want to teach this foolish old man a little lesson, and I hope he won't dare to be arrogant again in the future."
*Vomit*
"Guah!" As Zhang Fei [5] punched his abdomen, Yuan Kong screamed in pain and bent forward, spitting out a large amount of blood from his mouth. "Cough... Cough..."

Not only was the old woman relieved that Zhang Fei [5] did not kill them, but Duan Zhao was also relieved with his decision, especially since it would affect their reputation in the blacksmith union if they died in their realm.

"This is just a small lesson from me, Old Man. You should remember this pain for the rest of your life and stop being arrogant, or I will really kill you the next time we meet." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Duan Zhao. "Senior Duan, let them rest first, and I will come back tomorrow."
"All right, we will wait for you tomorrow." Duan Zhao replied with a nod.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] brought Hong Xinxin, Shang Yumei, and Mai Xiaomeng to leave the place, relieving the old woman and the others.

"You guys can take them to rest." Gang Zhishou and the other three immediately followed their master's orders and led the eight men to their rooms, but they were still frightened by Zhang Fei [5]'s actions just now. Duan Zhao then spoke to the two. "Old Yuan! Old Li Yanzhi! You two are really lucky that he didn't kill you. He's still young, but he's far more terrifying than all the senior cultivators, and he's far crueler than you can imagine."

Li Yanzhi helped Yuan Kong to his feet as she asked. "Who exactly is that young man, Old Duan? How could he have relations with the big clans of the upper realms? The Shang, Murong, and Hong clans are powerful, and they have quite a large influence in the upper realms."

"To be honest, I have no knowledge of Zhang Fei [5]'s true origins, and all I know is that he came from another realm." Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong looked distrustful of Duan Zhao. "He arrived in this realm more than four months ago, and he met one of my disciples to buy forging materials. He had interest and talent in blacksmithing, so my disciple taught him to forge weapons. He had only been a blacksmith for less than three months, but he had already succeeded in forging a spirit-grade weapon perfectly, and he had begun to learn to forge an earth-grade weapon."
"Are you kidding me? How could he do it so fast?" Li Yanzhi inquired with a look of incredulity.

Duan Zhao shook his head at her. "Do I need to lie to you? At first, I never suspected this, but I suspected that he had a relationship with a blacksmith from the upper realms, especially after I learned about his relationship with the people there."

"Since he had a relationship with the three powerful clans of the Red Sun Realm, I think he might also have a relationship with the Tie Clan, especially since they are one of the best blacksmith clans in the upper realms." Yuan Kong said with a gloomy expression, as he still did not expect that he would meet a terrifying young man.
Li Yanzhi turned to her friend in surprise. "Are you sure about that?"

"Yes." Yuan Kong nodded in response. "Tie Gong and his Tie Clan also live in the Red Sun Realm, so I think like that. They are the fifth rank among all blacksmith clans in the upper realms, and only the Xiong, Guan, Ou, and Jiao clans can beat them at blacksmithing."

"If you two still doubt me, you can witness his forging skills for yourself tomorrow, and you will surely understand the difference between him and the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realms." Duan Zhao then led the two to rest, especially since the incident just now was too stressful for everyone.
Elsewhere, Zhang Fei [5] directly asked Mai Xiaomeng. "Why do you want to see me?"

"Hehe." Mai Xiaomeng chuckled and walked around Zhang Fei [5] as her fingers traced his body, causing him to frown. "I have two interesting pieces of information about the Shang Clan, and you will be interested in hearing them. However, I will not give them away for free, and you must give me something in return."
Zhang Fei [5] used a bit of his aura to push Mai Xiaomeng back. "You can tell me everything first, and I will give you something in return if they are useful to me."

"First, Shang Ziyuan was on her way to the lower realms to look for Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, and she left there a month ago." Zhang Fei [5] was a little surprised to hear that from Mai Xiaomeng. He himself did not know the two people's destination after they left the Wasteland Realm, but he did not expect that they would go to the lower realms. "Second, Shang Huaqiang suspected that Princess Feng Yao kidnapped Cheng Gaoji, and he decided to send Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei to the Sky Jade Realm to check on the situation. Since the two of them were not members of the Shang Clan, he thought that she wouldn't know their identities. Do you think these two pieces of information are useful to you?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before speaking. "To be honest, I've already taken action against Shang Xiaoyin and Shang Baishi, forcing them to flee from the Wasteland Realm. If I want, I can kill them whenever I want, so your information about them is useless to me."
Mai Xiaomeng was surprised to hear that. "What did you do to them?"

"I initiated the relationship between them, and Shang Xiaoyin should be pregnant with Shang Baishi's child now." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer caused Mai Xiaomeng's jaw to drop, but he then gave her two bottles of pills. "Even so, it's still of little use to me, especially regarding Shang Ziyuan. The second piece of information is useful to me, so I can ask Feng Jinqiu to capture Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei once they arrive in the Sky Jade Realm, and I can formulate a new plan against Shang Huaqiang by using them."
"Feng Jinqiu?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Mai Xiaomeng. "Feng Yao is in seclusion in this realm now, and Feng Jinqiu is taking her place to protect the Sky Jade Realm. Currently, Cheng Gaoji is in her hands, and she is locking him up somewhere in that realm."
"Oh." Mai Xiaomeng then opened both bottles of pills before looking at him in shock. "Are you the one who concocted these pills?"
"Isn't that obvious?" Zhang Fei [5] then opened the portal. "You should return to the Red Sun Realm now, or your presence will make the people in this realm restless."
Mai Xiaomeng pouted her lips as she closed the bottles, but she did not argue with Zhang Fei [5] and directly entered the gate.
"I will also return to my clan, or Sister Qianying will be suspicious if she can't find me there." After she said that, Hong Xinxin followed Mai Xiaomeng and disappeared into the gate.

After Zhang Fei [5] had closed the gate, Shang Yumei questioned him. "What are your plans for Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei? They are the second and third young masters of the Wang and Dai clans, which support Shang Huaqiang, but those two brats are useless to you."

"Whether they are useful or not, we will see later, and I will ask Feng Jinqiu to capture them first." Zhang Fei [5] then contacted the ice phoenix using an interspatial communication device, informing her about Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei. "If they are not useful directly, I can make them useful indirectly, and Shang Huaqiang will definitely suffer because of it."

Seeing the evil smile on Zhang Fei [5]'s face, Shang Yumei could already guess that he had planned something truly evil against Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei. "Send me back to the training space, and I will start training at the level three gravity feature."
"All right." After he sent Shang Yumei into the training space, Zhang Fei [5] immediately went somewhere else.

sentences.text: [Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
After they had waited for a few hours, Zhang Fei [5] and the others detected a flying artifact flying towards them quickly.
Duan Zhao and the others immediately came out of the residence to greet the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm, who would be their opponents in the competition.
In a few minutes, a luxurious red flying artifact with golden flames painted on both sides landed in front of the residence.
An old man and an old woman led eight other men to descend from it, but their expressions were clearly condescending as they looked at Duan Zhao and the others.
'These guys are arrogant pricks!' Zhang Fei [5] inwardly muttered as he observed those people from inside the residence.
[Master, their two leaders most likely came from the upper realms, especially since their cultivation has already reached the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm.]

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement with that. 'Feng Yao once said that there were rarely any cultivators at the Divine Manifestation in the middle realms, and they would ascend to the upper realms after they reached that stage, so these two clearly came from the upper realms.'
"Why didn't the young man inside come out to greet us, Old Duan?" The old woman asked Duan Zhao.
Unlike the old woman, the old man immediately released his aura to suppress Zhang Fei [5] and force him out to meet them.
"Come out now!
Otherwise—Guah!"
*Bam!*
Before the old man could finish his words, his body was already smashed into the flying artifact.
The sudden incident not only shocked the old woman; it also shocked the eight men who came with them.
Duan Zhao and the others could only shake their heads at the scene, especially since they knew the old man's character quite well.
Unfortunately, the old man didn't know anything about Zhang Fei [5]'s character and actions, and he was too arrogant to want to suppress him.
"Old Yuan Kong!" The old woman immediately flew to the old man's side and helped him up.
"Are you okay?"
"Cough...
Cough..." The old man coughed hard as he glared toward the residence.
"I'm fine."
"The blacksmith union dares to be this arrogant, huh?"

The old man and the old woman frowned after hearing a woman's question, but their expressions changed to shock once Shang Yumei walked out from inside the residence, hugging Zhang Fei [5]'s arm. 'This woman's cultivation is equal to ours!'
Xian Xian and the others held their breath as they looked at Shang Yumei.
They knew that Zhang Fei [5] had many strong people on his side, but they did not expect that there was one who could fight back against Yuan Kong.
Unlike them, Duan Zhao and Gang Zhishou had met her and Feng Yao twice, so they were no longer surprised by her sudden appearance.
Shang Yumei unexpectedly moved in front of Yuan Kong and the old woman, shocking them. 'Her speed is incredibly fast!'
Shang Yumei sent the old woman flying to the side before lifting and choking Yuan Kong by the neck.
"Do you think I will let you suppress my husband, Old Man?
Your blacksmith union is indeed strong, but my Shang Clan from the Red Sun Realm is still stronger than them.
Even Ji Changlan wouldn't dare to be arrogant in front of us, yet you dare to pompously suppress my husband."
"Shang...
Shang Clan!" Yuan Kong and the old woman were completely shocked to hear that.
The old woman immediately stood up, walked to their side, and cupped her hands to Shang Yumei.
"Young Miss Shang, Old Yuan was indeed rash, but he did not cause any harm to your husband, so I beg you to let him go."
"Why don't you beg my husband?
If he wants to spare this old man, I will let him go.
If he doesn't agree, I will kill him right here and now." Shang Yumei indifferently spoke.
The old woman turned to Zhang Fei [5], but he spoke first.
"Usually, I will never spare anyone who dares to pressure me, but your arrival in this realm is important to Senior Duan and the others.
Therefore, I will spare this old man once, but I will not spare him just like that, and he must accept a little punishment from me.
If any of you object to it, this realm will become a grave for all of you."
"Aren't you going too far, Young Master?" The old woman frowned as she posed this question.
"We are afraid of the Shang Clan, but we can still kill you two right now, and we will meet them to take responsibility for it after we return."
"Are you sure about that, old woman?"
As soon as Zhang Fei [5] released his killing intent, the old woman staggered backward, and her body trembled tremendously.
Even Yuan Kong and the other eight men looked so shocked when they sensed his killing intent.
'This kid!
His killing intent is too suffocating, even though he didn't use it on us!' Ah Hu and the others screamed in their hearts as they wiped their sweat.
"Do you still think I need to rely on others to finish all of you off?" Zhang Fei [5] suddenly received a long-distance message.
Yuan Kong's and the old woman's eyes widened when Zhang Fei [5] opened a gate, and the two of them grew even more frightened once Hong Xinxin and Mai Xiaomeng walked out of it.
After all, their cultivation was several major stages above them, which greatly shocked them.
Zhang Fei [5] frowned when he saw Mai Xiaomeng.
"Why did you bring her here, Xinxin?
Is Murong Qianying's business finished?"
Mai Xiaomeng's lips curled upwards hearing that, but she did not immediately respond to Zhang Fei [5].
Instead, she paid attention to the people from the blacksmith union, especially Yuan Kong, who was still in Shang Yumei's grip. 'These idiots!
They don't know with whom they're dealing!'
"I didn't want to bring Xiaomeng to this realm, but she insisted on coming with me because she wanted to meet you.

Sister Qianying and her Murong Clan have moved not far from my Hong Clan, and they are arranging their new residence now." Yuan Kong and the old woman were even more frightened when they heard the two clans from Hong Xinxin's mouth, and they tensed up when she looked at them.
"Hmm?
You two are Ji Changlan's subordinates, right?
I didn't expect old people like you two to be so stupid and idiotic!
You guys even dare to pressure and threaten my future husband!
Even Old Ji wouldn't dare say anything to us if you all die here today."
*Thud!*
The old woman fell to her knees and begged Hong Xinxin directly.
"Please forgive us, Young Miss Hong.
We... we didn't know that this young man was your future husband."
"Even if he wasn't my future husband, do you think you two can be arrogant and oppress the younger generation?
You guys are senior cultivators, and you are already so old, but your behavior is so embarrassing." Hong Xinxin scolded the old woman instead, and she then spoke to Zhang Fei [5].
"You can kill them if you want, and I will take care of the higher-ups of the blacksmith union later."
The faces of the old woman, Yuan Kong, and the eight men turned deathly pale as soon as Hong Xinxin said that.

"Old Duan and the others still have to compete with them, and they haven't done anything excessive to me, so I won't kill them." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Shang Yumei, who immediately brought Yuan Kong before him.
"However, I still want to teach this foolish old man a little lesson, and I hope he won't dare to be arrogant again in the future."
*Vomit*
"Guah!" As Zhang Fei [5] punched his abdomen, Yuan Kong screamed in pain and bent forward, spitting out a large amount of blood from his mouth.
"Cough...
Cough..."

Not only was the old woman relieved that Zhang Fei [5] did not kill them, but Duan Zhao was also relieved with his decision, especially since it would affect their reputation in the blacksmith union if they died in their realm.
"This is just a small lesson from me, Old Man.
You should remember this pain for the rest of your life and stop being arrogant, or I will really kill you the next time we meet." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Duan Zhao.
"Senior Duan, let them rest first, and I will come back tomorrow."
"All right, we will wait for you tomorrow." Duan Zhao replied with a nod.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] brought Hong Xinxin, Shang Yumei, and Mai Xiaomeng to leave the place, relieving the old woman and the others.

"You guys can take them to rest." Gang Zhishou and the other three immediately followed their master's orders and led the eight men to their rooms, but they were still frightened by Zhang Fei [5]'s actions just now.
Duan Zhao then spoke to the two.
"Old Yuan!
Old Li Yanzhi!
You two are really lucky that he didn't kill you.
He's still young, but he's far more terrifying than all the senior cultivators, and he's far crueler than you can imagine."
Li Yanzhi helped Yuan Kong to his feet as she asked.
"Who exactly is that young man, Old Duan?
How could he have relations with the big clans of the upper realms?
The Shang, Murong, and Hong clans are powerful, and they have quite a large influence in the upper realms."
"To be honest, I have no knowledge of Zhang Fei [5]'s true origins, and all I know is that he came from another realm." Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong looked distrustful of Duan Zhao.
"He arrived in this realm more than four months ago, and he met one of my disciples to buy forging materials.
He had interest and talent in blacksmithing, so my disciple taught him to forge weapons.
He had only been a blacksmith for less than three months, but he had already succeeded in forging a spirit-grade weapon perfectly, and he had begun to learn to forge an earth-grade weapon."
"Are you kidding me?
How could he do it so fast?" Li Yanzhi inquired with a look of incredulity.
Duan Zhao shook his head at her.
"Do I need to lie to you?
At first, I never suspected this, but I suspected that he had a relationship with a blacksmith from the upper realms, especially after I learned about his relationship with the people there."

"Since he had a relationship with the three powerful clans of the Red Sun Realm, I think he might also have a relationship with the Tie Clan, especially since they are one of the best blacksmith clans in the upper realms." Yuan Kong said with a gloomy expression, as he still did not expect that he would meet a terrifying young man.
Li Yanzhi turned to her friend in surprise.
"Are you sure about that?"
"Yes." Yuan Kong nodded in response.
"Tie Gong and his Tie Clan also live in the Red Sun Realm, so I think like that.
They are the fifth rank among all blacksmith clans in the upper realms, and only the Xiong, Guan, Ou, and Jiao clans can beat them at blacksmithing."

"If you two still doubt me, you can witness his forging skills for yourself tomorrow, and you will surely understand the difference between him and the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realms." Duan Zhao then led the two to rest, especially since the incident just now was too stressful for everyone.
Elsewhere, Zhang Fei [5] directly asked Mai Xiaomeng.
"Why do you want to see me?"
"Hehe." Mai Xiaomeng chuckled and walked around Zhang Fei [5] as her fingers traced his body, causing him to frown.
"I have two interesting pieces of information about the Shang Clan, and you will be interested in hearing them.
However, I will not give them away for free, and you must give me something in return."
Zhang Fei [5] used a bit of his aura to push Mai Xiaomeng back.
"You can tell me everything first, and I will give you something in return if they are useful to me."

"First, Shang Ziyuan was on her way to the lower realms to look for Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, and she left there a month ago." Zhang Fei [5] was a little surprised to hear that from Mai Xiaomeng.
He himself did not know the two people's destination after they left the Wasteland Realm, but he did not expect that they would go to the lower realms.
"Second, Shang Huaqiang suspected that Princess Feng Yao kidnapped Cheng Gaoji, and he decided to send Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei to the Sky Jade Realm to check on the situation.
Since the two of them were not members of the Shang Clan, he thought that she wouldn't know their identities.
Do you think these two pieces of information are useful to you?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before speaking.
"To be honest, I've already taken action against Shang Xiaoyin and Shang Baishi, forcing them to flee from the Wasteland Realm.
If I want, I can kill them whenever I want, so your information about them is useless to me."
Mai Xiaomeng was surprised to hear that.
"What did you do to them?"

"I initiated the relationship between them, and Shang Xiaoyin should be pregnant with Shang Baishi's child now." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer caused Mai Xiaomeng's jaw to drop, but he then gave her two bottles of pills.
"Even so, it's still of little use to me, especially regarding Shang Ziyuan.

The second piece of information is useful to me, so I can ask Feng Jinqiu to capture Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei once they arrive in the Sky Jade Realm, and I can formulate a new plan against Shang Huaqiang by using them."
"Feng Jinqiu?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Mai Xiaomeng.
"Feng Yao is in seclusion in this realm now, and Feng Jinqiu is taking her place to protect the Sky Jade Realm.
Currently, Cheng Gaoji is in her hands, and she is locking him up somewhere in that realm."
"Oh." Mai Xiaomeng then opened both bottles of pills before looking at him in shock.
"Are you the one who concocted these pills?"
"Isn't that obvious?" Zhang Fei [5] then opened the portal.
"You should return to the Red Sun Realm now, or your presence will make the people in this realm restless."
Mai Xiaomeng pouted her lips as she closed the bottles, but she did not argue with Zhang Fei [5] and directly entered the gate.
"I will also return to my clan, or Sister Qianying will be suspicious if she can't find me there." After she said that, Hong Xinxin followed Mai Xiaomeng and disappeared into the gate.
After Zhang Fei [5] had closed the gate, Shang Yumei questioned him.
"What are your plans for Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei?
They are the second and third young masters of the Wang and Dai clans, which support Shang Huaqiang, but those two brats are useless to you."

"Whether they are useful or not, we will see later, and I will ask Feng Jinqiu to capture them first." Zhang Fei [5] then contacted the ice phoenix using an interspatial communication device, informing her about Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei.
"If they are not useful directly, I can make them useful indirectly, and Shang Huaqiang will definitely suffer because of it."
Seeing the evil smile on Zhang Fei [5]'s face, Shang Yumei could already guess that he had planned something truly evil against Wang Xinlei and Dai Ziwei.
"Send me back to the training space, and I will start training at the level three gravity feature."
"All right." After he sent Shang Yumei into the training space, Zhang Fei [5] immediately went somewhere else.

chapters.title: Chapter 740: Threat And Rob
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] was already inside Zhou Xiaochuan's royal chamber. He was satisfied when he found the Zhou Emperor lying limply on his bed. 'The Frozen Vein Grass is truly efficacious, and this guy has already been affected by its effects in just three days. This way, he won't be able to do anything to take care of his kingdom or anything else, especially since his meridians have been blocked by its effects, and he has difficulty moving his body.'
Zhang Fei [5] immediately left Zhou Xiaochuan's room before summoning Zhou Shenxin out of the training space. "Why did you bring me here? What if my father finds out about our presence?"

"Why don't you try checking your father's room?" Zhou Shenxin briefly raised an eyebrow before doing so, but then she looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion. "I used the Frozen Vein Grass on your father, so his condition is like that now. Unfortunately, it will only work for a month, and his condition will recover, so I must replace it next month."
"Why don't we deal with my father now?" Zhou Shenxin asked him. "With his current condition, you can easily do something to him, right?"

Zhang Fei [5] smiled at that. "Do you want him to fall that quickly? He made you suffer for decades, so I want him to suffer first before we take him down, and our plan will be even more devastating for him. At that time, he will surely languish half to death once he learns that his kingdom and the people around him are under our control, and he will fall even deeper when I push you to the throne and become the empress."
"You're too cruel and evil, you know?" Zhou Shenxin said with a low sigh. "What are we going to do here now?"

"Naturally, we'll go to the treasure room, and we'll steal everything." Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought Zhou Shenxin into the invisible state. In a few minutes, they were there. "Oh? Your father is so confident that no one will infiltrate here, he didn't even set up any formations in this place."
Zhou Shenxin shook her head in response. "You are the first cultivator who dares to sneak into this palace in hundreds of years."
"All these treasures are yours, so you can go in now and clean them all up."
"Is there anything you want among all these treasures?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] pushed Zhou Shenxin inside. "You will become empress soon, so you will need them to strengthen and advance your kingdom. Moreover, coins are useless in other realms, so I don't really need them. My pills and treasures are also much better than what's available here, so you can keep everything for yourself."
"All right."
Given the abundance of treasures, Zhou Shenxin spent several hours cleaning them up. Zhang Fei [5] also gave her several storage rings to store them, especially since each ring had a small limit.

After Zhou Shenxin collected all the treasures, Zhang Fei [5] immediately sent her back into the training space. He himself did not immediately leave the Zhou Kingdom and went to Zhou Xiaochuan's six wives' room instead.

Zhang Fei [5] did not do anything bad to Dong Feiling and the others. Instead, he forced them to swallow recovery pills and some other pills because he never wanted them to die, and he only wanted to use them to distract Zhou Xiaochuan.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly left the Zhou Kingdom and went to the Huangfu Kingdom. He found Huangfu Shou busy with the fake Ruo Yanxi and his other concubines, but Helian Yueyi was not with them.
Zhang Fei [5] found Helian Yueyi was sleeping in her room, so he went there and snuck onto her bed. However, his actions woke and shocked her.
"What—" Zhang Fei [5] immediately sealed Helian Yueyi's lips and kissed her for a few seconds. "You bastard! Why did you come here again?"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "I came here because you missed me."
"I never missed you! Get out of my bed now!" Helian Yueyi shouted while pointing forward.

Zhang Fei [5] naturally didn't listen to Helian Yueyi and lay on his side with both hands as a pillow, which made her angry. "If you didn't miss me, why didn't you stop me every time I kissed you? You knew deep down that you had been tempted by me ever since you peeked at me in that inn, and you even masturbated while imagining me fucking you, remember? Besides, you also wanted me to accompany you at the bar, but I refused because your attitude was annoying."

Helian Yueyi became extremely embarrassed every time Zhang Fei [5] mentioned the events of that night. She chose not to discuss the matter and asked something else. "What is your real purpose here? Are you deliberately seducing me because you want to use me to bring down my family?"
"Why do you think like that?"
"Answer me!"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] lay sideways, facing Helian Yueyi. "I did want to destroy your family because your husband sent Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian to attack my son, but he was lucky because Feng Yao and Xian Changyue protected him. After that, your husband sent Ling Baozi to capture him, but that old man also failed in his task, and he returned empty-handed."

Zhang Fei [5]'s answer filled Helian Yueyi's heart with fear. She had suspected that she had known all of her husband's actions, and his answers had proven her fears. "What can I do to keep you from destroying my family?"

"Nothing." ZhangFei [5] pointed his finger at her chest. "If you think you can use your body to stop me from destroying your family, then you have thought wrong about me. As I have told you in our previous meetings, you will never be able to resist my temptations if I intend to have you as my woman. Like you, my family is the most important part of my life, and I will never spare anyone who has evil intentions toward them, let alone if those people have attacked them like your husband. However, I have many other matters on hand right now, so I haven't made a move on you guys yet. Once all my matters are settled, you guys will be my next targets, and you won't be able to stop me even if Li Tiannan and the people from the Huangfu Clan help you."
"You—"

"The only thing you can do now is leave this realm before my other business is finished, but that won't save you from me and will only delay your destruction." Helian Yueyi frowned at Zhang Fei [5]. "Believe it or not, I've marked all of you with something, and I can find you wherever you go to hide, so you'll never be able to hide from me."
Helian Yueyi immediately sat up, glared at him, and asked in a high tone. "Why? Why are you so cruel? Nothing happened to your son, so you don't need to destroy my family, right?"

"Aren't you narrow-minded? What would have happened to my son if he didn't have some protectors by his side? He would have fallen into your hands and become your slave." Helian Yueyi opened her mouth without being able to answer Zhang Fei [5]. "If you want to blame someone, then you should blame yourself and your husband. My son didn't know or have any issues with you before, and all he wanted was to live a peaceful life with all his wives in this realm. Unfortunately, you guys were too arrogant, as no one dared to go against you all in this realm before, and you sent people to capture my son; even your husband thought of using the Gu Insect to control him. Do you think people like you deserve forgiveness?"
Helian Yueyi's expression became even more filled with fear after Zhang Fei mentioned the Gu Insect, especially since no one in the Nine Stars Realm knew about it, except for her family members.

"Are you surprised that I know about the Gu Insect?" Zhang Fei [5] then jumped down from the bed. "If you don't want your children to die with your husband, then you can kill Huangfu Shou for me. If you can do that, I will never touch you or your children, and all of you can continue to live peacefully in this realm."

After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately disappeared from the place, leaving Helian Yueyi in shock and horror. She bit her thumb as she recalled all their conversations, and the image of her family's destruction caused her to shake uncontrollably.

Naturally, Helian Yueyi didn't want to die, and she didn't want her children to die, but she also couldn't possibly kill her husband. "Shit! Is there anything I can do to stop that guy from destroying my family? Should I discuss this matter with my husband? Only my husband's ancestors can save us from that evil guy, but I'm sure he's monitoring us from afar, and he will slaughter us outright before they can arrive in this realm."

'You're right; I'm always monitoring all of you, and you guys will die before the people from the Huangfu Clan arrive in this realm.' Hearing that, Helian Yueyi looked around her room and used her senses to search for Zhang Fei [5], but she could not detect his presence in her room. 'I have given you one last way to save yourself and your children, so the decision is in your hands, and you better think things through before making any detrimental decisions.'

'That bastard! He keeps threatening me!' Helian Yueyi lay back on her bed and covered her face with her hands, thinking about the best solution to save herself and her children. 'Do I really have to kill my husband to save myself? If I kill him, Senior Tiannan and the people from the Huangfu Clan who will arrive soon will definitely find out, and they will definitely kill me.'
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] was already inside Huang Lian's room, but only Ling Baozi joined them because Huangfu Shou had assigned Huangfu Ziyuan to something else.

"Master, I have already used Du She's Silent Veins Poison on all the important generals, and they can't move their bodies now." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow at Ling Baozi, especially since he had never asked the old man to do that. "I thought it might help you smooth your plans against Huangfu Shou, so I decided to do it."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I think that's good, so Huangfu Shou won't be able to wage a war with any kingdom. However, Li Tiannan and someone from the Huangfu Clan will arrive in this realm in less than two weeks, and they will probably find out there is poison in their body. Therefore, you can ask Du She for an antidote, and you have to cure them before those two people arrive, or my plan will be ruined if they find out."
"Yes, Master." Ling Baozi then asked him. "Master, can you provide an antidote for my clan members? I am your slave, and they will never disobey me, so please stop torturing them."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out a bottle and threw it to Ling Baozi. "You can use it to cure them, but I want you to replace your clan leader. I want Pu Niu, who is disguised as Ling Long, to lead your clan."
"I'll arrange it right now, Master." Ling Baozi immediately left the room and rushed back to his Ling Clan.
"What do you want me to do, Master?" Huangfu Lian asked the question as soon as Zhang Fei [5] looked at him.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled faintly and gave Huangfu Lian some instructions, causing his eyes to widen in shock. "Are you incapable of doing such simple things? If you can't do them, you don't deserve to be my slave. I will seal your cultivation and feed you to those ferocious beasts, and they will eat you alive."
'He's too evil!' Huangfu Lian screamed in his heart. "I can do anything! I will carry out your orders as soon as possible, master."

"That's good." Zhang Fei [5] then threw a pill bottle at Huangfu Lian. "If you have the opportunity, you can use the pills inside on Li Tiannan and the person from the Huangfu Clan. However, you don't need to force yourself because the two of them are too strong for you, and I still need you for my next plans against your father."

Once Zhang Fei [5] vanished, Huangfu Lian exhaled with a sense of relief. He then looked at the pill bottle and thought of a way to use it, but he was really afraid that the two people would realize his actions, and he would die in their hands if that happened. "Since he didn't force me to use the pills on them, I'll think about that later. The problem is how I should carry out his previous orders, especially since my father will be aware of my actions, and he will beat me if I do it."

After leaving the Huangfu Kingdom, Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the training space, took out all the forging equipment, and began attempting to forge an earth-grade weapon using the materials Tie Xuan had given him before he left for the Blossom Heaven Realm.

In her residence, Mai Xiaomeng smiled in satisfaction after she swallowed the six pills Zhang Fei [5] gave her. Not only did her body become stronger, but her cultivation foundation also became stronger. In addition, the Yin Qi within her body became purer and richer, which will accelerate her cultivation. "Not only is his Yang Qi powerful, but he also has incredibly potent pills. If I can get his pills for my race members, they will become even stronger, and those people will not be able to bully us anymore. Unfortunately, he wasn't tempted by my beauty and sexiness, so I had to think of another way to get him."
Crack.

"Big Sis." Mai Xiaomeng looked at Mai Yuzhen, who had just walked in. "Our members in the western region just contacted me and told me that Xi Hongyan has come out of her seclusion, and she is furious because she can't find us in our old residence."
"Does Xi Hongyan know that we have moved to this region?"

Mai Yuzhen replied with a shake of her head. "For the time being, Xi Hongyan doesn't know about our move to this region, but I'm sure she will know about it sooner or later, and she might come here to attack us."

Mai Xiaomeng nodded in understanding and got off the bed. "Order all our remaining members in the western region to retreat immediately, and they must do it quietly so as not to attract Xi Hongyan's attention. I will go to the Hong Clan again to meet Hong Quan and the others, especially since we can't face that mad woman ourselves.
"Yes, Big Sis."
"Why did you suddenly come back here, Mai Xiaomeng?" Cai Yinzhi asked the female cat as soon as she arrived. "If you have business with Xin'er, you can go to the Murong Clan's new residence."

Mai Xiaomeng immediately sat down in front of her. "Grandma Yinzhi, I came here to talk to Grandpa Quan. Xi Hongyan has come out of her seclusion, and she's starting to look for us now. If she finds out that we're in this region, she'll definitely lead people from her Xi Clan to hunt us down. We can't face them, so we need this clan's help to face them."
Cai Yinzhi nodded in understanding. "Let's go; I will take you to meet my husband, and you can discuss this matter with him."

"You're too cruel and evil, you know?" Zhou Shenxin said with a low sigh.
"What are we going to do here now?"
"Naturally, we'll go to the treasure room, and we'll steal everything." Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought Zhou Shenxin into the invisible state.
In a few minutes, they were there.
"Oh?
Your father is so confident that no one will infiltrate here, he didn't even set up any formations in this place."
Zhou Shenxin shook her head in response.
"You are the first cultivator who dares to sneak into this palace in hundreds of years."
"All these treasures are yours, so you can go in now and clean them all up."
"Is there anything you want among all these treasures?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] pushed Zhou Shenxin inside.
"You will become empress soon, so you will need them to strengthen and advance your kingdom.
Moreover, coins are useless in other realms, so I don't really need them.
My pills and treasures are also much better than what's available here, so you can keep everything for yourself."
"All right."
Given the abundance of treasures, Zhou Shenxin spent several hours cleaning them up.
Zhang Fei [5] also gave her several storage rings to store them, especially since each ring had a small limit.
After Zhou Shenxin collected all the treasures, Zhang Fei [5] immediately sent her back into the training space.
He himself did not immediately leave the Zhou Kingdom and went to Zhou Xiaochuan's six wives' room instead.
Zhang Fei [5] did not do anything bad to Dong Feiling and the others.
Instead, he forced them to swallow recovery pills and some other pills because he never wanted them to die, and he only wanted to use them to distract Zhou Xiaochuan.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly left the Zhou Kingdom and went to the Huangfu Kingdom.
He found Huangfu Shou busy with the fake Ruo Yanxi and his other concubines, but Helian Yueyi was not with them.
Zhang Fei [5] found Helian Yueyi was sleeping in her room, so he went there and snuck onto her bed.
However, his actions woke and shocked her.
"What—" Zhang Fei [5] immediately sealed Helian Yueyi's lips and kissed her for a few seconds.
"You bastard!
Why did you come here again?"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled.
"I came here because you missed me."
"I never missed you!
Get out of my bed now!" Helian Yueyi shouted while pointing forward.
Zhang Fei [5] naturally didn't listen to Helian Yueyi and lay on his side with both hands as a pillow, which made her angry.
"If you didn't miss me, why didn't you stop me every time I kissed you?
You knew deep down that you had been tempted by me ever since you peeked at me in that inn, and you even masturbated while imagining me fucking you, remember?
Besides, you also wanted me to accompany you at the bar, but I refused because your attitude was annoying."
Helian Yueyi became extremely embarrassed every time Zhang Fei [5] mentioned the events of that night.
She chose not to discuss the matter and asked something else.
"What is your real purpose here?
Are you deliberately seducing me because you want to use me to bring down my family?"
"Why do you think like that?"
"Answer me!"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] lay sideways, facing Helian Yueyi.
"I did want to destroy your family because your husband sent Huangfu Ziyuan and Huangfu Lian to attack my son, but he was lucky because Feng Yao and Xian Changyue protected him.
After that, your husband sent Ling Baozi to capture him, but that old man also failed in his task, and he returned empty-handed."
Zhang Fei [5]'s answer filled Helian Yueyi's heart with fear.
She had suspected that she had known all of her husband's actions, and his answers had proven her fears.
"What can I do to keep you from destroying my family?"
"Nothing." ZhangFei [5] pointed his finger at her chest.
"If you think you can use your body to stop me from destroying your family, then you have thought wrong about me.
As I have told you in our previous meetings, you will never be able to resist my temptations if I intend to have you as my woman.
Like you, my family is the most important part of my life, and I will never spare anyone who has evil intentions toward them, let alone if those people have attacked them like your husband.
However, I have many other matters on hand right now, so I haven't made a move on you guys yet.
Once all my matters are settled, you guys will be my next targets, and you won't be able to stop me even if Li Tiannan and the people from the Huangfu Clan help you."
"You—"
"The only thing you can do now is leave this realm before my other business is finished, but that won't save you from me and will only delay your destruction." Helian Yueyi frowned at Zhang Fei [5].
"Believe it or not, I've marked all of you with something, and I can find you wherever you go to hide, so you'll never be able to hide from me."
Helian Yueyi immediately sat up, glared at him, and asked in a high tone.
"Why?
Why are you so cruel?
Nothing happened to your son, so you don't need to destroy my family, right?"
"Aren't you narrow-minded?
What would have happened to my son if he didn't have some protectors by his side?
He would have fallen into your hands and become your slave." Helian Yueyi opened her mouth without being able to answer Zhang Fei [5].
"If you want to blame someone, then you should blame yourself and your husband.
My son didn't know or have any issues with you before, and all he wanted was to live a peaceful life with all his wives in this realm.

Unfortunately, you guys were too arrogant, as no one dared to go against you all in this realm before, and you sent people to capture my son; even your husband thought of using the Gu Insect to control him.
Do you think people like you deserve forgiveness?"
Helian Yueyi's expression became even more filled with fear after Zhang Fei mentioned the Gu Insect, especially since no one in the Nine Stars Realm knew about it, except for her family members.
"Are you surprised that I know about the Gu Insect?" Zhang Fei [5] then jumped down from the bed.
"If you don't want your children to die with your husband, then you can kill Huangfu Shou for me.
If you can do that, I will never touch you or your children, and all of you can continue to live peacefully in this realm."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately disappeared from the place, leaving Helian Yueyi in shock and horror.
She bit her thumb as she recalled all their conversations, and the image of her family's destruction caused her to shake uncontrollably.
Naturally, Helian Yueyi didn't want to die, and she didn't want her children to die, but she also couldn't possibly kill her husband.
"Shit!
Is there anything I can do to stop that guy from destroying my family?
Should I discuss this matter with my husband?
Only my husband's ancestors can save us from that evil guy, but I'm sure he's monitoring us from afar, and he will slaughter us outright before they can arrive in this realm."

'You're right; I'm always monitoring all of you, and you guys will die before the people from the Huangfu Clan arrive in this realm.' Hearing that, Helian Yueyi looked around her room and used her senses to search for Zhang Fei [5], but she could not detect his presence in her room. 'I have given you one last way to save yourself and your children, so the decision is in your hands, and you better think things through before making any detrimental decisions.'
'That bastard!

He keeps threatening me!' Helian Yueyi lay back on her bed and covered her face with her hands, thinking about the best solution to save herself and her children. 'Do I really have to kill my husband to save myself?
If I kill him, Senior Tiannan and the people from the Huangfu Clan who will arrive soon will definitely find out, and they will definitely kill me.'
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] was already inside Huang Lian's room, but only Ling Baozi joined them because Huangfu Shou had assigned Huangfu Ziyuan to something else.

"Master, I have already used Du She's Silent Veins Poison on all the important generals, and they can't move their bodies now." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow at Ling Baozi, especially since he had never asked the old man to do that.
"I thought it might help you smooth your plans against Huangfu Shou, so I decided to do it."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"I think that's good, so Huangfu Shou won't be able to wage a war with any kingdom.
However, Li Tiannan and someone from the Huangfu Clan will arrive in this realm in less than two weeks, and they will probably find out there is poison in their body.
Therefore, you can ask Du She for an antidote, and you have to cure them before those two people arrive, or my plan will be ruined if they find out."
"Yes, Master." Ling Baozi then asked him.
"Master, can you provide an antidote for my clan members?
I am your slave, and they will never disobey me, so please stop torturing them."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out a bottle and threw it to Ling Baozi.
"You can use it to cure them, but I want you to replace your clan leader.
I want Pu Niu, who is disguised as Ling Long, to lead your clan."
"I'll arrange it right now, Master." Ling Baozi immediately left the room and rushed back to his Ling Clan.
"What do you want me to do, Master?" Huangfu Lian asked the question as soon as Zhang Fei [5] looked at him.
Zhang Fei [5] smiled faintly and gave Huangfu Lian some instructions, causing his eyes to widen in shock.
"Are you incapable of doing such simple things?
If you can't do them, you don't deserve to be my slave.
I will seal your cultivation and feed you to those ferocious beasts, and they will eat you alive."
'He's too evil!' Huangfu Lian screamed in his heart.
"I can do anything!
I will carry out your orders as soon as possible, master."
"That's good." Zhang Fei [5] then threw a pill bottle at Huangfu Lian.
"If you have the opportunity, you can use the pills inside on Li Tiannan and the person from the Huangfu Clan.
However, you don't need to force yourself because the two of them are too strong for you, and I still need you for my next plans against your father."
Once Zhang Fei [5] vanished, Huangfu Lian exhaled with a sense of relief.
He then looked at the pill bottle and thought of a way to use it, but he was really afraid that the two people would realize his actions, and he would die in their hands if that happened.
"Since he didn't force me to use the pills on them, I'll think about that later.
The problem is how I should carry out his previous orders, especially since my father will be aware of my actions, and he will beat me if I do it."

After leaving the Huangfu Kingdom, Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the training space, took out all the forging equipment, and began attempting to forge an earth-grade weapon using the materials Tie Xuan had given him before he left for the Blossom Heaven Realm.
In her residence, Mai Xiaomeng smiled in satisfaction after she swallowed the six pills Zhang Fei [5] gave her.
Not only did her body become stronger, but her cultivation foundation also became stronger.
In addition, the Yin Qi within her body became purer and richer, which will accelerate her cultivation.
"Not only is his Yang Qi powerful, but he also has incredibly potent pills.
If I can get his pills for my race members, they will become even stronger, and those people will not be able to bully us anymore.
Unfortunately, he wasn't tempted by my beauty and sexiness, so I had to think of another way to get him."
Crack.
"Big Sis." Mai Xiaomeng looked at Mai Yuzhen, who had just walked in.
"Our members in the western region just contacted me and told me that Xi Hongyan has come out of her seclusion, and she is furious because she can't find us in our old residence."
"Does Xi Hongyan know that we have moved to this region?"
Mai Yuzhen replied with a shake of her head.
"For the time being, Xi Hongyan doesn't know about our move to this region, but I'm sure she will know about it sooner or later, and she might come here to attack us."
Mai Xiaomeng nodded in understanding and got off the bed.
"Order all our remaining members in the western region to retreat immediately, and they must do it quietly so as not to attract Xi Hongyan's attention.
I will go to the Hong Clan again to meet Hong Quan and the others, especially since we can't face that mad woman ourselves.
"Yes, Big Sis."
"Why did you suddenly come back here, Mai Xiaomeng?" Cai Yinzhi asked the female cat as soon as she arrived.
"If you have business with Xin'er, you can go to the Murong Clan's new residence."
Mai Xiaomeng immediately sat down in front of her.
"Grandma Yinzhi, I came here to talk to Grandpa Quan.
Xi Hongyan has come out of her seclusion, and she's starting to look for us now.
If she finds out that we're in this region, she'll definitely lead people from her Xi Clan to hunt us down.
We can't face them, so we need this clan's help to face them."
Cai Yinzhi nodded in understanding.
"Let's go; I will take you to meet my husband, and you can discuss this matter with him."

chapters.title: Chapter 741: Xi Hongyan
paragraphs: In the Heaven Blossom Realm, a flying artifact had just landed in front of the Sun Tower, and a young man hurriedly descended before storing it away. The young man is Shang Xiaojuan, who has always been crazy about Shang Yaolin.

"Is this tower really the key to going to the realms beyond the upper realms? If that's true, I must strive hard to reach its peak; only then can I surpass the cultivators in the Red Sun Realm. If I can do that, I will definitely kill that bastard Shang Huaqiang because he's been trampling on my family for too long, and no one can stop me from getting Yaolin anymore." Shang Xiaojian then turned to the crowd of men outside the walls surrounding the Sun Tower. He usually didn't need to bother with other people's business, but their condition sparked his curiosity, and he immediately approached them. "What happened to you?"

"Young master, we are slaves, and our situation has been like this for generations." A man then pointed to the floating island, and Shang Xiaojuan followed that direction. "All the women in this realm live on that island, and they have enslaved us."
"Oh?" Shang Xiaojuan was surprised to hear that. "What really happened? Why did all those women enslave you guys?"

One of the men immediately explained to Shang Xiaojuan their situation in the past. Back then, their male ancestors enslaved all the women in their realm, but the situation changed after one of the female ancestors found the floating island, along with various valuable treasures in it, which ultimately reversed their situation.

"So there are only women on the floating island, huh?" They nodded to Shang Xiaojuan, but he couldn't care about those women. In his eyes, there was no woman better than Shang Xiaoyin, let alone the woman from a small realm in the middle realms.
"Can you free us, young master?"

"I am not interested in your affairs, so you can spend your lives as slaves." Shang Xiaojuan immediately refused, disappointing the men. He did not care about their reactions and walked towards the stone obelisk. When he arrived there, he immediately touched it, but he did nothing and sat cross-legged in front of it. "My master asked me to wait for her, so I should wait here, or she will beat me if I don't listen to her."

Dressed in a tight black and red robe, which emphasizes the sexiness of her figure, a young woman around her early thirties walked out of the room. Her long and smooth, black hair was coiled on top of her head, adorned by a black tiara, with the front hanging down to her waist. Her lovely face was as cold as the middle of winter, and not the slightest emotion could be seen on it.
The woman has big and round eyes, with pupils as black as ink. She has a slender nose, but it is slightly bent like an eagle's beak. Her lips were small but thick, covered in thick red lipstick.
"Xi Zhenyang."
A young man immediately appeared and knelt on one knee. "What can I do for you, Master Hongyan?"

The woman was the leader of the Xi Clan, Xi Hongyan, who had just come out of her seclusion. "We will face Shang Huaqiang and his Shang Clan soon, but we have to unite the western region first, so I want you to lead our members and use force to subdue the other clans. If they dare to oppose us, you can get rid of the important people in their clans."
"Yes, Master."

After the young man disappeared, a young woman appeared by Xi Hongyan's side. "What are your plans for Mai Xiaomeng, Big Sis? They are living in the southern region now, and they seem to have decided to join the Hong Clan."
"The Hong Clan, huh?" Xi Hongyan muttered to herself while frowning. "Have the other clans decided to join them, Xi Xiuling?"

"The Hao, Qiao, Tie, Tao, Miao, Lai, Deng, Huang, Li, and Wu clans had already joined the Hong Clan. However, the Wang and Dai clans decided to join Shang Huaqiang." Xi Hongyan was not surprised to hear about the relationship of the last three clans, and she had expected it to be a long time ago. "The clans that are still in a neutral position are the Huo, Niu, Ren, and Jin clans. However, I heard that Shang Ziyuan went to see Ren Dongcheng a month ago, but I have no information on whether that old man is willing to join her or not."

"The Huo clan is no less powerful than the Shang and Hong clans, and they control the alchemy market in our realm. Moreover, they have a favorable relationship with Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia, so I believe Huo Jiguang will never join any camp. The Niu clan was tied in marriage with the Huo clan, so they should be on their side. Ren Dongcheng was not a fool, and he knew that the Shang clan only wanted to use them. Unfortunately, he couldn't possibly remain neutral forever, and his best choice was to join the Hong clan. Jin Ruyue's character was hard to predict, so the chances of her joining one of those clans were still fifty-fifty." Xi Hongyan then pondered a few things before speaking again. "Xiuling, I will go to the southern region to meet Mai Xiaomeng, and I want you to lead additional people to help Xi Zhenyang subdue the clans in this region."
Xi Xiuling was a little surprised by Xi Hongyan's decision, but she did not refute or ask further. "I'll gather them now, Big Sis."

"Do you think you can escape from me, Xiaomeng? Even if Hong Quan protects you, you will still fall into my hands." After that, Xi Hongyan left her Xi Clan for the southern region, but she was in no rush to get there.

"Patriarch." Shang Huaqiang turned to Shang Xishun, who had just arrived. She was the woman Zhang Fei had met in the Netherworld Realm when she and Feng Yao had destroyed the demon portal. "Xi Hongyan has already come out of her isolation, and she is on her way to this region."
"What is Xi Hongyan's purpose for going to this region?"

"Ma Xiaomeng." Shang Huaqiang raised his eyebrows in surprise. "Patriarch, everyone in this realm knows that Xi Hongyan is obsessed with her, and she must have heard that she brought her cat race members to this region."
Shang Huaqiang then asked again. "Did they tell you the situation in the western region?"
"Xi Hongyan's clan members seem to be preparing to do something, and I guess that she wants to use force to subdue all the clans in that region."

'That ambitious woman has lost her patience, huh? Otherwise, she wouldn't do that, especially since her clan would face resistance from the other clans, which would only be detrimental to them.' Shang Huaqiang then gave his order. "Xishun, I want you to go to the Wasteland Realm secretly, and I want you to report to me about any changes that occur in the northern island."
"Do you suspect anything, Patriarch?"

Shang Huaqiang nodded at her. "Shang Baishi knew the risks if he dared to touch Shang Xiaoyin, but they suddenly had a love affair and ran away together, and I'm sure there was a mastermind behind their relationship. In addition, Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu also disappeared without a trace, and I suspect all these matters are related to each other, so I want you to investigate it thoroughly. If my guess is correct, I want you to capture the culprit and bring that person to me, and I will decide my next step after that."
"I will leave for the Wasteland Realm right now, Patriarch."
After Shang Xishun left, Shang Huaqiang immediately contacted Fei Qinyuan, who was at the Fei Clan, informing her about Xi Hongyan.

Meanwhile, Mai Xiaomeng had arrived at the new residence of the Murong Clan, her expression much more relieved after her discussion with Hong Quan and Hong Chong. She then went to see Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin, who were chatting in the back area. "Hey, Xi Hongyan has come out of her seclusion, and the situation in the western region will be chaotic soon, especially since she ordered her clan members to force those clans to submit to her."
"Xi Hongyan has lost her patience, huh?" Murong Qianying muttered with a frown. "Do you think she has thought about going against Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan?"

"Xi Hongyan has never liked Shang Huaqiang, and she has always been ambitious to make her Xi Clan the best in this realm. Since she intends to subjugate those clans, her cultivation has probably been broken through to the 2-Moon Divine Ascendant by now. However, her strength is still insufficient to fight against Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, and her clan will be destroyed if she insists on fighting them." Hong Xinxin then asked Mai Xiaomeng. "Did she come here to look for you?"

"Why are you asking the obvious?" Mai Xiaomeng replied with a heavy sigh. "Xi Hongyan is too obsessed with me, and she is on her way here now. Therefore, I met your father and grandfather earlier, and I asked for their help to stop her."

Hong Xinxin nodded in understanding and spoke to her via voice transmission. 'I will discuss this with Zhang Fei first, and I hope he will agree to send you and your race members to another realm so that my Hong Clan will not have to clash needlessly with Xi Hongyan.'
Mai Xiaomeng's eyes gleamed with joy after hearing that. 'All right, you can contact him now! I don't want to meet that mad woman, and I will suffer if I fall into her hands.'

Hong Xinxin immediately contacted Zhang Fei to discuss it. Although he did not like Mai Xiaomeng very much, he realized that the Hong and Murong clans still needed her and her Mai Clan, so he immediately agreed to it. 'Hey! He agreed to move you and your clan members to another realm, so we will return to my clan now.'
'That's great!' Mai Xiaomeng replied with joy.
"Sister Qianying, have you collected the Yin Qi that Long'er asked for?"

Murong Qianying immediately gave Hong Xinxin a storage ring. "I don't know why Long'er needs Yin Qi from cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms, but there are 100 bottles in it, and the rest is Yin Qi from cultivators in the Saint Realm and above."
"In that case, Xiaomeng and I will return to my clan first, especially since Long'er will pick me up soon." Murong Qianying wanted to leave with Hong Xinxin, but she still couldn't leave her clan.

Upon their arrival at the Hong clan, Mai Xiaomeng immediately asked all of her clan members to gather there, and she asked her members who were still in other regions to hide in another place that was safe from Xi Hongyan and her Xi Clan. "When will Zhang Fei pick us up?"

"Why are you impatient?" Hong Xinxin asked with a shake of her head. "He is still tempering his body, and he will pick us up as soon as he is done. Moreover, your clan members have not gathered here yet, so you should wait patiently."
"All right then."

Hong Xinxin then went to her family and told them her plans for Mai Xiaomeng and her clan. Although Hong Quan and the others did not mind helping them, they were also relieved if the cat race members were moved to another realm temporarily.
"Xin'er, I want you to introduce Zhang Fei to us."
Hong Xinxin sighed helplessly before nodding to her grandfather. "If he wants to meet you guys, I brought him here directly, but I won't force him if he doesn't feel ready."
"Try persuading him first."
"Yes."

After flying through the darkness of outer space for nearly two months, Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin finally arrived at a realm in the lower realms. Fortunately, they had a flying artifact with high enough speed, or else they would have had to spend a lot longer arriving at the lower realms.

Shang Baishi, who was flying his flying artifact, suddenly received a long-distance message. He then informed Shang Xiaoyin about it. "Wife, your mother went to look for us, and she left our realm a month ago."
"Do you think my mother will find us here?" Shang Xiaoyin frantically asked.
Shang Baishi shook his head. "I can't confirm that because my informant doesn't know your mother's exact destination, but I hope she won't guess that we are in the lower realms."
"I hope so." Shang Xiaoyin then pointed at the planet in front of them. "Why can't I feel the Qi from that planet?"

"Hmm?" Shang Baishi then looked at the planet and realized the situation. "Since there is no Qi on that planet, we will hide there for the time being. Even if your mother realized that we were in the lower realms, she would never suspect that we were hiding there."
Shang Xiaoyin immediately agreed with that. "Let's go there, husband. I'm almost two months pregnant, so I want to enjoy a quiet life."
"All right." Shang Baishi immediately flew the flying artifact into that realm.

None of the planet's inhabitants noticed their presence because Shang Baishi used a shield on his flying artifact. However, he and Shang Xiaoyin immediately noticed the presence of several cultivators on the planet. "Did you feel that, husband?"
"Yes." Shang Baishi replied with a nod. "There are three cultivators in this realm, but they are too weak for their cultivation in the ten mortal realms."
Shang Xiaoyin frowned before asking. "What if we get rid of them? I'm afraid they will spread our presence on this planet, and my mother might find us here."

"No need." Shang Baishi refused her. "With their low cultivation, they won't be able to notice our presence, so we don't need to do anything to them. Moreover, you are pregnant with our child now, so we shouldn't dirty our hands with blood."

"Yeah, you're right." Shang Xiaoyin then pointed toward a mountain. "I couldn't detect anyone there, and it was quite remote, so I thought it would be a good place for us to stay until our child was born. After our child is born, we must leave this realm, or our child will not be able to cultivate because there is no Qi on this planet."

After making sure the mountain was far from people, Shang Baixi immediately took Shang Xiaoyin there. He looked for the flattest place and landed his flying artifact there. "You can stay here first, and I will go find materials to build our house here."

"Yes." After Shang Baishi left, Shang Xiaoyin let out a soft sigh and rubbed her stomach, which was already a little big due to her pregnancy. "I want to give birth to you, but I'm afraid your grandmother will find us before I give birth. If that happens, she will force me to abort you, and she will also kill your father."
"Can you sense that, Mo Zifeng?"
Mo Zifeng nodded to Pang Gui. "Even though those two cultivators have hidden their auras, I can still faintly sense them, and they are much stronger than the three of us."

"You should contact our master now so he can take precautions against the two of them, or else the ordinary humans on this planet will suffer because of them." Pang Hong, who was standing by their side, said.
Mo Zifeng gave a slight nod before sending Zhang Fei a message. "Our master is still a little busy right now, but he will be back here soon, and he asked us not to approach those two cultivators.

After he finished absorbing the Jiashen Liquid, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got out of the wooden tub and got dressed. However, Wu Lianzhi was already waiting for him in the room. "Do you want to go somewhere else, Long'er?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told her. "I have to go to the Hong Clan to pick up some people, and I will return to my home realm to take care of something after that."
"Can I go with you?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] carried the little girl straight away. "I will take you to the home realm after this."
"Yay!"
