If they dare to oppose us, you can get rid of the important people in their clans."
"Yes, Master."
After the young man disappeared, a young woman appeared by Xi Hongyan's side.
"What are your plans for Mai Xiaomeng, Big Sis?
They are living in the southern region now, and they seem to have decided to join the Hong Clan."
"The Hong Clan, huh?" Xi Hongyan muttered to herself while frowning.
"Have the other clans decided to join them, Xi Xiuling?"
"The Hao, Qiao, Tie, Tao, Miao, Lai, Deng, Huang, Li, and Wu clans had already joined the Hong Clan.
However, the Wang and Dai clans decided to join Shang Huaqiang." Xi Hongyan was not surprised to hear about the relationship of the last three clans, and she had expected it to be a long time ago.
"The clans that are still in a neutral position are the Huo, Niu, Ren, and Jin clans.
However, I heard that Shang Ziyuan went to see Ren Dongcheng a month ago, but I have no information on whether that old man is willing to join her or not."
"The Huo clan is no less powerful than the Shang and Hong clans, and they control the alchemy market in our realm.
Moreover, they have a favorable relationship with Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia, so I believe Huo Jiguang will never join any camp.
The Niu clan was tied in marriage with the Huo clan, so they should be on their side.
Ren Dongcheng was not a fool, and he knew that the Shang clan only wanted to use them.
Unfortunately, he couldn't possibly remain neutral forever, and his best choice was to join the Hong clan.
Jin Ruyue's character was hard to predict, so the chances of her joining one of those clans were still fifty-fifty." Xi Hongyan then pondered a few things before speaking again.
"Xiuling, I will go to the southern region to meet Mai Xiaomeng, and I want you to lead additional people to help Xi Zhenyang subdue the clans in this region."
Xi Xiuling was a little surprised by Xi Hongyan's decision, but she did not refute or ask further.
"I'll gather them now, Big Sis."
"Do you think you can escape from me, Xiaomeng?
Even if Hong Quan protects you, you will still fall into my hands." After that, Xi Hongyan left her Xi Clan for the southern region, but she was in no rush to get there.
"Patriarch." Shang Huaqiang turned to Shang Xishun, who had just arrived.
She was the woman Zhang Fei had met in the Netherworld Realm when she and Feng Yao had destroyed the demon portal.
"Xi Hongyan has already come out of her isolation, and she is on her way to this region."
"What is Xi Hongyan's purpose for going to this region?"
"Ma Xiaomeng." Shang Huaqiang raised his eyebrows in surprise.
"Patriarch, everyone in this realm knows that Xi Hongyan is obsessed with her, and she must have heard that she brought her cat race members to this region."
Shang Huaqiang then asked again.
"Did they tell you the situation in the western region?"
"Xi Hongyan's clan members seem to be preparing to do something, and I guess that she wants to use force to subdue all the clans in that region."
'That ambitious woman has lost her patience, huh?
Otherwise, she wouldn't do that, especially since her clan would face resistance from the other clans, which would only be detrimental to them.' Shang Huaqiang then gave his order.
"Xishun, I want you to go to the Wasteland Realm secretly, and I want you to report to me about any changes that occur in the northern island."
"Do you suspect anything, Patriarch?"
Shang Huaqiang nodded at her.
"Shang Baishi knew the risks if he dared to touch Shang Xiaoyin, but they suddenly had a love affair and ran away together, and I'm sure there was a mastermind behind their relationship.
In addition, Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu also disappeared without a trace, and I suspect all these matters are related to each other, so I want you to investigate it thoroughly.
If my guess is correct, I want you to capture the culprit and bring that person to me, and I will decide my next step after that."
"I will leave for the Wasteland Realm right now, Patriarch."
After Shang Xishun left, Shang Huaqiang immediately contacted Fei Qinyuan, who was at the Fei Clan, informing her about Xi Hongyan.
Meanwhile, Mai Xiaomeng had arrived at the new residence of the Murong Clan, her expression much more relieved after her discussion with Hong Quan and Hong Chong.
She then went to see Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin, who were chatting in the back area.
"Hey, Xi Hongyan has come out of her seclusion, and the situation in the western region will be chaotic soon, especially since she ordered her clan members to force those clans to submit to her."
"Xi Hongyan has lost her patience, huh?" Murong Qianying muttered with a frown.
"Do you think she has thought about going against Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan?"
"Xi Hongyan has never liked Shang Huaqiang, and she has always been ambitious to make her Xi Clan the best in this realm.
Since she intends to subjugate those clans, her cultivation has probably been broken through to the 2-Moon Divine Ascendant by now.
However, her strength is still insufficient to fight against Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, and her clan will be destroyed if she insists on fighting them." Hong Xinxin then asked Mai Xiaomeng.
"Did she come here to look for you?"
"Why are you asking the obvious?" Mai Xiaomeng replied with a heavy sigh.
"Xi Hongyan is too obsessed with me, and she is on her way here now.
Therefore, I met your father and grandfather earlier, and I asked for their help to stop her."

Hong Xinxin nodded in understanding and spoke to her via voice transmission. 'I will discuss this with Zhang Fei first, and I hope he will agree to send you and your race members to another realm so that my Hong Clan will not have to clash needlessly with Xi Hongyan.'
Mai Xiaomeng's eyes gleamed with joy after hearing that. 'All right, you can contact him now!
I don't want to meet that mad woman, and I will suffer if I fall into her hands.'
Hong Xinxin immediately contacted Zhang Fei to discuss it.
Although he did not like Mai Xiaomeng very much, he realized that the Hong and Murong clans still needed her and her Mai Clan, so he immediately agreed to it. 'Hey!
He agreed to move you and your clan members to another realm, so we will return to my clan now.'
'That's great!' Mai Xiaomeng replied with joy.
"Sister Qianying, have you collected the Yin Qi that Long'er asked for?"
Murong Qianying immediately gave Hong Xinxin a storage ring.
"I don't know why Long'er needs Yin Qi from cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms, but there are 100 bottles in it, and the rest is Yin Qi from cultivators in the Saint Realm and above."
"In that case, Xiaomeng and I will return to my clan first, especially since Long'er will pick me up soon." Murong Qianying wanted to leave with Hong Xinxin, but she still couldn't leave her clan.

Upon their arrival at the Hong clan, Mai Xiaomeng immediately asked all of her clan members to gather there, and she asked her members who were still in other regions to hide in another place that was safe from Xi Hongyan and her Xi Clan.
"When will Zhang Fei pick us up?"
"Why are you impatient?" Hong Xinxin asked with a shake of her head.
"He is still tempering his body, and he will pick us up as soon as he is done.
Moreover, your clan members have not gathered here yet, so you should wait patiently."
"All right then."
Hong Xinxin then went to her family and told them her plans for Mai Xiaomeng and her clan.
Although Hong Quan and the others did not mind helping them, they were also relieved if the cat race members were moved to another realm temporarily.
"Xin'er, I want you to introduce Zhang Fei to us."
Hong Xinxin sighed helplessly before nodding to her grandfather.
"If he wants to meet you guys, I brought him here directly, but I won't force him if he doesn't feel ready."
"Try persuading him first."
"Yes."
After flying through the darkness of outer space for nearly two months, Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin finally arrived at a realm in the lower realms.
Fortunately, they had a flying artifact with high enough speed, or else they would have had to spend a lot longer arriving at the lower realms.
Shang Baishi, who was flying his flying artifact, suddenly received a long-distance message.
He then informed Shang Xiaoyin about it.
"Wife, your mother went to look for us, and she left our realm a month ago."
"Do you think my mother will find us here?" Shang Xiaoyin frantically asked.
Shang Baishi shook his head.
"I can't confirm that because my informant doesn't know your mother's exact destination, but I hope she won't guess that we are in the lower realms."
"I hope so." Shang Xiaoyin then pointed at the planet in front of them.
"Why can't I feel the Qi from that planet?"
"Hmm?" Shang Baishi then looked at the planet and realized the situation.
"Since there is no Qi on that planet, we will hide there for the time being.
Even if your mother realized that we were in the lower realms, she would never suspect that we were hiding there."
Shang Xiaoyin immediately agreed with that.
"Let's go there, husband.
I'm almost two months pregnant, so I want to enjoy a quiet life."
"All right." Shang Baishi immediately flew the flying artifact into that realm.
None of the planet's inhabitants noticed their presence because Shang Baishi used a shield on his flying artifact.
However, he and Shang Xiaoyin immediately noticed the presence of several cultivators on the planet.
"Did you feel that, husband?"
"Yes." Shang Baishi replied with a nod.
"There are three cultivators in this realm, but they are too weak for their cultivation in the ten mortal realms."
Shang Xiaoyin frowned before asking.
"What if we get rid of them?
I'm afraid they will spread our presence on this planet, and my mother might find us here."
"No need." Shang Baishi refused her.
"With their low cultivation, they won't be able to notice our presence, so we don't need to do anything to them.
Moreover, you are pregnant with our child now, so we shouldn't dirty our hands with blood."
"Yeah, you're right." Shang Xiaoyin then pointed toward a mountain.
"I couldn't detect anyone there, and it was quite remote, so I thought it would be a good place for us to stay until our child was born.
After our child is born, we must leave this realm, or our child will not be able to cultivate because there is no Qi on this planet."
After making sure the mountain was far from people, Shang Baixi immediately took Shang Xiaoyin there.
He looked for the flattest place and landed his flying artifact there.
"You can stay here first, and I will go find materials to build our house here."
"Yes." After Shang Baishi left, Shang Xiaoyin let out a soft sigh and rubbed her stomach, which was already a little big due to her pregnancy.
"I want to give birth to you, but I'm afraid your grandmother will find us before I give birth.
If that happens, she will force me to abort you, and she will also kill your father."
"Can you sense that, Mo Zifeng?"
Mo Zifeng nodded to Pang Gui.
"Even though those two cultivators have hidden their auras, I can still faintly sense them, and they are much stronger than the three of us."

"You should contact our master now so he can take precautions against the two of them, or else the ordinary humans on this planet will suffer because of them." Pang Hong, who was standing by their side, said.
Mo Zifeng gave a slight nod before sending Zhang Fei a message.
"Our master is still a little busy right now, but he will be back here soon, and he asked us not to approach those two cultivators.
After he finished absorbing the Jiashen Liquid, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got out of the wooden tub and got dressed.
However, Wu Lianzhi was already waiting for him in the room.
"Do you want to go somewhere else, Long'er?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told her.
"I have to go to the Hong Clan to pick up some people, and I will return to my home realm to take care of something after that."
"Can I go with you?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] carried the little girl straight away.
"I will take you to the home realm after this."
"Yay!"

chapters.title: Chapter 742: Meet The Hong Clan
paragraphs: "Wow! So many kitties!" Wu Lianzhi exclaimed as soon as she saw so many Mai Xiaomeng's subordinates in their cat form. "Grandma Xinxin, where do all these cats come from?"
Hong Xinxin pointed at Mai Xiaomeng. "This one is a big female cat, and all these kitties are her subordinates."

Wu Lianzhi looked at Mai Xiaomeng in confusion because she did not have any cat features on her body, and her current form was no different from the other humans. "Are you really a female cat, Grandma?"

'This little girl! I'm young and sexy, but she calls me that.' Mai Xiaomeng squatted in front of Wu Lianzhi and patted her head. "Little girl, I'm not as old as Hong Xinxin, so you can't address me as grandma. Instead, you can call me a big sister, okay?"
"No!" Wu Lianzhi refused by shaking her head. "My mother told me to address Grandma Xinxin as a grandmother, and you are her friend, so I will also address you as a grandmother."
"You can call me whatever you like then." Mai Xiaomeng then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Where are you going to move us? Are you going to take us to the Nine Stars Realm?"

"I will take you all there, but you and your race members will be living on an empty island to avoid pressuring the other cultivators." Mai Xiaomeng did not reject Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s idea, especially since it was better than if she had to meet Xi Hongyan. Moreover, they would live in the same realm, and she could come to him whenever she wanted. "Are all your members gathered here? If they are all here, we can leave now."
Hong Xinxin immediately spoke to her. "Fei, I know you're not ready to meet my family because the situation in this realm is still complicated, but I hope you can meet them."

[Master, I think you can meet them, and your real body must stay in this realm. That way, the quality and quantity of the Qi inside the training space will be equal to the Qi in this realm, and all of you can cultivate faster because of it. As long as you stay in seclusion, you don't need to think about the situation in this realm, and your clones can take care of all problems in other realms, including the Earth.]
'Well, that's true.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] said to Hong Xinxin directly. "I will bring these cats to the Nine Stars Realm first, then we will meet your family."
Hong Xinxin smiled in relief after hearing that, and she carried Wu Lianzhi directly. "In that case, I will wait for you with my family."

Mai Xiaomeng directly led her race members into the gate, followed by Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Since they were of the beast race, he wanted to place them on an island not far from the beast kingdom, but he contacted Long Huang to ask for his approval first.

After the beast emperor agreed, Zhang Xiaolong [3] took them to the island he had chosen. He then returned to the Zhou Kingdom to temper his body again, but Mai Xiaomeng actually followed him to seduce him. He chose to ignore her and let her do whatever she liked, especially since she could help him if any unexpected problems occurred.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei walked out of the training space, but he was not alone. Instead, Zhang Lin accompanied him because he was curious about the Red Sun Realm, and she couldn't do anything because her cultivation was not stable after she broke through to the Earth Realm.

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows when they arrived in front of them because Hong Quan tried to suppress him with his aura, but he did not do it to Zhang Lin because she would not be able to withstand it.

Zhang Fei directly let go of Zhang Lin's hand and disappeared from their sight, which shocked Hong Quan and the others. After all, the old man's cultivation was higher than Shang Huaqiang's, but he was not the least bit pressured and was still able to move under his pressure.
Hong Xinxin simply smiled, observing her family's reaction, but she gestured for them to turn around, as Zhang Fei was already standing there, wearing a relaxed smile.

Hong Quan and the others immediately turned to Zhang Fei. "No wonder my granddaughter has confidence in you, and Old Man Hun is also willing to accept you as his newest disciple. If I pressure the other younger generations with my aura, they will immediately fall to the floor and not be able to move an inch."

"How did you train yourself to this extent, kid? Your cultivation is still at the 5-Star Earth Realm, but you are much better than cultivators at the Seven Divine Realms in some aspects." Hong Chong spoke to him.

"You both praise me too much, seniors." Zhang Fei then told them. "Xinxin trained me in the body cultivation path, and Master Hun trained me in the soul cultivation path. I have many wives and partners, and they helped me in my cultivation, and I was able to reach this level thanks to them. In addition, I also trained my mental strength in a special way, which I can't explain to you."

Hong Quan nodded in understanding while rubbing his long beard. "I've lived for so long, but I've never met a cultivator as complete as you. Xin'er also told me you were an alchemist and blacksmith; even the Nameless One couldn't walk all the cultivation paths like you."

"Senior, I still can't compare to the four of you, let alone the Nameless One." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "The four of you are much stronger than me, and that man is the strongest in this universe, even though he cannot pursue all cultivation paths like me. However, I am significantly younger than all of you, and the path ahead of me is still uncharted. All I can do now is strive hard to improve myself in all areas, and I am confident that I can surpass all of you in the future. At that time, I will stand at the pinnacle of the cultivation world, and no one will be able to harm me or those closest to me."

"Hahaha." Hong Quan laughed as he stood up and approached Zhang Fei. "If it was someone else who said that, I would think that person was bragging. However, you are different from others, and you have many advantages to stand at the pinnacle of the cultivation world. I don't know when you will succeed in achieving your lofty dream, but I will definitely be there and witness your success. Anyway, Xin'er told me that you still don't know how strong your true strength is, so I will help you measure it. Therefore, you can attack me with all your strength, and I might be able to give you some pointers to improve your strength."

Zhang Fei himself was curious about his true strength, so he immediately followed Hong Quan's wishes by channeling all his strength into his fist, but he did not use all of his enhanced strength abilities.
*Bam*
Zhang Fei was stunned to see Hong Quan not budging from his spot even an inch, even though he had used all his strength to punch his abdomen, and the old man did not look like he was in any pain.
"Based on your attack just now, your true strength is still equivalent to quasi-divine realm cultivators." Hong Quan then asked him. "Do you have enhanced strength techniques?"
"I have some, Senior."
"Use all of them at once."

"All right." Zhang Fei immediately used all of his enhanced strength abilities and punched Hong Quan's abdomen once again, but the old man was only pushed back an inch. 'Holy fudge! A high-level cultivator and body cultivator like him is indeed terrifying, and his body strength is several times above mine.'

Hong Quang rubbed his beard as he thought for some time. "I must admit that your enhanced strength abilities are truly amazing, especially since they can increase your strength to the level of cultivators in the Divine Expansion Realm. If your body cultivation has reached the third stage, you might be able to face cultivators at the Divine Manifestation Realm. However, enhanced abilities usually put an excessive burden on our bodies, so you can't use them for long-term combat. If you are forced to use them because you are facing strong enemies, then you must finish the fight as quickly as possible. Otherwise, you will lose to them, and you will also die in their hands."
"Grandpa, Zhang Fei's main advantage is not in his enhanced abilities but in his speed." Hong Xinxin said this to Hong Quan.
Hearing that, Hong Quan turned to his daughter-in-law. "Yizhen, you are the fastest among us, so I want you to compete with Zhang Fei in speed."
"Yes, Father." Yan Yizhen replied in a soft voice.
Hong Quan then asked Zhang Fei. "Do you mind showing us your speed, kid? Yizhen comes from the Yan Clan in the Shandian Realm, and her clan focuses on speed, so you can compare your speed with hers."
"Not at all." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head. "However, we can't possibly do it here, or I won't be able to use my maximum speed."
"Let's do it outside so you two can use your maximum speed." Hong Quan immediately led them out. "Anyway, you don't need to hold back your speed, Yizhen."
Yan Yizhen was surprised to hear that, but she still agreed to Hong Quan's request. "Yes, Father."

Arriving outside, Zhang Fei and Yan Yizhen immediately stood opposite each other, and Hong Quan locked his aura on them because he was sure he wouldn't be able to follow their movements without doing so.
Zhang Fei cupped his hands to Yan Yizhen before saying. "Senior, I don't mean to belittle you, but you must use your highest speed, or I will catch you immediately."

Yan Yizhen and the others were surprised by Zhang Fei's confidence, so they turned to Hong Xinxin and Zhang Lin, who smiled confidently. "Mother, he really didn't mean to underestimate you, and you will realize the truth of his speed once the two of you compete, so you should use your highest speed from the start."
Yan Yizhen's body was instantly enveloped by a green aura, but it didn't just come from her wind element, and there was something else fused with it. "Get ready, Zhang Fei."
"I'm ready, senior."

Yan Yizhen immediately disappeared from their sight, but she was shocked because Zhang Fei suddenly patted her shoulder from behind. She immediately activated her technique and accelerated her speed even further.

However, Zhang Fei continued to follow Yan Yizhen from the side, and he repeatedly patted her shoulder, giving her a tremendous shock. 'What the hell with his speed? Our speed and technique are the best in the upper realms, but he can keep up with my movements. Moreover, he hasn't used his wind element yet, and I won't be able to catch up to him if he does.'

Unlike Hong Xinxin and her family members, Zhang Lin could naturally watch Zhang Fei and Yan Yizhen's movements with naked eyes. "Big Sis Xinxin, your mother's speed is amazing, but she will never be able to escape from my big brother."
"Can you see their movements, little girl?" Hong Chong asked.

Zhang Lin nodded at him. "My brother is actually afraid of death because there are so many people by his side, so he keeps honing his speed, and his speed is several times faster than Senior Yizhen. Actually, I can catch up to them because I have trained my speed using the same method, but my speed is still behind my big brother's."
"Try chasing them, little girl." Hong Quan immediately enveloped Zhang Lin with his aura to follow her movements.
Hong Chong and Cai Yinzhi's expressions turned serious as soon as Zhang Lin disappeared, but since they did not lock their auras on her like Hong Quan, they could not follow her movements.
"Did she succeed in chasing them, Father?"

"Yes." Hong Quan nodded to his son. "That little girl's speed is a few levels below Zhang Fei's, but her speed is obviously several levels above Yizhen's, and she can pat your wife's shoulder without any difficulty. Moreover, she doesn't have the wind element but the water element, so her speed is truly impressive."
"Do you think my father-in-law's speed can surpass theirs?"

Hong Quan thought for a moment before replying. "Yan Liejing's speed is truly remarkable, and he may be able to surpass the little girl's, but his fastest speed still won't be able to surpass Zhang Fei's."
Hong Chong took a deep breath before muttering. "If my father-in-law meets Zhang Fei, he will probably beg him to help him increase his speed, especially since he is too obsessed with speed."
"Xin'er, you accidentally found two talented monsters." Cai Yinzhi spoke softly, a satisfied smile on her old face.

"Haha." Hong Xinxin smiled bitterly at her grandmother's remark about Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin. "Grandma, I myself never thought that his speed could surpass my mother's and grandfather's, and I only discovered it a few days ago. Honestly, I still don't know how they practice, but he and his little sister are not the only ones who have such a high speed. Even his grandmother is much faster than senior cultivators like us, even though her cultivation is still in the Soul Realm now."

After they played cat and mouse for some time, the three returned to Hong Quan and the others. However, Yan Yizhen looked disappointed because Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin were able to surpass her speed, even though her cultivation was much higher than theirs. "Father."

"I know you are disappointed, but you must always remember that there is another sky above the sky. Your Yan Clan has always been considered the fastest because no one could match you in the past, but your match has appeared now, not just one but two." Yan Yizhen nodded to Hong Quan, who immediately asked Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin. "Can you two still increase your speed again?"
"Senior, I have just broken through to the Earth Realm, and my speed will increase again after I practice to the next stage." Zhang Lin was the first to answer.
Zhang Fei also answered him. "I still can't improve my speed for now, and I have to wait for my cultivation to break through to the quasi-divine realm first."

"I see." Hong Quan was actually curious about their training in increasing their speed, but he was not a nosy person, and he fully understood that everyone had their own secrets. "Since it's almost nighttime, let's have dinner together and talk about light things, especially about your relationship with Xin'er."
"Yes, Senior."
During dinner, Hong Quan and Cai Yinzhi asked Zhang Fei all kinds of questions, especially about the future of his relationship with Hong Xinxin.

Zhang Fei assured them that he would marry Hong Xinxin after his cultivation reached the Seven Divine Realms. Additionally, he distributed his basic pills to the four members of the Hong Clan, and he also gave them the Yin and Yang Purifying Pills, which elated them.

However, Zhang Fei had no intention of giving his other pills to them, especially the Youthful Retaining Pill and the Beauty Restoring Pill. After all, the effects of the two pills were too unbelievable, and their effects would only cause them a lot of trouble.
Zhang Fei suddenly spoke to them. "Senior, if the four of you want, I can also guide you to become soul cultivators like Xinxin."
"Eh?" Hong Quan and the others turned to Hong Xinxin directly. "Are you really a soul cultivator now?"

"That's right." Hong Xinxin nodded at them. "Zhang Fei helped me become a soul cultivator, and I feel much better now. Therefore, the four of you can learn from him, which will help you become stronger and less vulnerable to soul attacks."
"All right, we agree with that."

"You both praise me too much, seniors." Zhang Fei then told them.
"Xinxin trained me in the body cultivation path, and Master Hun trained me in the soul cultivation path.
I have many wives and partners, and they helped me in my cultivation, and I was able to reach this level thanks to them.
In addition, I also trained my mental strength in a special way, which I can't explain to you."
Hong Quan nodded in understanding while rubbing his long beard.
"I've lived for so long, but I've never met a cultivator as complete as you.
Xin'er also told me you were an alchemist and blacksmith; even the Nameless One couldn't walk all the cultivation paths like you."
"Senior, I still can't compare to the four of you, let alone the Nameless One." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head.
"The four of you are much stronger than me, and that man is the strongest in this universe, even though he cannot pursue all cultivation paths like me.
However, I am significantly younger than all of you, and the path ahead of me is still uncharted.
All I can do now is strive hard to improve myself in all areas, and I am confident that I can surpass all of you in the future.
At that time, I will stand at the pinnacle of the cultivation world, and no one will be able to harm me or those closest to me."
"Hahaha." Hong Quan laughed as he stood up and approached Zhang Fei.
"If it was someone else who said that, I would think that person was bragging.
However, you are different from others, and you have many advantages to stand at the pinnacle of the cultivation world.
I don't know when you will succeed in achieving your lofty dream, but I will definitely be there and witness your success.
Anyway, Xin'er told me that you still don't know how strong your true strength is, so I will help you measure it.
Therefore, you can attack me with all your strength, and I might be able to give you some pointers to improve your strength."

Zhang Fei himself was curious about his true strength, so he immediately followed Hong Quan's wishes by channeling all his strength into his fist, but he did not use all of his enhanced strength abilities.
*Bam*
Zhang Fei was stunned to see Hong Quan not budging from his spot even an inch, even though he had used all his strength to punch his abdomen, and the old man did not look like he was in any pain.
"Based on your attack just now, your true strength is still equivalent to quasi-divine realm cultivators." Hong Quan then asked him.
"Do you have enhanced strength techniques?"
"I have some, Senior."
"Use all of them at once."
"All right." Zhang Fei immediately used all of his enhanced strength abilities and punched Hong Quan's abdomen once again, but the old man was only pushed back an inch. 'Holy fudge!
A high-level cultivator and body cultivator like him is indeed terrifying, and his body strength is several times above mine.'
Hong Quang rubbed his beard as he thought for some time.
"I must admit that your enhanced strength abilities are truly amazing, especially since they can increase your strength to the level of cultivators in the Divine Expansion Realm.
If your body cultivation has reached the third stage, you might be able to face cultivators at the Divine Manifestation Realm.
However, enhanced abilities usually put an excessive burden on our bodies, so you can't use them for long-term combat.
If you are forced to use them because you are facing strong enemies, then you must finish the fight as quickly as possible.
Otherwise, you will lose to them, and you will also die in their hands."
"Grandpa, Zhang Fei's main advantage is not in his enhanced abilities but in his speed." Hong Xinxin said this to Hong Quan.
Hearing that, Hong Quan turned to his daughter-in-law.
"Yizhen, you are the fastest among us, so I want you to compete with Zhang Fei in speed."
"Yes, Father." Yan Yizhen replied in a soft voice.
Hong Quan then asked Zhang Fei.
"Do you mind showing us your speed, kid?
Yizhen comes from the Yan Clan in the Shandian Realm, and her clan focuses on speed, so you can compare your speed with hers."
"Not at all." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head.
"However, we can't possibly do it here, or I won't be able to use my maximum speed."
"Let's do it outside so you two can use your maximum speed." Hong Quan immediately led them out.
"Anyway, you don't need to hold back your speed, Yizhen."
Yan Yizhen was surprised to hear that, but she still agreed to Hong Quan's request.
"Yes, Father."

Arriving outside, Zhang Fei and Yan Yizhen immediately stood opposite each other, and Hong Quan locked his aura on them because he was sure he wouldn't be able to follow their movements without doing so.
Zhang Fei cupped his hands to Yan Yizhen before saying.
"Senior, I don't mean to belittle you, but you must use your highest speed, or I will catch you immediately."
Yan Yizhen and the others were surprised by Zhang Fei's confidence, so they turned to Hong Xinxin and Zhang Lin, who smiled confidently.
"Mother, he really didn't mean to underestimate you, and you will realize the truth of his speed once the two of you compete, so you should use your highest speed from the start."
Yan Yizhen's body was instantly enveloped by a green aura, but it didn't just come from her wind element, and there was something else fused with it.
"Get ready, Zhang Fei."
"I'm ready, senior."
Yan Yizhen immediately disappeared from their sight, but she was shocked because Zhang Fei suddenly patted her shoulder from behind.
She immediately activated her technique and accelerated her speed even further.
However, Zhang Fei continued to follow Yan Yizhen from the side, and he repeatedly patted her shoulder, giving her a tremendous shock. 'What the hell with his speed?
Our speed and technique are the best in the upper realms, but he can keep up with my movements.
Moreover, he hasn't used his wind element yet, and I won't be able to catch up to him if he does.'
Unlike Hong Xinxin and her family members, Zhang Lin could naturally watch Zhang Fei and Yan Yizhen's movements with naked eyes.
"Big Sis Xinxin, your mother's speed is amazing, but she will never be able to escape from my big brother."
"Can you see their movements, little girl?" Hong Chong asked.
Zhang Lin nodded at him.
"My brother is actually afraid of death because there are so many people by his side, so he keeps honing his speed, and his speed is several times faster than Senior Yizhen.
Actually, I can catch up to them because I have trained my speed using the same method, but my speed is still behind my big brother's."
"Try chasing them, little girl." Hong Quan immediately enveloped Zhang Lin with his aura to follow her movements.
Hong Chong and Cai Yinzhi's expressions turned serious as soon as Zhang Lin disappeared, but since they did not lock their auras on her like Hong Quan, they could not follow her movements.
"Did she succeed in chasing them, Father?"
"Yes." Hong Quan nodded to his son.
"That little girl's speed is a few levels below Zhang Fei's, but her speed is obviously several levels above Yizhen's, and she can pat your wife's shoulder without any difficulty.
Moreover, she doesn't have the wind element but the water element, so her speed is truly impressive."
"Do you think my father-in-law's speed can surpass theirs?"
Hong Quan thought for a moment before replying.
"Yan Liejing's speed is truly remarkable, and he may be able to surpass the little girl's, but his fastest speed still won't be able to surpass Zhang Fei's."
Hong Chong took a deep breath before muttering.
"If my father-in-law meets Zhang Fei, he will probably beg him to help him increase his speed, especially since he is too obsessed with speed."
"Xin'er, you accidentally found two talented monsters." Cai Yinzhi spoke softly, a satisfied smile on her old face.
"Haha." Hong Xinxin smiled bitterly at her grandmother's remark about Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin.
"Grandma, I myself never thought that his speed could surpass my mother's and grandfather's, and I only discovered it a few days ago.
Honestly, I still don't know how they practice, but he and his little sister are not the only ones who have such a high speed.
Even his grandmother is much faster than senior cultivators like us, even though her cultivation is still in the Soul Realm now."
After they played cat and mouse for some time, the three returned to Hong Quan and the others.
However, Yan Yizhen looked disappointed because Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin were able to surpass her speed, even though her cultivation was much higher than theirs.
"Father."
"I know you are disappointed, but you must always remember that there is another sky above the sky.

Your Yan Clan has always been considered the fastest because no one could match you in the past, but your match has appeared now, not just one but two." Yan Yizhen nodded to Hong Quan, who immediately asked Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin.
"Can you two still increase your speed again?"
"Senior, I have just broken through to the Earth Realm, and my speed will increase again after I practice to the next stage." Zhang Lin was the first to answer.
Zhang Fei also answered him.
"I still can't improve my speed for now, and I have to wait for my cultivation to break through to the quasi-divine realm first."
"I see." Hong Quan was actually curious about their training in increasing their speed, but he was not a nosy person, and he fully understood that everyone had their own secrets.
"Since it's almost nighttime, let's have dinner together and talk about light things, especially about your relationship with Xin'er."
"Yes, Senior."
During dinner, Hong Quan and Cai Yinzhi asked Zhang Fei all kinds of questions, especially about the future of his relationship with Hong Xinxin.
Zhang Fei assured them that he would marry Hong Xinxin after his cultivation reached the Seven Divine Realms.
Additionally, he distributed his basic pills to the four members of the Hong Clan, and he also gave them the Yin and Yang Purifying Pills, which elated them.
However, Zhang Fei had no intention of giving his other pills to them, especially the Youthful Retaining Pill and the Beauty Restoring Pill.
After all, the effects of the two pills were too unbelievable, and their effects would only cause them a lot of trouble.
Zhang Fei suddenly spoke to them.
"Senior, if the four of you want, I can also guide you to become soul cultivators like Xinxin."
"Eh?" Hong Quan and the others turned to Hong Xinxin directly.
"Are you really a soul cultivator now?"
"That's right." Hong Xinxin nodded at them.
"Zhang Fei helped me become a soul cultivator, and I feel much better now.
Therefore, the four of you can learn from him, which will help you become stronger and less vulnerable to soul attacks."
"All right, we agree with that."

chapters.title: Chapter 743: Training Space Changes
paragraphs: In the training space, all Zhang Fei's wives, partners, and family members were overjoyed as the quality and quantity of Qi within it increased significantly.
"What exactly happened? Why did the Qi here suddenly increase?" Hu Qiaomu asked Hu Lili.

Instead, Hu Yue answered Hu Qiaomu. "My husband decided to go to the Red Sun Realm, and this place is connected to his real body. Since that realm is in the upper realms, the quality and quantity of Qi in here is equal to there."
"Does that mean he will take us to the upper realm soon?"

"No." Hu Yue shook her head at Liu Rong. "It's true that not all cultivators in the upper realms have reached the seven divine realms, but there are countless cultivators at that level there, so he won't be reckless in taking us there. For the time being, his real body will stay in the Hong Clan for at least the next five months, so we don't have much time to relax, and we must make full use of this opportunity to reach the highest level possible. I don't know if it's possible, but I want to try reaching the Saint Realm before our seclusion ends."

"Even if the quality and quantity of Qi in this place have become much higher, we can't possibly reach the Saint Realm in just ten months." Hu Lili said with a shake of her head. "I think we could potentially reach the 5-Star Sovereign Realm, but we shouldn't hold unrealistic expectations of reaching the Saint Realm."

"That level will probably be our limit, but Hu Yue is different from us, Lili." Hu Lili looked at Zi'er directly. "Zhang Fe can help all his wives who were previously in the Soul Realm break through to the Earth Realm so quickly, so he might be able to help your daughter reach the Saint Realm faster than all of us."

However, Yang Yudie has a different opinion from her daughter-in-law. "Even though Zhang Fei can do that, the Saint Realm is still too far away for Hu Yue because her cultivation is still at the 2-Star Sovereign Realm, and she needs to break through eight times in the next ten months to reach that stage. Moreover, his cultivation is still at the 5-Star Earth Realm, so I think it's impossible for him to help her reach it."

"Whether it will work or not, I will try my best to reach that stage." Hu Yue then looked at the others. "Our overall strength will change after we come out of our seclusion, and we will be more prepared to face the outside world."

Shen Huang and the other senior cultivators nodded in agreement with Hu Yue. They immediately ignored it and went back to their cultivation, especially since time was ticking and they couldn't afford to waste even a second.
In another area, Yun Xinyue had already begun preparing for her breakthrough to the Seven Divine Realm, especially since she had postponed it for the sake of her marriage to Zhang Fei.
Yao Yin sighed softly as she looked at Yun Xinyue, making Xian Xianqin question her. "Why are you sighing?"

"I'm just a little envious of you two, especially since you broke through to the Seven Divine Realms months ago, and Xinyue is about to break through to that stage." Yao Yin then clenched her fists. "It took me a few years to break through to the Quasi-Divine Realm, so I'm a little doubtful whether I can break through to the Seven Divine Realms. Even if I can do it, it might take me a few decades to achieve it."

Xian Xianwu immediately embraced his wife. "You don't have to think too much about it, okay? Just like you, I myself doubt whether I can break through to the Seven Divine Realms, but I will not give up. Moreover, Zhang Fei has given us a way to reach that level, especially with the increasing quality and quantity of Qi in this place. Therefore, we don't need to burden our minds with such negative thoughts, and we just need to cultivate more diligently than usual."

"Xianwu is right, Yin." Qian Ying said with a nod. "This Qi is much denser and richer compared to the one in our realm, and it gives the two of you a greater chance of breaking through to the Seven Divine Realms, like us."
"How did you reach that stage so quickly, Ying?"

Qian Ying let out a soft sigh and touched Yao Yin's forehead, sharing some of her memories of when she fell into the hands of the demons. "I don't want to talk about that, so you can see everything for yourself."
Yao Yin nodded and looked at Qian Ying's memories for quite some time, but Xian Xianwu could feel that her body was shaking quite hard, so he could guess that her memories were really terrifying.
A while later, Yao Yin opened her eyes and looked at Qian Ying. "I-"

"No need." Qian Ying immediately shook her head. "Therefore, you don't need to burden your mind too much and let everything flow like water. With the current Qi in this place, you and Xianwu will definitely break through to that stage in time."
Yao Yin replied with a light nod. "You're right, Ying. Let's start our cultivation again."
Inside the room, Xu Ling'er looked restless, confusing Tasha. "What happened to you, Ling'er? Why do you like this?"
"I'm fine." Xu Ling'er hugged Tasha directly. "I suddenly remembered a lot of things, but not all of them are good things. I can't tell you everything yet, but I will tell you someday."
"I know; I'll wait for you to tell me everything yourself." Tasha then whispered something to Xu Ling'er.

Xu Ling'er smiled hearing that. "If you want to know about all that, you can go see Sister Lin later, and she will teach you a lot of things. She's too young compared to my mother and the others, but she's one of the best if you want to learn about them."
"How about you? Have you learned about them?"

"Naturally, I've learned about them, but I can't do anything yet." Xu Ling'er then touched Tasha's forehead and imparted something to her. He also gave the wolf girl a bottle of Zhang Fei's Yang Qi. "Learn the technique and cultivate Big Brother's Yang Qi."

Tasha seemed hesitant to drink Zhang Fei's Yang Qi, but she still drank it anyway, especially since she had heard about its beneficial effects. "He is a beast, and his Yang Qi is simply delicious to me."

"You can drink it again later, but you must learn the technique and cultivate his Yang Qi soon, or you will have a hard time resisting its effects." After Tasha closed her eyes, Xu Ling'er lay beside her and thought about the memories that came to her mind. 'All those memories should be a small part of Tian Huangjin's past memories, but I didn't expect that she lived in such a terrible era, and she had to witness many destructions during her era. Sigh! All those memories are weighing on my mind, so I have to talk to Big Brother about this.'
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]

A few hours later, the four members of the Hong Clan had successfully become soul cultivators thanks to Zhang Fei's guidance. He then turned to Hong Xinxin. "As long as they continue to increase their soul power, they will be stronger than non-soul cultivators like Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, so they don't need to be afraid of them."

"Unfortunately, the two of them are not the main force of the Shang Clan, especially since there are still Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun. They are both stronger than my two grandparents, so we will never be able to win against them as long as those two old men still exist." Hong Xinxin then asked him. "Are you going to enter seclusion again?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "My slaves in my home realm informed me that two powerful cultivators arrived there yesterday, so I plan to go back there to check the situation first. After that, I will go back into seclusion again to break through to the Heaven Realm in the next five months, and I will come out after that. For the time being, you can help your family monitor the situation in this realm, and you can contact my clone if something untoward happens. Although I am not yet able to fight against the cultivators in this realm, I am at least able to save all of you. When the situation in this realm is stable, I will take you to my private place, and you can focus on improving yourself."
"All right." Hong Xinxin nodded in agreement. "Once your body cultivation breaks through to the third stage, you should immediately bring your clone here, and we will go see Jin Ruyue."

After that, Zhang Fei sent Zhang Lin back to the training space, and he took Wu Lianzhi to Earth. At first, he wanted to send the little girl to train with the others, but her physical strength was still insufficient to train there, so he chose to postpone sending her there.

Upon arrival on Earth, Zhang Fei checked the location of the two cultivators on his map. He was momentarily surprised after learning their identities. 'Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, huh? I never expected them to escape all the way here, but their presence would be dangerous for the earthlings, especially if Shang Ziyuan managed to find them here.'
"What happened, Long'er? Is there a serious problem here?"
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Wu Lianzhi. "Those two cultivators are strong, but I can still handle them. You should wait for me here, and I will go over there to meet them."
Wu Lianzhi nodded. "I will wait for you here, but you have to come back quickly and take me back to the Nine Stars Realm, especially since the air in this realm is suffocating me."

Zhang Fei smiled at that because all cultivators were never comfortable with the air of the earth, including his slaves. However, Zheng Mohei and the others couldn't refute his orders, so they were forced to familiarize themselves with the earth's air.

In a few minutes, Zhang Fei had arrived at Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's location, where the two were quickly asleep on their flying artifact. He used the plant generation ability to create a small golden grass before burning it, and he used his wind element to direct the smoke towards them. 'This thousand-dream poppy will make them sleep long enough, and I will move them to another place.'
[Are you thinking about returning them to the Wasteland Realm, Master?]

'If I send them back to that realm, Shang Ziyuan's people will find them, and she will return there directly. I don't want her to return to the Red Sun Realm too soon, so Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan cannot continue with their plans.' After he waited for some time, Zhang Fei saw that Shang Baishi and Shang Xiyuan were already affected by the effects of the thousand-dream poppy, so he went over to them and sealed their cultivation. He then sent the two people to the Xian Realm and asked Zheng Mohei to watch over them, but he took their flying artifact for himself. 'This way, that woman will not be able to find them, and she will be busy looking for them.'

After that, Zhang Fei returned to Zhang Chen's residence and sent Wu Lianzhi back to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s side. He then returned to the training space, and he distributed the Yin and Yang Qi he got from Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin to those closest to him so they could break through faster by utilizing them.

Naturally, Zhang Fei did not give the Yang Qi from other men to some women, such as Hu Lili, Hu Qiaomu, Shen Huang, and other women. Instead, he gave his Yang Qi to them, especially since some of them were still unwilling to become his wives.

Zhang Fei did not dual cultivate with his wives because they still needed time to stabilize their cultivation. Instead, he engaged in dual soul cultivation with them, with the exception of Yun Xinyue, who was still in the process of breaking through.

Mai Xiaomeng sat by the side of a wooden tub while watching Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was focused on absorbing the remaining Jianshen Liquid in the water. She repeatedly looked into the water and swallowed her saliva at the sight of his dick. 'This kid is truly a monster! No wonder Xinxin changed her heart from Shang Guangming to him! Hmm? I am curious about his strength when he breaks through to the Seven Divine Realm and his body cultivation reaches higher levels; he will become truly powerful inside and out at that time.'

A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes and immediately came out of the wooden tub without paying any attention to Mai Xiaomeng. After he got dressed, he hurriedly left the bathroom to meet Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen, who were already waiting for him in the living room.
'Tch! This kid! He keeps ignoring me!' Mai Xiaomeng inwardly grumbled as she followed Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Release your souls." Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen immediately followed Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had already released his soul. In a few seconds, the three of them had already started dual soul cultivation.

Mai Xiaomeng sat beside them and observed their souls. 'Can he really do anything? The more I look at him, the more absurd I find him! He is clearly an alchemist, a dual cultivator, and a body cultivator, but he is also a soul cultivator. Moreover, his soul level should be quite high, or else he wouldn't be able to help these two women. Unfortunately, he didn't care about me, and he wasn't interested in me either. I have never felt so helpless to face a man, let alone one who was much younger than me, like him.'

Mai Xiaomeng repeatedly sighed in her heart as she watched Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women. In the end, she decided to leave their residence and go to the small island where the members of her race lived, especially since she still had to organize them.
Early in the morning, Zhang Fei [5] came out of the training space and went to Duan Zhou's residence, and he found everyone already preparing for the blacksmith competition.
Although Zhang Fei [5] came alone, Yuan Kong and Li Yanzhi were still afraid of him, especially after they learned some things about him.

However, the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm looked pale because they couldn't sleep all night, mainly because the incident between Zhang Fei [5] and Yuan Kong yesterday kept ringing in their minds, which made them restless and had difficulty concentrating for the blacksmith competition.

When the sun was high enough, Li Yanzhi immediately started the blacksmith competition between Duan Zhao's disciples and the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm. The first to go was Ah Hu against a middle-aged man of the same age, but their match was not easy because they had to forge a heaven-grade weapon, which usually took two to three days to complete.

Zhang Fei [5] did not want to miss the opportunity to witness their skills. He casually sat down on a large rock and watched the two men closely. He could see that they had different ways of forging, but Ah Hu's technique was similar to what Gang Zhishou had shown him before, especially since they learned blacksmithing from the same master.

Therefore, Zhang Fei [5] was more interested in observing the forging technique of the middle-aged man from the Divine Flame Realm, especially since the way he forged his weapon was softer. 'If I look closely, his technique is a bit similar to Tie Xuan's, but he still lacks experience compared to him.'

'All those memories should be a small part of Tian Huangjin's past memories, but I didn't expect that she lived in such a terrible era, and she had to witness many destructions during her era.
Sigh!
All those memories are weighing on my mind, so I have to talk to Big Brother about this.'
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]
A few hours later, the four members of the Hong Clan had successfully become soul cultivators thanks to Zhang Fei's guidance.
He then turned to Hong Xinxin.
"As long as they continue to increase their soul power, they will be stronger than non-soul cultivators like Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, so they don't need to be afraid of them."
"Unfortunately, the two of them are not the main force of the Shang Clan, especially since there are still Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun.
They are both stronger than my two grandparents, so we will never be able to win against them as long as those two old men still exist." Hong Xinxin then asked him.
"Are you going to enter seclusion again?"
Zhang Fei shook his head.
"My slaves in my home realm informed me that two powerful cultivators arrived there yesterday, so I plan to go back there to check the situation first.
After that, I will go back into seclusion again to break through to the Heaven Realm in the next five months, and I will come out after that.
For the time being, you can help your family monitor the situation in this realm, and you can contact my clone if something untoward happens.
Although I am not yet able to fight against the cultivators in this realm, I am at least able to save all of you.
When the situation in this realm is stable, I will take you to my private place, and you can focus on improving yourself."
"All right." Hong Xinxin nodded in agreement.
"Once your body cultivation breaks through to the third stage, you should immediately bring your clone here, and we will go see Jin Ruyue."
After that, Zhang Fei sent Zhang Lin back to the training space, and he took Wu Lianzhi to Earth.
At first, he wanted to send the little girl to train with the others, but her physical strength was still insufficient to train there, so he chose to postpone sending her there.
Upon arrival on Earth, Zhang Fei checked the location of the two cultivators on his map.
He was momentarily surprised after learning their identities. 'Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, huh?
I never expected them to escape all the way here, but their presence would be dangerous for the earthlings, especially if Shang Ziyuan managed to find them here.'
"What happened, Long'er?
Is there a serious problem here?"
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Wu Lianzhi.
"Those two cultivators are strong, but I can still handle them.
You should wait for me here, and I will go over there to meet them."
Wu Lianzhi nodded.
"I will wait for you here, but you have to come back quickly and take me back to the Nine Stars Realm, especially since the air in this realm is suffocating me."
Zhang Fei smiled at that because all cultivators were never comfortable with the air of the earth, including his slaves.
However, Zheng Mohei and the others couldn't refute his orders, so they were forced to familiarize themselves with the earth's air.
In a few minutes, Zhang Fei had arrived at Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's location, where the two were quickly asleep on their flying artifact.

He used the plant generation ability to create a small golden grass before burning it, and he used his wind element to direct the smoke towards them. 'This thousand-dream poppy will make them sleep long enough, and I will move them to another place.'
[Are you thinking about returning them to the Wasteland Realm, Master?]
'If I send them back to that realm, Shang Ziyuan's people will find them, and she will return there directly.

I don't want her to return to the Red Sun Realm too soon, so Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan cannot continue with their plans.' After he waited for some time, Zhang Fei saw that Shang Baishi and Shang Xiyuan were already affected by the effects of the thousand-dream poppy, so he went over to them and sealed their cultivation.

He then sent the two people to the Xian Realm and asked Zheng Mohei to watch over them, but he took their flying artifact for himself. 'This way, that woman will not be able to find them, and she will be busy looking for them.'
After that, Zhang Fei returned to Zhang Chen's residence and sent Wu Lianzhi back to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s side.

He then returned to the training space, and he distributed the Yin and Yang Qi he got from Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin to those closest to him so they could break through faster by utilizing them.
Naturally, Zhang Fei did not give the Yang Qi from other men to some women, such as Hu Lili, Hu Qiaomu, Shen Huang, and other women.
Instead, he gave his Yang Qi to them, especially since some of them were still unwilling to become his wives.
Zhang Fei did not dual cultivate with his wives because they still needed time to stabilize their cultivation.
Instead, he engaged in dual soul cultivation with them, with the exception of Yun Xinyue, who was still in the process of breaking through.
Mai Xiaomeng sat by the side of a wooden tub while watching Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was focused on absorbing the remaining Jianshen Liquid in the water.
She repeatedly looked into the water and swallowed her saliva at the sight of his dick. 'This kid is truly a monster!
No wonder Xinxin changed her heart from Shang Guangming to him!
Hmm?
I am curious about his strength when he breaks through to the Seven Divine Realm and his body cultivation reaches higher levels; he will become truly powerful inside and out at that time.'
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes and immediately came out of the wooden tub without paying any attention to Mai Xiaomeng.
After he got dressed, he hurriedly left the bathroom to meet Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen, who were already waiting for him in the living room.
'Tch!
This kid!
He keeps ignoring me!' Mai Xiaomeng inwardly grumbled as she followed Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Release your souls." Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen immediately followed Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had already released his soul.
In a few seconds, the three of them had already started dual soul cultivation.
Mai Xiaomeng sat beside them and observed their souls. 'Can he really do anything?
The more I look at him, the more absurd I find him!
He is clearly an alchemist, a dual cultivator, and a body cultivator, but he is also a soul cultivator.
Moreover, his soul level should be quite high, or else he wouldn't be able to help these two women.
Unfortunately, he didn't care about me, and he wasn't interested in me either.
I have never felt so helpless to face a man, let alone one who was much younger than me, like him.'
Mai Xiaomeng repeatedly sighed in her heart as she watched Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women.
In the end, she decided to leave their residence and go to the small island where the members of her race lived, especially since she still had to organize them.
Early in the morning, Zhang Fei [5] came out of the training space and went to Duan Zhou's residence, and he found everyone already preparing for the blacksmith competition.
Although Zhang Fei [5] came alone, Yuan Kong and Li Yanzhi were still afraid of him, especially after they learned some things about him.

However, the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm looked pale because they couldn't sleep all night, mainly because the incident between Zhang Fei [5] and Yuan Kong yesterday kept ringing in their minds, which made them restless and had difficulty concentrating for the blacksmith competition.
When the sun was high enough, Li Yanzhi immediately started the blacksmith competition between Duan Zhao's disciples and the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm.
The first to go was Ah Hu against a middle-aged man of the same age, but their match was not easy because they had to forge a heaven-grade weapon, which usually took two to three days to complete.
Zhang Fei [5] did not want to miss the opportunity to witness their skills.
He casually sat down on a large rock and watched the two men closely.
He could see that they had different ways of forging, but Ah Hu's technique was similar to what Gang Zhishou had shown him before, especially since they learned blacksmithing from the same master.

Therefore, Zhang Fei [5] was more interested in observing the forging technique of the middle-aged man from the Divine Flame Realm, especially since the way he forged his weapon was softer. 'If I look closely, his technique is a bit similar to Tie Xuan's, but he still lacks experience compared to him.'

chapters.title: Chapter 744: Situations
paragraphs: Shang Baishi had just opened his eyes, but he was shocked after finding himself in another place and his cultivation sealed. He immediately woke up Shang Xiaoyin, who was still sleeping soundly beside him. "Xiaoyin! Wake up."
"Hmm." Shang Xiaoyin groaned softly and rubbed her eyes. "Why did you wake me up, husband? I'm still worn out and want to rest."
"Wake up now! We have moved to a different location, and someone sealed our cultivation.
Shocked, Shang Xiaoyin sat up and looked around. "How could this happen? Did my mother find us?"
"I don't think it's your mother but someone else." Shang Baishi helped Shang Xiaoyin up and led her out. "Even though our cultivation is sealed, I believe this place is still in the lower realm."

"You're right." Shang Baishi pulled Shang Xiaoyin behind him as soon as Zheng Mohei appeared in front of them. "My master brought you here, but you two are still in the lower realm due to this realm's connection to the previous realm."
"Who is your master?" Shang Baishi inquired with vigilance, as he had previously been unable to detect anything.

Zheng Mohei shook his head. "You don't need to know my master's name, but you guys need not worry because he won't kill you two, especially since your wife is pregnant. Instead, you will be safe from Shang Ziyuan's pursuit as long as you stay here, and your wife can give birth in peace. If you need food or anything else, you can look for all your needs around here."
"Husband."

Shang Baishi nodded to his wife. "The man just now was indeed strong, but he wasn't as strong as us if our cultivation wasn't sealed, and he seemed to be a demon. Moreover, his master must have known us for a long time, or else he wouldn't know your mother's name. That man might be one of the strong cultivators in the upper realms, but I don't understand why he would concern himself with the lower realms or why he wanted to save us from your mother."
"Do you think my mother won't be able to find us here?"

"We don't have any information about this place, so I don't know if she can find us or not." Shang Baishi then looked around the surroundings of the Xian Realm. "This realm is quite peaceful, and I can't feel the presence of anyone else other than that man. Moreover, we can't do anything with our cultivation sealed, and that person probably has certain plans to bring us here, so we can only stay here for the time while waiting for you to give birth."

Shang Xiaoyin nodded in response. "This realm seems comfortable, so we can stay here for the time being until our child is born. Moreover, that man's master will probably meet us soon, and we can know his plans for us then. I hope he is not an enemy of our family, or he might harm our child. I don't mind if I have to die, but I don't want that to happen to our child."
"Me too." Shang Baishi rubbed her stomach. "Even though I still feel that your pregnancy is too fast, I am happy that you are carrying my child, and I will do anything to protect our child."
"Yeah." Shang Xiaoyin immediately took his hand. "Since we will be here for a while, I want to explore the area first to find the best spots."

Shang Baishi walked beside her while looking around. "This realm is too small compared to the Wasteland Realm, let alone compared to the Red Sun Realm. We might be able to explore the entire realm area in a few days, but I still don't understand why there's no one here."
"Do you think that man's master has killed all the inhabitants?"

"That's possible." Shang Baishi nodded slightly. "However, it is none of our business, so we don't need to think about it. I just hope that man will come to see us soon; I want to know his identity and his intentions towards us."

Meanwhile, Zheng Mohei watched Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin from a distance, but he was curious as to why Zhang Fei didn't kill the two, especially after the cruelty he had shown when they attacked the Tian Realm and slaughtered so many winged races.

Helian Yueyi sat alone on the veranda looking up at the sky, but her face was quite pale, and her eyes were swollen. Her conversation with Zhang Fei last night kept bothering her mind, making it difficult for her to calm down or sleep. "What should I do to stop him? I don't want to die or see my children die, but I can't possibly fulfill his wish to kill my husband."
*Tap... Tap...*
Helian Yueyi turned towards the sound of footsteps. "Why did you come here, Lian'er?"

"What are you thinking about, Mother? Are you still thinking about Xiaoying and Xiaomei's condition?" Huangfu Lian returned the question, quickened his pace, and sat down next to Helian Yueyi. "I heard Senior Tiannan will be back in two weeks, and he brought someone from the Huangfu Clan with him."
"Did your father tell you about them?"
Huangfu Lian replied with a shake of his head. "My father never told me about them, and Grandpa Ling told me last night. So what's bothering you? Why is your face so pale?"

Helian Yueyi hesitated to tell her son the truth, but Zhang Fei's threat stressed her too much. "A powerful and evil cultivator wants to destroy our family, but I can't tell your father about him because he keeps monitoring us. He repeatedly infiltrated this palace without anyone knowing, including your father. He threatened me that he would kill you or your siblings if I told your father about this matter, and he ordered me to kill your father if I wanted us to survive."

'I'm sorry, Mother. My inability to defeat Zhang Fei left us in this situation, and I have become his slave now.' Huangfu Lian then asked. "Who exactly is that person? Why does he want to destroy our family?"

"Zhang Fei." Huangfu Lian pretended to be shocked so that Helian Yueyi would not be suspicious of him. "If your father wasn't obsessed with capturing him, we wouldn't be in this situation now. That brat apparently has a terrifying background, and his father is a powerful cultivator from the upper realms. I met him a few times, and one of his wives has an extraordinary status in the Red Sun Realm."

This time, Huangfu Lian was truly shocked by Helian Yueyi's answer. He knew that Zhang Fei came from another realm, but he thought that he came from the lower realms. Moreover, he knew nothing about his true background or the people around him, except for Feng Yao and Shang Yumei, who had helped him before. "Are you sure about that, Mother?"

"Do I need to lie to you?" Helian Yueyi then leaned back in her chair. "A month ago, I tried to track down the whereabouts of a mysterious woman in the Zhou Kingdom, and I met Zhang Fei's father there. I thought he was just an ordinary man because his cultivation was only at the 4-Star Earth Realm, but he apparently disguised it. I followed him when he went somewhere else, and the mysterious woman turned out to be one of his wives. She was able to restrict my movements so easily, and I couldn't do anything to free myself from her, but they didn't do anything to me and released me before they returned to their realm. After I returned, I asked your father to ask Senior Tiannan about her identity, and he told him that Hong Xinxin was the young miss of the Hong Clan, one of the powerful clans in that realm. They have a stellar reputation and influence in the upper realms; even the ancestors of the Huangfu Clan would not dare to confront them directly."
"Then, how can you be sure that that man is Zhang Fei's father?" Huangfu Lian asked in confusion.

Helian Yueyi let out a heavy sigh. "A few days later, Sister Yanxi and I met him at Zhang Fei's restaurant in the Yun Royal Capital, and he revealed to us that he was his father. At first, I didn't believe him, so I came to Yun Xinyue's wedding, and he was present with Hong Xinxin. He had a close relationship with everyone there; even the Beast Emperor and the Elf Emperor were also familiar with him."
'Mother! You have been fooled by Zhang Fei! That man is not his father but himself!' Naturally, Huangfu Lian could not tell Helian Yueyi that. "So aren't you going to talk to my father about this?"

Helian Yueyi frowned at her son. "How could I possibly tell your father about this matter? I already told you that man was constantly monitoring us, and he gave me a choice between our safety or your father's life. He has infiltrated your two sisters' rooms twice, and they are in a helpless state now. I fear that if I inform your father about this, he will immediately kill them."

'That guy is truly evil, mother! You would probably die of shock if you knew all his actions, including his action of turning Du She into Ruo Yanxi. Right now, all of us are already in his grasp, including Grandpa Ling.' Huangfu Lian then stood up, walked behind Helian Yueyi, and hugged her from behind. "I know we are in a difficult situation, but I am confident that we can get through it. We just need to wait for the right time. Senior Tiannan and the people from the Huangfu Clan will probably realize our situation, and they might be able to save us from that evil man."

"I don't have your self-confidence." Helian Yueyi rubbed her son's arm. "I don't mind if I die, but I'm afraid that he will hurt you and your two sisters. If the situation worsens, I want you to take Xiaoying and Xiaomei away from this kingdom, and you must take them to hide as far as possible so that he cannot find the three of you."

'Unfortunately, there is no safe place in this realm because I am his slave, and he can order me around at will.' Huangfu Lian could only say that in his heart. "I'll go see Xiaomei and Xiaoying now."
"All right." Helian Yueyi closed her eyes after her son left. 'Will he come to see me again tonight? If he comes to me again, I must try hard to persuade him not to destroy our family.'
Zhou Xiaochuan, who was lying sick in bed, was shocked after one of his ministers told him that his treasury had been emptied and nothing was left.
"What should I do, Emperor?"

"Leave." The minister simply nodded and left Zhou Xiaochuan's room. "Who dares to infiltrate my palace? How did the culprit manage to infiltrate here without anyone knowing? Could it be those two people who did it? No one has dared to infiltrate here for hundreds of years, and this is the first time this has happened. Furthermore, I still can't figure out my situation; I suddenly felt sick like this four days ago. All my meridians are blocked, and I haven't been able to move my body for the past four days; even the imperial physicians couldn't cure me."

Zhou Xiaochuan then contacted his three aides to ask about the continuation of his order to attack the Yun Kingdom. However, he was disappointed because Zhou Hanling, Zhou Fanzhi, and Zhou Fenghu still had not succeeded in conquering the kingdom. The three inform him that they encountered fierce resistance from Yun Shang's troops. "Those bastards! If I weren't in this condition, I would go there and kill the three of them directly! I've given them the best troops to conquer that kingdom, but they still haven't managed to take it over."
Zhou Xiaochuan then contacted Kong Zhi to ask for his help. To his surprise, the old man was already in his palace, so he asked him to meet him directly.

Kong Zhi naturally knew that Zhou Xiaochuan was in such a condition because of Zhang Fei, especially since he had ordered the old man to meet him. "Oh? What happened to you, Old Zhou? Why did your condition become like this?"

"Old Kong! I became like this four days ago, and I haven't found the cause yet." Kong Zhi laughed in his heart when he heard that and approached Zhou Xiaochuan directly. "Anyway, I asked you here to help me open the blockade on my meridians."

"Do you think I will help you?" Kong Zhi then took out a dagger and pressed it against Zhou Xiaochuan's neck, causing him to frown. "You must know that I had a long-standing ambition to seize your position, right? Back then, I didn't dare because those demons protected you, but they were still in the Star Tower and hadn't returned. Moreover, you are in this condition now, and you will go straight to hell once I slit your throat."

"Hahaha." Zhou Xiaochuan laughed instead. "Old Kong, I have known you for a long time, and you are not someone who would commit such a lowly act by killing defenseless people. If you really wanted to kill me, you would have killed me by now."

"You're right, I would never do such a lowly act, but I might if I had to." Kong Zhi immediately put away his dagger and grabbed Zhou Xiaochuan's hand. He then tried to open the blockade on the Zhou Emperor's meridians, but he gave up halfway. "Unfortunately, I can't help you, Old Zhou. It's unclear how your meridians got blocked, but I think you were exposed to something without your knowledge, and someone close to you may have done it."

Zhou Xiaochuan frowned for a moment. "Feiling and my other wives were dying in their rooms, so they couldn't have done it. All my sons were out hunting Jiang Tingxi and her Jiang Clan, and I would definitely know if they did something to me."
"What about Zhou Fengyu and the others?"

"Zhou Hanling, Zhou Fanzhi, and Zhou Fenghu had already left for the Yun Kingdom's border before I fell ill." Zhou Xiaochuan pondered for a moment before continuing. "Perhaps they did something before they left, and I was unaware of their actions. However, they have always been loyal to me, so I find it hard to believe that they did it to me."

'What a fool! The three of them have become Zhang Fei's slaves, and your most important people have also fallen into his hands, so you can only wait for your downfall.' Kong Zhi then stood up. "Actually, I came here to look for your daughter, but she still hasn't returned, so I'll be leaving now."
"Wait a minute, Old Kong." Kong Zhi turned to Zhou Xiaochuan. "Zhou Shenxin and Jiang Tingxi have clearly betrayed me, so I hope you can bring them back to me, and I will punish them severely."
'Do you think you still have a chance at that?' Kong Zhi nodded at him. "All right, I will bring them to you if I manage to find them."

After Kong Zhi left, Zhou Xiaochuan thought of something and called one of his ministers. Before long, a middle-aged man had arrived in his room. "Old Yang, I want you to take me to see someone, especially since only that person can cure me."
"Yes, Emperor. I will prepare a horse carriage now so the citizens will not know about your health condition."

Some time later, Zhou Xiaochuan and his minister arrived at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s residence, but he did not meet them right away because he was still busy tempering his body. Instead, he sent Shang Xinyu to meet them. "He is busy with something else right now, and he will meet you two after he is done. However, I can't say for sure when he will be done, so you can wait until he is done."

If someone else treated him like that, Zhou Xiaochuan would definitely be furious, but he didn't dare to do anything now, especially with his body in such a condition. "Please tell him that I'm waiting for him."
"All right."
