He has infiltrated your two sisters' rooms twice, and they are in a helpless state now.
I fear that if I inform your father about this, he will immediately kill them."
'That guy is truly evil, mother!
You would probably die of shock if you knew all his actions, including his action of turning Du She into Ruo Yanxi.
Right now, all of us are already in his grasp, including Grandpa Ling.' Huangfu Lian then stood up, walked behind Helian Yueyi, and hugged her from behind.
"I know we are in a difficult situation, but I am confident that we can get through it.
We just need to wait for the right time.
Senior Tiannan and the people from the Huangfu Clan will probably realize our situation, and they might be able to save us from that evil man."
"I don't have your self-confidence." Helian Yueyi rubbed her son's arm.
"I don't mind if I die, but I'm afraid that he will hurt you and your two sisters.
If the situation worsens, I want you to take Xiaoying and Xiaomei away from this kingdom, and you must take them to hide as far as possible so that he cannot find the three of you."
'Unfortunately, there is no safe place in this realm because I am his slave, and he can order me around at will.' Huangfu Lian could only say that in his heart.
"I'll go see Xiaomei and Xiaoying now."
"All right." Helian Yueyi closed her eyes after her son left. 'Will he come to see me again tonight?
If he comes to me again, I must try hard to persuade him not to destroy our family.'
Zhou Xiaochuan, who was lying sick in bed, was shocked after one of his ministers told him that his treasury had been emptied and nothing was left.
"What should I do, Emperor?"
"Leave." The minister simply nodded and left Zhou Xiaochuan's room.
"Who dares to infiltrate my palace?
How did the culprit manage to infiltrate here without anyone knowing?
Could it be those two people who did it?
No one has dared to infiltrate here for hundreds of years, and this is the first time this has happened.
Furthermore, I still can't figure out my situation; I suddenly felt sick like this four days ago.
All my meridians are blocked, and I haven't been able to move my body for the past four days; even the imperial physicians couldn't cure me."
Zhou Xiaochuan then contacted his three aides to ask about the continuation of his order to attack the Yun Kingdom.
However, he was disappointed because Zhou Hanling, Zhou Fanzhi, and Zhou Fenghu still had not succeeded in conquering the kingdom.
The three inform him that they encountered fierce resistance from Yun Shang's troops.
"Those bastards!
If I weren't in this condition, I would go there and kill the three of them directly!
I've given them the best troops to conquer that kingdom, but they still haven't managed to take it over."
Zhou Xiaochuan then contacted Kong Zhi to ask for his help.
To his surprise, the old man was already in his palace, so he asked him to meet him directly.
Kong Zhi naturally knew that Zhou Xiaochuan was in such a condition because of Zhang Fei, especially since he had ordered the old man to meet him.
"Oh?
What happened to you, Old Zhou?
Why did your condition become like this?"
"Old Kong!
I became like this four days ago, and I haven't found the cause yet." Kong Zhi laughed in his heart when he heard that and approached Zhou Xiaochuan directly.
"Anyway, I asked you here to help me open the blockade on my meridians."
"Do you think I will help you?" Kong Zhi then took out a dagger and pressed it against Zhou Xiaochuan's neck, causing him to frown.
"You must know that I had a long-standing ambition to seize your position, right?
Back then, I didn't dare because those demons protected you, but they were still in the Star Tower and hadn't returned.
Moreover, you are in this condition now, and you will go straight to hell once I slit your throat."
"Hahaha." Zhou Xiaochuan laughed instead.
"Old Kong, I have known you for a long time, and you are not someone who would commit such a lowly act by killing defenseless people.
If you really wanted to kill me, you would have killed me by now."
"You're right, I would never do such a lowly act, but I might if I had to." Kong Zhi immediately put away his dagger and grabbed Zhou Xiaochuan's hand.
He then tried to open the blockade on the Zhou Emperor's meridians, but he gave up halfway.
"Unfortunately, I can't help you, Old Zhou.
It's unclear how your meridians got blocked, but I think you were exposed to something without your knowledge, and someone close to you may have done it."
Zhou Xiaochuan frowned for a moment.
"Feiling and my other wives were dying in their rooms, so they couldn't have done it.
All my sons were out hunting Jiang Tingxi and her Jiang Clan, and I would definitely know if they did something to me."
"What about Zhou Fengyu and the others?"
"Zhou Hanling, Zhou Fanzhi, and Zhou Fenghu had already left for the Yun Kingdom's border before I fell ill." Zhou Xiaochuan pondered for a moment before continuing.
"Perhaps they did something before they left, and I was unaware of their actions.
However, they have always been loyal to me, so I find it hard to believe that they did it to me."
'What a fool!
The three of them have become Zhang Fei's slaves, and your most important people have also fallen into his hands, so you can only wait for your downfall.' Kong Zhi then stood up.
"Actually, I came here to look for your daughter, but she still hasn't returned, so I'll be leaving now."
"Wait a minute, Old Kong." Kong Zhi turned to Zhou Xiaochuan.
"Zhou Shenxin and Jiang Tingxi have clearly betrayed me, so I hope you can bring them back to me, and I will punish them severely."
'Do you think you still have a chance at that?' Kong Zhi nodded at him.
"All right, I will bring them to you if I manage to find them."
After Kong Zhi left, Zhou Xiaochuan thought of something and called one of his ministers.
Before long, a middle-aged man had arrived in his room.
"Old Yang, I want you to take me to see someone, especially since only that person can cure me."
"Yes, Emperor.
I will prepare a horse carriage now so the citizens will not know about your health condition."
Some time later, Zhou Xiaochuan and his minister arrived at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s residence, but he did not meet them right away because he was still busy tempering his body.
Instead, he sent Shang Xinyu to meet them.
"He is busy with something else right now, and he will meet you two after he is done.
However, I can't say for sure when he will be done, so you can wait until he is done."
If someone else treated him like that, Zhou Xiaochuan would definitely be furious, but he didn't dare to do anything now, especially with his body in such a condition.
"Please tell him that I'm waiting for him."
"All right."

When the night came, Zhang Xiaolong [3] finally stopped his training and met Zhou Xiaochuan, who had been waiting for him since morning. "Oh? Why is your condition like this?"

Zhou Xiaochuan was naturally furious because Zhang Xiaolong [3] had kept him waiting for a whole day, but he did not dare to express his anger. On the other hand, the minister looked puzzled after seeing him, especially since he looked so young, but he dared to treat the Zhou emperor like that.

Zhou Xiaochuan immediately replied to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Senior, I don't know what happened to my body, but I've been like this for the past four days. All the imperial physicians and an acquaintance of mine couldn't cure my illness, so I decided to come to you to ask for your help."
'Why did my emperor address this young man as a senior?' The minister wondered.

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding before speaking. "You were exposed to something that caused all your meridians to become blocked and your motor nerves to become uncontrollable, so you can't move your body."
"You're right, Senior."

"Do you still remember our conversation five days ago, Zhou Xiaochuan?" The minister wanted to rebuke Zhang Xiaolong [3] for calling his emperor by his name directly, but the Zhou Emperor immediately stopped him. "Is your throne and authority worth more than your life and the lives of your six wives? I can cure all of you in less than an hour, but the choice is yours. If you prefer your throne and authority to your lives, you can return to your palace now, especially since I will only cure all of you if you are willing to exchange both for your lives. Otherwise, you can forget about asking for my help, and you guys will probably die in the end."
"You—" The minister swallowed his saliva because Zhang Xiaolong [3] had suddenly moved behind him, with his hongxi dagger pressing on his neck, causing it to bleed.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] pressed his dagger a little deeper. "I don't care about your identity or status in this kingdom, but I will kill you if you dare interrupt my conversation with Zhou Xiaochuan."

The minister broke out in a cold sweat because of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s threat, but Zhou Xiaochuan then spoke. "Please spare him, Senior. He is the best minister in my kingdom, and he has no ill intentions."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] said nothing and returned to his seat. "So what's your answer?"
"Forgive me, but I don't have an answer right now, and I—"
"Go back now and don't come here until you have an answer." Zhang Xiaolong [3] instantly disappeared from their sight.
Zhou Xiaochuan was furious and disappointed. "Bring me back to the palace."
"Yes, Emperor."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just watched their departure from the inner area. Shang Xinyu then asked him. "How long are you going to toy with that fellow, Long'er? Why don't you just end things with him?"
"That guy, all his wives, and his kingdom are already in your grasp. Rather than continuing to stall for time, I think it's better if you end your plans for them sooner." Shang Yifen added.

[Master, I understand your desires for Zhou Xiaochuan, but these two women are right. You have been stalling for too long, and you should settle everything as soon as possible. Therefore, you don't need to bother with trivial matters anymore, and you can focus on all your personal affairs. Also, you still have to go to the Nine Hells Darkland and other realms, so don't waste time here. Once your business with the Zhou Kingdom is finished, you can continue with the Huangfu Kingdom directly.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to them. "You guys are right; I will take care of things in this kingdom right now. After that, we will focus on our dual soul cultivation, but we will do it while forging our bodies."
"Eh?" Shang Yifen turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in surprise. "Do you really want to do that?"
"Are you embarrassed, Yifen?" Shang Yifen nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "It will take too long to cultivate our bodies and souls separately, so we will do both at once."
Shang Yifen let out a soft sigh before nodding. "You're right, but I think we should do it in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place, and the beast blood will have a more significant effect on our bodies."

"Shang Xiaoyin's secret place is no longer useful because I have moved the blood of the beast to another place. I kept half of it in my private place and half on the western island, so we must go there." Shang Xiaolong [3]'s revelation surprised Shang Yifen, especially since she hadn't been to that place for a long time, so she didn't know that he had already removed the beast blood from that place. "Anyway, I will go to the Zhou Royal Palace now, and I will settle my business with Zhou Xiaochuan today."

Meanwhile, Zhou Xiaochuan had just arrived at his royal chamber, and the minister immediately left him there. His expression was truly angry because Zhang Xiaolong [3] kept forcing him to hand over his throne and authority for the sake of his recovery and that of his six wives. He had sacrificed too much to strengthen his power, and he had also made many plans to become the sole ruler of the human island, but various changes in the situation that occurred recently caused all his plans to fall apart.

Zhou Xiaochuan pondered about everything seriously, and he felt that the situation started at the same time as Zhang Fei appeared in the Nine Stars Realm. His second son died in the Star Tower, and his other four sons disappeared without a trace. Zhou Shenxin and Jiang Tingxi betrayed him, and his ambition to rule the two demon kingdoms failed miserably because of the beast rampage. Upon his return from the demon island, a mysterious illness immediately affected his six wives."

Despite having no concrete evidence, Shou Xiaochuan felt that his guess about all the troubles that had fallen on him was correct. 'I'm sure those two people have something to do with Zhang Fei, but I don't understand how he could have a relationship with two powerful people. That guy has a relationship with the Yun and Xian Kingdoms; I'm sure they're blocking Zhou Hanling and the others from attacking the Yun Kingdom.'
"Are you still confused about your situation?"
Zhou Xiaochuan was shocked when he heard that and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just appeared in his room. "How did you manage to infiltrate here?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed. "Your protection is too weak to stop me, and I can come in here whenever I want."
"Did you do all this to me and my six wives on purpose?"

"You finally realized it, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to his true form, shocking Zhou Xiaochuan. "We never had any problems in the past, but Zhou Tong wanted to kill me in the Star Tower. Unfortunately, he failed because Xiang Changyue was by my side, but I couldn't kill him either because he was stronger than me at that time. After that, you sent Zhou Shenxin and Zhou Hanling to capture me, and I heard from them that you wanted to control me with the help of the demons behind you. Therefore, I tracked down the whereabouts of Ju Yingzhi and refused. In the end, they both joined my organization, your daughter became my lover, and your aide became my slave."

"You—" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately suppressed Zhou Xiaochuan with his killing intent, causing cold sweat to begin to drip down his forehead. 'This bastard! His killing intent is more terrifying and oppressive than Ju Yingzhi's!'

"To tell you the truth, I ordered Xin Yanluo to send you to the demon island, and I also made the demon beasts rampage because I needed time to take you down." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened a portal to the training space, shocking Zhou Xiaochuan, especially once Zhou Shenxin and Jiang Tingxi walked out of it. "You may not be aware of the real situation yet, but Zhou Tong, Zhou Fang, Zhou Fenghu, Zhou Fanshi, and all your generals are already subject to me. Oh! Zhou Meiling and your other four sons are also in my hands, and I lock them up in a special place. Additionally, the Yun and Xian Kingdoms' troops have already taken over three-quarters of your kingdom's territory, so your status as emperor is empty because only your ministers remain, and I will force them to submit soon."
All of this shocked Zhou Xiaochuan further, but he then shouted at his concubine and daughter. "You two are traitors!"

Zhou Shenxin simply smiled at that. "Father, I have endured everything for decades, but I will not hold myself back anymore. Since I was a child, I have been aware of my situation, as I was born a woman. Despite this, I didn't want to give up, and I strove hard to be the best. In the end, I became even better than Zhou Tong, but you never appreciated my hard work, and you kept treating me as a tool because I was a woman. You knew that I would never be able to win against Zhang Fei, but you still sent me to him, which means you wanted to sacrifice me. Fortunately, he didn't kill me, and he offered me a better opportunity, so I agreed to join him and become his lover. I knew you would realize my strangeness after I refused to follow your orders, and I knew you would vent your anger on my mother, so I asked him to save her."

Jiang Tingxi also spoke to him. "Husband, I don't want it to happen, but I have no other choice. I have never questioned or challenged your attitude toward me because I don't have the strength to do it, but I was disappointed that you want to sacrifice our daughter to fulfill your ambition. Unfortunately, you don't have the chance to regret it because all your important people are already in Zhang Fei's hands, and he will push our daughter to the throne to replace you."

"Hahaha!" After hearing all that, Zhou Xiaochuan laughed loudly, as the truth dealt a heavy blow to him. He had always been confident in himself and his strength, and he had also always believed that no one would dare to betray him, but his wife and daughter had already betrayed him.
"Are you going to end up a lunatic, Old Zhou?"
Zhou Xiaochuan immediately looked at Kong Zhi, who had just arrived. "Have you also decided to join them, Old Kong?"
"I didn't join them, but I had no other choice because Zhang Fei is my master now, and it happened the night after we returned from the demon island."

"Amazing! You are truly amazing, Zhang Fei!" Zhou Xiaochuan said to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in a high tone. "I have been an emperor for several hundred years, but I never thought that I would fall into the hands of a brat like you."

"Heh!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] snorted and moved beside Zhou Xiaochuan. "Age has nothing to do with this, foolish emperor. We are both arrogant and always confident in ourselves, but I am not overconfident like you, and I have always believed that there is another sky above the sky. Unlike you, I prefer to operate in the background, ensuring that my adversaries remain unaware of my actions."
Zhou Xiaochuan stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] for a while. "Kill me."

"Kill you? Aunt Tingxi already told you that I would push Shenxin to the throne to replace you, so I still need you to help her." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Zhou Shenxin, who immediately approached him and released her soul.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pulled Zhou Xiaochuan's soul out of his body, replicated it, and merged it with Zhou Shenxin's soul. After that, he planted his demon slave mark into his original soul before returning it to his body.

"Starting today, you are my slave, and you must prepare everything for Shenxin to ascend the throne." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then forced Zhou Xiaochuan to swallow an antidote so his condition would return to normal. "After her reign stabilizes, you can die at that time."

Zhou Xiaochuan's face was deathly pale as he imagined himself as an emperor becoming the slave of a brat like Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Jiang Tingxi also let out a soft sigh after witnessing all that. "Send me back to your place, Zhang Fei."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent Jiang Tingxi into the training space, but Zhou Shenxin decided to accompany her because she understood her mother's feelings. He then turned to Kong Zhi. "I want you to stay here and help this foolish emperor to prepare everything, and Shenxin will ascend the throne in five months."

"Yes, Master." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] left the room, Kong Zhi spoke to Zhou Xiaochuan. "He's right, Old Zhou. We both used to be arrogant and overconfident, and we never realized all his actions until it was too late. Unfortunately, regret always comes too late, and we are both his slaves now. Even if he didn't enslave us, we would never be able to fight him, especially since many people on his side were too powerful for us."
Zhou Xiaochuan said nothing to reply to Kong Zhi, and he regretted all his carelessness that had caused him to fall into such a situation. 'Bastard! I won't let myself end up like this!'

After he left Zhou Xiaochuan's room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to Dong Feiling and the others' room to heal them. He decided to use his memory manipulation on them, but he did not alter their old memories. Instead, he added a little new memory to them, and they would fully support Zhou Shenxin when she ascended the throne to become the empress, so no one would be able to fight him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to his residence in the Zhou Kingdom, and he sent Wu Lianzhi into his training space. However, he did not let the little girl train because her body was not ready to face the greater gravity, and he asked her to stay with Xu Ling'er, who was the same age as her.
Since he didn't know the situation in the Wasteland Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu into an invisible state before bringing the two of them into that realm.

Upon their arrival at the small beast blood pond on the western island, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women immediately soaked in it. They were not only tempering their bodies, but they were also cultivating their souls.

On the eastern island, Tianguo, who was in his black fox form, noticed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s return. 'Hmm? That heavenly fox brat left this realm not long ago, but his strength has increased quite significantly, especially his soul power. Moreover, I could feel that he was also monitoring me, so I thought our meeting wouldn't be long. If he thinks he can conquer me, I will teach him a harsh lesson he will never forget.'

Two weeks passed quickly, and the blacksmith competition was nearing its peak. Unfortunately, two of Duan Zhou's four disciples, An Hu and Gang Zhishou, were defeated by the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm, but Xian Xian and Lu Zhong managed to secure victory, making the score even.
Since the seniors had finished competing, the young blacksmiths from both realms took turns competing with each other, including Zhang Fei [5], who faced off against a young male blacksmith.
"Since your blacksmith ranks are still at the spirit rank, you will compete to create a spirit-grade weapon." They nodded at Li Yanzhi. "Let's begin."

"Hahaha!" After hearing all that, Zhou Xiaochuan laughed loudly, as the truth dealt a heavy blow to him.
He had always been confident in himself and his strength, and he had also always believed that no one would dare to betray him, but his wife and daughter had already betrayed him.
"Are you going to end up a lunatic, Old Zhou?"
Zhou Xiaochuan immediately looked at Kong Zhi, who had just arrived.
"Have you also decided to join them, Old Kong?"
"I didn't join them, but I had no other choice because Zhang Fei is my master now, and it happened the night after we returned from the demon island."
"Amazing!
You are truly amazing, Zhang Fei!" Zhou Xiaochuan said to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in a high tone.
"I have been an emperor for several hundred years, but I never thought that I would fall into the hands of a brat like you."
"Heh!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] snorted and moved beside Zhou Xiaochuan.
"Age has nothing to do with this, foolish emperor.
We are both arrogant and always confident in ourselves, but I am not overconfident like you, and I have always believed that there is another sky above the sky.
Unlike you, I prefer to operate in the background, ensuring that my adversaries remain unaware of my actions."
Zhou Xiaochuan stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] for a while.
"Kill me."
"Kill you?

Aunt Tingxi already told you that I would push Shenxin to the throne to replace you, so I still need you to help her." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Zhou Shenxin, who immediately approached him and released her soul.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pulled Zhou Xiaochuan's soul out of his body, replicated it, and merged it with Zhou Shenxin's soul.
After that, he planted his demon slave mark into his original soul before returning it to his body.

"Starting today, you are my slave, and you must prepare everything for Shenxin to ascend the throne." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then forced Zhou Xiaochuan to swallow an antidote so his condition would return to normal.
"After her reign stabilizes, you can die at that time."
Zhou Xiaochuan's face was deathly pale as he imagined himself as an emperor becoming the slave of a brat like Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Jiang Tingxi also let out a soft sigh after witnessing all that.
"Send me back to your place, Zhang Fei."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent Jiang Tingxi into the training space, but Zhou Shenxin decided to accompany her because she understood her mother's feelings.
He then turned to Kong Zhi.
"I want you to stay here and help this foolish emperor to prepare everything, and Shenxin will ascend the throne in five months."
"Yes, Master." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] left the room, Kong Zhi spoke to Zhou Xiaochuan.
"He's right, Old Zhou.
We both used to be arrogant and overconfident, and we never realized all his actions until it was too late.
Unfortunately, regret always comes too late, and we are both his slaves now.
Even if he didn't enslave us, we would never be able to fight him, especially since many people on his side were too powerful for us."
Zhou Xiaochuan said nothing to reply to Kong Zhi, and he regretted all his carelessness that had caused him to fall into such a situation. 'Bastard!
I won't let myself end up like this!'
After he left Zhou Xiaochuan's room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to Dong Feiling and the others' room to heal them.
He decided to use his memory manipulation on them, but he did not alter their old memories.
Instead, he added a little new memory to them, and they would fully support Zhou Shenxin when she ascended the throne to become the empress, so no one would be able to fight him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to his residence in the Zhou Kingdom, and he sent Wu Lianzhi into his training space.
However, he did not let the little girl train because her body was not ready to face the greater gravity, and he asked her to stay with Xu Ling'er, who was the same age as her.
Since he didn't know the situation in the Wasteland Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu into an invisible state before bringing the two of them into that realm.
Upon their arrival at the small beast blood pond on the western island, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women immediately soaked in it.
They were not only tempering their bodies, but they were also cultivating their souls.
On the eastern island, Tianguo, who was in his black fox form, noticed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s return. 'Hmm?
That heavenly fox brat left this realm not long ago, but his strength has increased quite significantly, especially his soul power.
Moreover, I could feel that he was also monitoring me, so I thought our meeting wouldn't be long.
If he thinks he can conquer me, I will teach him a harsh lesson he will never forget.'

Two weeks passed quickly, and the blacksmith competition was nearing its peak.

Unfortunately, two of Duan Zhou's four disciples, An Hu and Gang Zhishou, were defeated by the blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm, but Xian Xian and Lu Zhong managed to secure victory, making the score even.
Since the seniors had finished competing, the young blacksmiths from both realms took turns competing with each other, including Zhang Fei [5], who faced off against a young male blacksmith.
"Since your blacksmith ranks are still at the spirit rank, you will compete to create a spirit-grade weapon." They nodded at Li Yanzhi.
"Let's begin."

chapters.title: Chapter 746: Two Enemies's Arrival
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] did not want to hold back or waste time facing the young blacksmith of the Divine Flame Realm, so he took out his forging equipment. The Portable Dragon Flame Furnace, the Heavenly Forge Hammer, and the Heavenly Soulweave Anvil.

'Three divine-grade equipment!' Not only were Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong shocked to see that, but Duan Zhao and his four disciples were also shocked to find out that Zhang Fei [5] had three divine-grade blacksmithing equipment.

Unfortunately, the Heavenly Forge Array was not a portable formation, and Zhang Fei [5] had already set it up in the training space, so he could not use it in the competition. Even so, it wasn't a big deal for him because he had already forged dozens of spirit-grade swords, and he had already created the most perfect one.
However, Zhang Fei [5] was curious about the true effect of his hammer and anvil. He wanted to try to implant his soul mark in his weapon later, and he intended to infuse his soul power into it.
[Do you really intend to use Nalan Yushu as a sword spirit for the new sword, Master?]

'Mei, these forging materials aren't that good, and it would be a waste if I used her soul to be the sword spirit. I will do so after I find a way to go to the realms beyond the upper realms and find materials of much higher quality, so the sword I will create at that time will be of the best quality.' Zhang Fei [5] heated his furnace before starting to soften all the materials, and he softened them at the same time.

Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong frowned at Zhang Fei [5]'s actions because no blacksmith had ever done such things before, and they usually softened the forging materials one at a time, especially since each material required different heat, like the herbs in alchemy.
Xian Xian and the others were also confused by Zhang Fei [5]'s actions, but Duan Zhao asked them not to say anything and focused on watching how he softened them and forged his weapon.

'This guy is crazy! The starsteel and the shell of the metal tortoise have different hardnesses, so he needed different heats to soften them, but he softened them at the same time.' Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong muttered in their hearts, but they were shocked when they saw the fire inside Zhang Fei [5]'s furnace split into two, and the heat they produced was clearly different. One was blazing hot, and the other was mildly hot. 'He is still twenty years old, and his cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, but his control over his fire element is simply amazing. Not all fire cultivators can separate and control their fire elements in two different heats at the same time, and only our leader Ji Changlan can do it.'

The young blacksmith of the Divine Flame Realm became nervous watching Zhang Fei [5] do that, which caused his fire element to go out of control. However, he quickly stabilized his fire, but it couldn't reduce his nervousness.

Half an hour later, Zhang Fei [5] pulled the two materials out of his furnace and hammered them both in a fast and alternating rhythm. Although he looked reckless, Duan Zhao and the others could see that every beat of his hammer was precise, and they could also feel that he infused his soul power into the two metals, which made them confused and wonder about his purpose for using his soul power, especially since blacksmiths would only do that if they intended to forge a soul weapon.

Once the two materials were evenly flat, Zhang Fei [5] stacked them together and used his aura to mold them into a single piece of material. After molding the two materials, he dipped them in a special cooling liquid and waited for it to harden first.
[Master, I think you have become more skilled at forging spirit-grade weapons, so you should start focusing on forging earth-grade weapons.]

Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh in response to Mei's words. 'You know that I have tried to forge earth-grade weapons several times, but I have not succeeded until now, and I feel that there is something wrong with the pores. Unfortunately, Tie Xuan is in the Blossom Heaven Realm now, so I can't ask him for guidance, but I will ask Duan Zhao later.'
Zhang Fei [5] and the others suddenly felt two powerful auras enter the Nine Stars Realm, and they saw an artifact flying across the sky, but it quickly flew towards the Huangfu Kingdom.

Since they came from the upper realms, Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong immediately recognized that the owners of the two auras were cultivators from there. They did not dare to check their identities, especially since their aura was clearly stronger than theirs.

'You don't need to think about them, and they came here for a specific purpose.' Duan Zhao and his four disciples immediately looked at Zhang Fei [5], but he did not say anything further and thought about something. 'These two auras should belong to Li Tiannan and the person from the Huangfu Clan. Since they have arrived, I will make a move on them, but I have to investigate their true strength first.'

Zhang Fei [5] then contacted the fake Ruo Yanxi and ordered her to find a way to do something about the person from the Huangfu Clan. He also instructed Huangfu Ziyuan, Huangfu Lian, and Old Ling to monitor the person.
Zhang Fei [5] did not forget to contact Xian Feng, Yun Shang, Long Huang, Linghu Yingchen, and Xian Lianghua.

Mai Xiaomeng naturally noticed the arrival of the two people, but she forbade her clan members from doing anything. Instead, she went to check on the two people herself, but she contacted Zhang Fei [5] to inform him of her purpose, which he agreed to.
Huangfu Shou, Helian Yueyi, Huangfu Ziyuan, Huangfu Lian, Huangfu Xiaofan, the fake Ruo Yanxi, and several women were waiting at the top of the royal palace.
After a few minutes, a flying artifact landed in front of them, and Li Tiannan led an old man down it.

However, Helian Yueyi and some other women shuddered when they noticed a glimmer of lewdness in the old man's eyes, and he clearly wanted to devour them. Unlike them, the fake Ruo Yanxi still looked calm and responded with a faint but seductive smile.

Huangfu Shou also noticed the old man's gaze at his wife, but he was too afraid to stop her because he was the messenger of his ancestors, and his cultivation was several major levels higher than his. 'Crap! Why did my ancestors send a man like him here? I couldn't possibly stop him if he wanted to do something awful to my wives and daughters.'

Li Tiannan then introduced the old man to them. "His name is Huangfu Fanbo, and he is one of the elders of the Huangfu Clan. He is also one of the best physicians in the Grand Royal Realm, so ancestors Huangfu Zhenji and Huangfu Xinnan sent him here to check on Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying's condition."
Huangfu Shou immediately greeted the old man. "Welcome to our palace, Senior Fanbo."
"Lead me to your daughters first, and we'll talk later."
"Please follow me, Senior." Huangfu Shou immediately led the old man, followed by his two sons and Huangfu Ziyuan. However, he forbade Helian Yueyi and the others from following them.

The fake Ruo Yanxi immediately contacted Zhang Fei [5] and reported the situation to him. On the other hand, Helian Yueyi asked Li Tiannan. "Senior, are the cultivators of the Red Sun Realm really that powerful?"

"Is the mysterious man still bothering you?" Helian Yueyi nodded at Li Tiannan. "There are four strongest clans in the Red Sun Realm: the Shang, Hong, Xi, and Huo Clans. The Murong Clan is also powerful, even though they are not as powerful as the four clans. According to the Huangfu Ancestors, the Shang and Xi clans want to rule that realm, but the other two clans prevent them from doing so. I heard from them that the Hong Clan has succeeded in convincing several clans to their side, and the Huo Clan is in a neutral position. They also told me that the Mai Clan is from the western region, and their strength is on par with the Murong Clan, but they are a beast clan."
"A beast clan?"

Li Tiannan nodded. "They don't know the exact identity of their beast race, but they said that their leader is quite powerful. Anyway, I've heard from your husband that Zhang Fei is the mysterious guy's son, and I've told him not to trouble him anymore. Otherwise, no one can save your family, especially since the Huangfu Ancestors have said they don't want to face those clans."

"I see." Helian Yueyi sighed heavily in her heart, especially since everything was too late. The matter had become complicated ever since Huangfu Lian wanted to capture Zhang Fei, and he had already made it clear that he would destroy her family. 'Sigh! Since the Huangfu Ancestors clearly don't want to help us, I have to think of another solution to save my family. However, that guy hasn't come to me in the past two weeks, and I have no way to contact him."
"I'll follow them now."

After Li Tiannan left, Helian Yueyi immediately said to the fake Ruo Yanxi and the other concubines. "That old man seems to have bad intentions toward us, so you all should leave this palace for the time being. Our husband has no power to resist him, and you will be in trouble if he really does something bad to us."
"What about you, Sister Yueyi?"
Helian Yueyi shook her head at them. "I am the empress of this kingdom, so I will stay here to accompany our husband."

"In that case, I will accompany you here, Sister Yueyi." Helian Yueyi frowned at the fake Ruo Yanxi. "We are both women, and we are our husband's wives. Therefore, I will not leave you two behind, and I will accompany you."
Seeing the determination on the fake Ruo Yanxi's expression, Helian Yueyi did not say anything more to her. "You guys leave this palace right now, or it will be too late."
"Yes, Sister Yueyi."

Helian Yueyi then asked the fake Ruo Yanxi to accompany her to her room, especially since she did not want to meet Huangfu Fanbo. However, she was surprised when they arrived at her room, especially since Zhang Fei [4] was already there and leisurely waiting for them. "Are you crazy? Why did you come here so early? My husband and the others are in my two daughters' room right now, and they will definitely notice your presence."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed upon hearing that. "Why are you acting like a woman who's afraid of her husband catching her cheating?"
"You—"

"You don't have to worry because they will never notice me coming." Zhang Fei [4] interrupted Helian Yueyi. "I arrived long before those two people arrived, and they would have already come here if they had noticed my presence here. I didn't come here to see you, but I came to check their strength. Li Tiannan's cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm, and the old man's cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Transformation Realm, so neither of them is an opponent for me or my wives."

Helian Yueyi was shocked after hearing about Li Tiannan and Huangfu Fanbo's cultivation. "Are you sure you can beat the old man? He clearly has malicious intentions toward me and the others, and his presence here makes me uncomfortable."

"Do you need to doubt my words? That old man didn't even notice my presence, even though his cultivation was that high." Helian Yueyi nodded to Zhang Fei [4]. "However, you and the others are not my wives, so your safety is none of my business, and I could not care less if that old man wanted to do anything bad to you all."
"Why are you so mean?" Helian Yueyi asked with a frown.

Zhang Fei [4] indifferently shrugged. "If Huangfu Shou cannot guarantee the safety of all of you, then he is not worthy of being your husband. You guys can divorce him and leave this palace, and you will be safe from the old man. Unfortunately, it's too late, especially since he already targeted you."

Helian Yueyi looked angry at Zhang Fei [4]'s indifferent response, but she couldn't refute him because they had no relationship whatsoever, and they were enemies. "What can I do to get you to help us?"

"Kill your husband for me, and I will save all of you. You don't have to answer now, and I will give you time to think about it. However, you don't have much time because I'm sure that Huangfu Fanbo will come to you soon, so you must make a decision quickly." Zhang Fei [4] immediately disappeared from Helian Yueyi's sight, but he didn't really leave there, and he entered an invisible state instead. After that, he went to Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei's room to monitor the old man closely.
"Are you really going to kill our husband, Sister Yueyi?" The fake Ruo Yanxi asked her.

Helian Yueyi sharply glared at her. "Do you think I will betray our husband for my own safety? If that old man comes to me and intends to do something awful to me, I will commit suicide before he can do it."
"Oh." The fake Ruo Yanxi gave a light nod. "In that case, I will accompany you, Sister Yueyi. The old man may be strong, but I'm sure he won't survive if we explode our cultivation cores."

"You're right." Helian Yueyi then set up a formation in her room in the hope that Hungfu Fanbo couldn't break through it. "However, suicide is our last option, and we have to think of another solution to avoid it."

Zhang Fei [4] was already inside Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei's room. He observed Huangfu Fanbo examining the two women, but the old man's gaze roamed over their bodies, and he repeatedly licked his lips. 'This old bastard! I am a lustful demon lord, but he is much more lustful than me. Hey, Mei, how did your examination of the black liquid go?'

[I couldn't find any information about the black liquid, Master. I'm sure the black liquid came from something that came from the realms beyond the upper realms, so the system couldn't detect it. I think the only solution is to take the two women to the Star Tower, and the old man in the tower might be able to do something for them.]
Zhang Fei [4] did not care much about the fate of Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying. They were useless in that condition, so he considered taking them to the Star Tower.
"How did it go, Senior?" Huangfu Shou immediately inquired after Huangfu Fanbo had finished examining his two daughters.
Huangfu Fanbo shook his head in response. "I have never seen this black liquid before, so I don't have a solution for them. Where exactly were they exposed to it?"
"Senior, they were exposed to this black liquid in the Star Tower, specifically in the Maze Challenge."

Huangfu Fanbo turned to Huangfu Lian, who immediately explained the situation at that time. "I have never heard of the Star Tower before, but if these two little girls were exposed to this black liquid there, I am sure the antidote is there as well. Our best option is to take them there, and I may be able to find the antidote to cure them."
"How about we go there now, Senior?" Huangfu Shou asked. "My two daughters have been in this condition for almost three months, and I'm afraid they will die if we don't cure them soon."

Huangfu Fanbo felt lazy to help the two women, but he had no other choice because their ancestors ordered him to cure them. "Let's go now! You must bring all your family and aides there so we can find the antidote faster."

"Do you need to doubt my words?
That old man didn't even notice my presence, even though his cultivation was that high." Helian Yueyi nodded to Zhang Fei [4].
"However, you and the others are not my wives, so your safety is none of my business, and I could not care less if that old man wanted to do anything bad to you all."
"Why are you so mean?" Helian Yueyi asked with a frown.
Zhang Fei [4] indifferently shrugged.
"If Huangfu Shou cannot guarantee the safety of all of you, then he is not worthy of being your husband.
You guys can divorce him and leave this palace, and you will be safe from the old man.
Unfortunately, it's too late, especially since he already targeted you."
Helian Yueyi looked angry at Zhang Fei [4]'s indifferent response, but she couldn't refute him because they had no relationship whatsoever, and they were enemies.
"What can I do to get you to help us?"
"Kill your husband for me, and I will save all of you.

"Are you really going to kill our husband, Sister Yueyi?" The fake Ruo Yanxi asked her.

"In that case, I will accompany you, Sister Yueyi.
The old man may be strong, but I'm sure he won't survive if we explode our cultivation cores."
"You're right." Helian Yueyi then set up a formation in her room in the hope that Hungfu Fanbo couldn't break through it.
"However, suicide is our last option, and we have to think of another solution to avoid it."
Zhang Fei [4] was already inside Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei's room.
He observed Huangfu Fanbo examining the two women, but the old man's gaze roamed over their bodies, and he repeatedly licked his lips. 'This old bastard!

"I have never seen this black liquid before, so I don't have a solution for them.

Huangfu Fanbo turned to Huangfu Lian, who immediately explained the situation at that time.
"I have never heard of the Star Tower before, but if these two little girls were exposed to this black liquid there, I am sure the antidote is there as well.

"How about we go there now, Senior?" Huangfu Shou asked.
"My two daughters have been in this condition for almost three months, and I'm afraid they will die if we don't cure them soon."
Huangfu Fanbo felt lazy to help the two women, but he had no other choice because their ancestors ordered him to cure them.
"Let's go now!
You must bring all your family and aides there so we can find the antidote faster."

chapters.title: Chapter 747: Meeting The Old Man
paragraphs: Huangfu Shou decided to take Huangfu Ziyuan, Ling Baozi, and several of his aides to the Star Tower. He hoped that with their large numbers, they could find a cure for his two daughters sooner. Unfortunately, Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Xiaofan had recently failed to challenge the tower, and they couldn't enter it for a few years, so he didn't bring them along.

Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei were no different from their two brothers, and they were unable to enter the tower after their previous failure. Despite this, Huangfu Shou took them there, and he also brought several special imperial physicians to treat them outside the tower.
Since both the emperor and the empress were absent, Huangfu Lian took over leadership of their kingdom, especially since he was the crown prince of the Huangfu Kingdom.

Huangfu Fanbo used an artifact to protect the Huangfu Royal Capital so no one could attack in their absence. He was disappointed after he learned that Helian Yueyi ordered Huangfu Shou's other concubines to leave the palace, yet he said nothing.

Helian Yueyi was shivering from Huangfu Fanbo's cruel gaze, giving her ominous feelings. She really didn't want to be around the old man, but she wanted her two daughters to get better quickly, so she decided to join them. 'Tch! This old man seems to have never touched a woman before! Sigh! I hope we can find the source and cure for my two daughters' illnesses so they can return to normal again.'

After they left, Zhang Fei [4] immediately went to see Huangfu Lian. "I will do something about them, and they will not be coming back here anytime soon. I want you to build your power since you'll be taking over their duties. No matter what, I want you to control your father's trusted people, and I will send someone to help you later."

"Yes, Master." After Zhang Fei [4] disappeared, Huangfu Lian sat down weakly in his chair. 'Does he think it's easy to control my father's trusted people? Those old folks are completely loyal to him, and they will never side with me as long as he is alive.'

In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [4] had already arrived at the Star Tower. Mei suddenly spoke. [Master, I think this is a good opportunity to get rid of Li Tiannan and Huangfu Fanbo, but you can't possibly do it by yourself, and I think you can ask the old man for help to get rid of them.]

'I did think that, Mei. However, I'm not sure the old man will be willing to help me, but I will try first.' After he lit up ten crystals, Zhang Fei [4] immediately entered the Star Tower. "Old man, I know you can hear me. I need a little help from you, so I hope you are willing to see me."

The old man immediately appeared in front of Zhang Fei [4]. "Even though I already know your talent, your progress still amazes me, kid. Your cultivation has already been broken through twice in two and a half months, and your body cultivation has already reached the second stage; even your soul power has also reached the earthly soul level."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed. "Old man, my cultivation wouldn't have progressed this fast without my wives and partners, and one of them helped me temper my body. As for my soul power, I was lucky to meet a master in the soul cultivation path, and he is the best soul cultivator in the upper realms."

"I don't know much about upper realm cultivators, but the best is mere dust in my realm, and his abilities are useless." Zhang Fei [4]'s lips twitched at the old man's words. Even cultivators in the lower realms are not comparable to cultivators in the upper realms, so it is natural that cultivators of Hun Di's level are not comparable to cultivators in the realms beyond the upper realms. "What kind of help do you want from me? Do you want to do something about those demons?"

Zhang Fei [4] was slightly taken aback upon recalling Ximen Gongfu and the others. "Those demons haven't failed yet, eh? I thought you would make all the challenges difficult for them, so I thought they would fail too early."
"They're pretty resilient and tough, and I didn't make the challenges difficult for them, so they're on the third floor now." The old man then asked. "Do you want me to fail them?"

"I would prefer if they stayed in this tower for a long time so I could take over their demon kingdoms." Zhang Fei [4] then told the old man about the black liquid that injured Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei, and he also told him about Huangfu Fanbo. "Do you have a way to remove the black liquid from their bodies? Anyway, I don't want to do anything to the others, and some of them are my slaves. However, I hope you can help me lock up that lecherous old man in this tower as long as possible, especially since his presence will disrupt my plans."

"All right, I will lock him in this tower." The old man then thought for a moment. "I have no way to remove the black liquid from the two girls' bodies, but I know someone who can do it, and I will send my disciple to him to ask for the antidote. Kid, did you tell anyone about my home realm? I heard that there were several groups from the upper realms going to the Sun Tower, and they were talking about you."

"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] immediately admitted it. "I did tell some people, but I didn't tell them too much detail. Feng Yao also told her parents about this tower, and they led their group to the Sun Tower. Did that give you any trouble?"

"Not really." The old man shook his head in response. "I heard about them from my two old friends at the Sun Tower, and they didn't report to our higher-ups, so it's not a big deal. When are you going to challenge the second floor?"

"In four and a half months." Zhang Fei [4]'s answer surprised the old man, as he thought that he would need at least a year. "All my wives and some partners have already reached the Earth Realm, and I am confident of reaching the Heaven Realm by then, so I will bring them all to this tower to try the challenges."
The old man nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will wait for you to return to this tower in four and a half months, so I hope you will not disappoint me."

"Don't worry, Old Man. I won't let you down, and I will pass all the challenges on the second floor by then." The old man disappeared immediately after that, and Zhang Fei [4] left the tower. However, he did not leave there immediately and waited for Huangfu Shou's group to arrive.

Above the tower, Hua Mei'er immediately questioned the old man. "Why did you help that kid to that extent, Master? I know his talent is extraordinary, but he is still too weak now, and he is not necessarily worthy of setting foot in our realm."

"Can you break through once a month?" Hua Mei'er immediately shut her mouth after the old man asked that. "The quality and quantity of Qi in our realm is a hundred times better than in his realm, but you needed several months to break through when your cultivation was still in the Earth Realm back then. Not to mention, he is also a body cultivator and soul cultivator. Are you able to walk all three paths at the same time, like him?"

"Hehe." Helian Xun'er chuckled at seeing Hua Mei'er cornered, but she cornered her too. "Mei'er, that kid is a cultivator from the middle realms, but he managed to learn the immortal grade Yin-Yang Fire Art in just ten hours, so his talent is much better than yours. If you were in his shoes, I'm sure you wouldn't succeed in learning it, and your hair would probably fall out trying to learn it."
"Ugh! Why are you mocking me, Sister Xun'er?" Hua Mei'er protested.
Helian Xun'er shrugged. "I'm just telling the truth."

"All right, you two don't need to make a fuss." The old man then looked at another disciple. "Sima Yun, I want you to return to our realm and find Ye Yongshan and ask for the antidote to his black liquid, or those two little girls will die."
"Yes, Master."
After Sima Yun disappeared, the old man spoke to Helian Xun'er. "Xun'er, I want you to take care of the man named Huangfu Fanbo, and you can lock him up in that area."
"Yes, Master." Helian Xun'er replied with a nod. "Four and a half months is not a long time, and I want to see that kid's progress by then."
The old man gave a light nod. "Since he is so confident in himself, I will look forward to his progress, and I hope he is truly capable of completing the challenges on the second floor."

Unlike them, Hua Mei'er seemed to be thinking about something, and the evil smile on her face clearly showed that she was thinking about something bad. 'Hehehe! If that kid comes here again, I will make him fail the challenges on the second floor, and he will not be able to come here again for a few years.'

Using Huangfu Fanbo's flying artifact, Huangfu Shou's group didn't need too long to arrive at the Star Tower. The old man immediately led them down to enter the tower area, but the barrier stopped him. "Who would foolishly set up a formation in such a useless place?"
"Senior—" Before Huangfu Shou could reply, Huangfu Fanbo had already punched the barrier with enormous force.
*Bam*

"Gah!" Instantly, the barrier struck back at Huangfu Fanbo with even greater force, which caused him to be thrown quite far back and spurt out a mouthful of blood. The old man stuck one foot back to stop himself before cursing. "Fuck! How could there be such a strong barrier in the middle realms?"

Huangfu Shou sighed in his heart, especially since Huangfu Fanbo was too careless. On the other hand, Helian Yueyi cursed in his heart, as he expected the old man to be injured because of the counterattack just now, but he turned out to be fine and only suffered minor injuries.

Zhang Fei [4], who was still hiding in the invisible state, burst into laughter upon witnessing Huangfu Fanbo's ridiculous action. 'What a foolish and arrogant old man! Even the Nameless One will fail to breach the barrier!'

"Senior, this tower mysteriously appeared in this realm in the past, and no one knows its origin; even the Huangfu Ancestors have never heard of this tower." Huangfu Fanbo turned to Li Tiannan, who immediately explained to him about the Star Tower. "In fact, I challenged this tower once, but I underestimated the challenges inside, and I couldn't get past the first floor."

Huangfu Fanbo nodded and approached the barrier again, but he no longer attacked it and just touched it. "The counterattack just now was equivalent to an attack from a cultivator at the high-level seven divine realms. If I hadn't worn my protective artifact, I would have suffered quite a heavy injury from it."

"This tower is too mysterious, so you should not act rashly, or you'll be injured if you get hit by a stronger counterattack than just now." Li Tiannan then turned to Huangfu Shou, who immediately took out his token to open the barrier. "Let's go in."
Soon, they arrived in front of the stone obelisk, and Li Tiannan led them to light those crystals on it.

Huangfu Fanbo acted arrogantly once again by punching it with full force, but the result was not as he had expected, especially since it did not crack even a little, let alone shatter. "Who actually created this tower? Where did this damn tower come from? The barrier is incredibly strong, and so is this stone."

"No one knows." Li Tiannan then turned to Huangfu Shou. "Since your two daughters have failed before, they have to stay outside and let the palace physicians take care of them while we look for the antidote in the tower."
"Yes, Senior."
After Huangfu Shou instructed the palace physicians, Li Tiannan immediately led them into the Star Tower, but a portal sucked them straight in, which took them directly into the maze challenge.

As Zhang Fei [4] wished, the old man who controlled the Star Tower deliberately separated Huangfu Fanbo from their entourage, causing him to frown. "Tch! This shitty tower separated me from them, so I couldn't get close to Huangfu Shou's wife and concubine."

However, Huangfu Fanbo's eyes suddenly lit up, especially when he saw Helian Xun'er appear in the distance with a seductive smile on her face. She stretched her hand forward, signaling the old man to follow her.
Seeing Helian Xun'er's seductive appearance, Huangfu Fanbo immediately followed her without thinking twice, making him unable to realize that it was a trap.

Over a period of time, Helian Xun'er led the old man to areas filled with strange creatures, including some chimera beasts. Despite these obstacles, Huangfu Fanbo was able to overcome them effortlessly with his high cultivation level.

Huangfu Fanbo slowly began to notice the strangeness of Helian Xun'er's actions, making him wonder about her identity. Despite this, his lust still controlled his mind, and he was eager to devour her, so he continued to follow her.
'This idiot! He only thinks of using his dick!' Helian Xun'er then accelerated her movements. A while later, she arrived at a dead-end room and waited for Huangfu Fanbo to arrive.

After a few minutes, Huangfu Fanbo arrived at the room, and he smiled in satisfaction because there was no way out there. He immediately entered it as he continued to stare at Helian Xun'er with a lustful gaze, but he stepped on a trap that right away transported him to another area.

"What a fool! Does he think a mortal like him is worthy of me? Even men in my realm are not worthy of me, let alone such an idiot like him." Helian Xun'er suddenly thought of Zhang Fei [4] and smiled to herself. "If that kid approached me, I definitely wouldn't reject him. Unfortunately, he is still too weak right now, and I might have to wait a few hundred years for him to be able to go to my home realm."
After that, Helian Xun'er disappeared from that place and returned to her master's side, who was watching Huangfu Shou and the others' movements through the screen in front of them.

"Fuck! That woman deliberately toyed with me, and she trapped me in this damn hot place!" Huangfu Fanbo then looked around, but he only saw a vast expanse of wilderness. "Damn it! How am I supposed to get out of this place? Do I have to look for something in this place to be able to leave?"
Just as Huangfu Fanbo was contemplating his next move, he was suddenly surrounded by two giant sand beasts, whose cultivation was several levels higher than his own.

Realizing the unfavorable situation, Huangfu Fanbo immediately flew at high speed to get away from the two giant sand beasts, but the two swiftly chased them, which was the beginning of the old man's suffering.

After the old man informed him about Huangfu Fanbo, Zhang Fei [4] immediately left the Star Tower, but he did not return to the training space. Instead, he summoned Orith, Ilsath, and Zilvora out of there before taking them to the Netherworld Realm.
Zhang Fei [4] did not bring the three female demons to Lust City, but he brought them to the Dead Forest, especially since Shang Chongyun and the other three would arrive in that realm soon.

The three female demons shivered as soon as they arrived in front of the guardian beast that protected the portal to the Azure Sky Realm. "Why are the three of you so afraid of that beast? You are no longer ordinary demons but demon cultivators. Moreover, I'm here with you guys, so you don't need to be afraid of it. I will tame the demon beast, and it will help Morgana and the others to protect this realm."

Despite this, his lust still controlled his mind, and he was eager to devour her, so he continued to follow her.
'This idiot!
He only thinks of using his dick!' Helian Xun'er then accelerated her movements.
A while later, she arrived at a dead-end room and waited for Huangfu Fanbo to arrive.
After a few minutes, Huangfu Fanbo arrived at the room, and he smiled in satisfaction because there was no way out there.
He immediately entered it as he continued to stare at Helian Xun'er with a lustful gaze, but he stepped on a trap that right away transported him to another area.
"What a fool!
Does he think a mortal like him is worthy of me?
Even men in my realm are not worthy of me, let alone such an idiot like him." Helian Xun'er suddenly thought of Zhang Fei [4] and smiled to herself.
"If that kid approached me, I definitely wouldn't reject him.
Unfortunately, he is still too weak right now, and I might have to wait a few hundred years for him to be able to go to my home realm."
After that, Helian Xun'er disappeared from that place and returned to her master's side, who was watching Huangfu Shou and the others' movements through the screen in front of them.
"Fuck!
That woman deliberately toyed with me, and she trapped me in this damn hot place!" Huangfu Fanbo then looked around, but he only saw a vast expanse of wilderness.
"Damn it!
How am I supposed to get out of this place?
Do I have to look for something in this place to be able to leave?"
Just as Huangfu Fanbo was contemplating his next move, he was suddenly surrounded by two giant sand beasts, whose cultivation was several levels higher than his own.

Realizing the unfavorable situation, Huangfu Fanbo immediately flew at high speed to get away from the two giant sand beasts, but the two swiftly chased them, which was the beginning of the old man's suffering.
After the old man informed him about Huangfu Fanbo, Zhang Fei [4] immediately left the Star Tower, but he did not return to the training space.
Instead, he summoned Orith, Ilsath, and Zilvora out of there before taking them to the Netherworld Realm.
Zhang Fei [4] did not bring the three female demons to Lust City, but he brought them to the Dead Forest, especially since Shang Chongyun and the other three would arrive in that realm soon.
The three female demons shivered as soon as they arrived in front of the guardian beast that protected the portal to the Azure Sky Realm.
"Why are the three of you so afraid of that beast?
You are no longer ordinary demons but demon cultivators.
Moreover, I'm here with you guys, so you don't need to be afraid of it.
I will tame the demon beast, and it will help Morgana and the others to protect this realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 748: Lava Lion Demon Beast
paragraphs: "Hmm?" The portal guardian, who was a lava lion, immediately opened his eyes as soon as Zhang Fei [4] landed not far from him. "I remember your scent; you were the one who broke through my portal about three months ago, right?"

"You have a sharp sense of smell and memory, eh?" Zhang Fei [4] leisurely walked toward the lion. "Don't you feel angry that a human forced you to protect this portal, Yan Jiang? You are an emperor-rank demon beast, and your cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm, but Shang Huaqiang brought you here, which halted your cultivation."
Yan Jiang immediately stood up as he ferociously glared at Zhang Fei [4]. His body was enormous, and hot lava was dripping from it. "How do you know my name and that person's identity?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed in response. "Anyway, you don't need to look at me like that because I'm not afraid of you in the slightest. Your demon rank and cultivation are indeed higher than mine, but you are just a mere demon beast, and your beast bloodline is futile in front of me."

As an old and experienced beast, Yan Jiang had a sharp beast instinct, and he knew that Zhang Fei [4]'s bloodline was far superior to his. Moreover, he was also a beast cultivator, so he could feel something unusual from him.

'This old beast is quite wise and not hot-headed.' Zhang Fei [4] just smiled at Yan Jiang's reaction. "Shang Huaqiang is my enemy, and he must be your enemy too, right? Since we have the same enemy, how about you follow me? I'm unable to defeat that guy now, especially since his cultivation is already at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, but I'm confident I can fight him in the future."

"Hmm?" Yan Jiang observed Zhang Fei [4] for quite some time, mainly because he looked so confident. "Why should I follow you? What benefits can you give me? I admit that you are interesting because you can trick me and break through my portal, but Shang Huaqiang is much stronger than you think, and his two ancestors are even stronger."

Zhang Fei [4] nodded to the lion. "You are right, Shang Huaqiang and his two ancestors are indeed powerful, and most cultivators in the Red Sun Realm fear them. However, I'm much better than you think, and I have a lot of things in my arsenal. To tell you the truth, I became a demon beast and a cultivator around ten months ago, but I have reached this stage now. My cultivation is at the 5-Star Earth Realm, and my demon rank has reached the duke rank."

"Do you think you can lie to me? Do you think I will believe that you can reach this stage in less than ten months?" Yan Jiang asked in a furious tone. "You may be able to fool other cultivators or demons below you, but you will never be able to fool me because I am too experienced."

Zhang Fei [4] shook his head when he heard that. "At first, I thought you were a wise old demon, but I misjudged you. Even if I lied to you, you should have realized that I could defeat you, and I could subdue you by force. However, I prefer that you choose to join me voluntarily, so I haven't taken any action against you yet."
"Prove your strength to me."
Zhang Fei [4] released a soft sigh. "Why don't you just attack me with your lava? If I were as weak as you imagine, I would immediately die from your attack."

"Hmm?" Yan Jiang seemed hesitant to attack Zhang Fei [4], as he was sure that he would die if he attacked him. "Since you asked for it, I will attack you now, but I will not be responsible if you die."
"Just attack me using your strongest attack."

Yan Jiang immediately opened his mouth and spat out a lump of lava, which directly hit Zhang Fei [4]. However, the lion demon beast seemed confused as he did not groan in pain, and he still stood straight in his spot, especially since his lava would dissolve everything right away.

"Is this your strongest strength? How disappointing." Zhang Fei [4] asked as he got rid of the lava from his body, shocking Yan Jiang. "Your lava may be strong for other living creatures, but it's just a mere child's toy in front of me, and I don't feel the heat at all. If you still have other powerful attacks, you can use them now, and I will accept them all."
Yan Jiang was furious to hear Zhang Fei [4]'s taunt, and he attacked him several times using his lava, but none of his attacks injured him.
Yan Jiang decided to physically attack him using his front paws, but Zhang Fei [4] immediately disappeared and moved above his back.

"Your speed is not bad, even though your body is enormous, but it's still useless in front of me." Yan Jiang shook his body to throw Zhang Fei [4], but he remained on his back. "Since you feel that your physique is great, I will attack you with one of my strongest attacks."
Bam
"Roar!" Yan Jiang let out a pained roar as Zhang Fei [4] hit the back of his head, forcing him to fall to the ground. "How can your attack be so strong?"

"Heh! You don't know me, so you're looking down on me too much." Zhang Fei [4] immediately moved behind Yan Jiang and grabbed his tail, and he tied his six tails to it as well. He lifted the lion demon beast high into the sky, spun him around in mid-air for a while, and threw him out of the dead forest.

"Roar!" Once again, Yan Jiang let out a loud roar as his body hurtled toward the ground outside the forest, but he stabilized himself before hitting the ground and flying in front of Zhang Fei [4]. "Tell me! How can your strengths be so strong? Your body is so small, and I can swallow you in one go, but your physical strength clearly surpasses mine."
Zhang Fei [4] shrugged in response. "I still have many tricks to subdue you."
"Hmm?" Yan Jiang frowned as an artificial forest suddenly enclosed him. "Isn't this the ability of the Dryads? How can you have their abilities?"

"As I said before, I am indeed weaker than you in terms of demon rank and cultivation, but I am much better than you think. If I intend to attack you seriously, I dare to guarantee that you will not be able to wake up for a week or more." Zhang Fei [4] then took out six beast pills and showed them to Yan Jiang, causing the lion demon beast to drool, especially after he recognized their grade. "Even though you are a demon beast, you are still a beast. These pills are specially concocted for beasts, and I will give them to you if you are willing to join me. Once you swallow them, you will immediately feel changes in yourself, and they also have long-term effects, such as increasing your beast rank."

Yan Jiang looked thoughtful after hearing all that, but his gaze never moved from the six pills. "I'm willing to join you, but I still want to live freely, so I don't want to become your contract beast."

"I don't have a problem with that." Zhang Fei [4] replied with a nod. "I won't make a contract with you, but I will implant my soul mark on you. You don't have to worry because it's not a slave mark, so I can't control you, and I use it just in case you betray me. If you betray me, I can track your whereabouts immediately, and I will kill you as soon as I find you."

"All right." Zhang Fei [4] immediately removed the artificial forest and floated in front of Yan Jiang, shocking him by pulling his soul out of his body. Once he finished implanting his soul mark, he immediately returned his soul to his body. "Who the hell are you? A lust demon lord like you shouldn't have a soul ability like that."

"I mimicked it from another demon, and I still have many other abilities that I mimicked from other demons." Zhang Fei [4] immediately gave the six beast pills to Yan Jiang. "For now, your job is only to help my friends to protect this realm, especially since Shang Huaqiang sent four people here."
"Your friends?"
"Come out now! I know you two have been here for a while."

Yan Jiang immediately looked at Oz the First and Morgana, who had just appeared in front of them. "The two of them are clearly stronger than me, and they should be able to defeat Shang Huaqiang's subordinates, so why do you still want me to join you?"

"My dream is not in the middle or upper realms; it is in a realm higher than the upper realms." Therefore, I need many strong people by my side, be they humans, demons, or beasts." Yan Jiang, Morgana, and Oz the First stared at Zhang Fei [4] in shock. "I won't say anything about that now, especially since I still don't have a way to go there. However, that place is real, and I've met several people from there. For now, you guys just need to focus on your strengths, and I will take you all there when the time comes."
"So, when will those people arrive in this realm?" Morgana asked.

"They will arrive around two weeks from now. You've met one of them before, especially since he was the one who summoned Shang Huaqiang's avatar back then." Morgana and Oz the First nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei [4], as they still remembered Shang Chenguang. "Morgana, I hope you can help Ju Yingzhi recover faster because I need her abilities, and she lives in the succubi tower in Lust City."
Morgana nodded at him. "I already know about the woman's presence, but I haven't gone to see her. Since you want it that way, I'll go see her after this."
"Thank you." After that, Zhang Fei [4] picked up the three female demons and took them back to the training space.
Yan Jiang went straight back to the dead forest to swallow the six pills. As she had agreed, Morgana and Oz the First went to meet Ju Yingzhi at the succubi tower.

Ju Yingzhi was initially shocked by the two's presence, but Morgana immediately explained to her that they came to her because of Zhang Fei [4]'s request, and the two began to help her recover from her injuries.

Inside the maze, Huangfu Shou and his party did not have too much difficulty in facing the challenges inside, but they were still busy searching for Huangfu Fanbo's location. After all, he was the only healer in their group, and only he could determine the cure for Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei.
Li Tiannan decided to split them into groups, with him bringing Huangfu Ziyuan with him. Ling Baozi led the people from the Huangfu Kingdom to another area.

Meanwhile, Huangfu Shou went with his two wives to another area. "Fortunately, that old man is not with us, Husband. Since his arrival, he has been eyeing me and the others with lustful eyes, so I ordered your other concubines to leave the palace."

"I know." Huangfu Shou replied with a soft sigh. "I still don't understand why my ancestors had to send him to us, and you have made the right decision to order the others to leave the palace. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to save you if he really made a move against you guys. However, the condition of our two daughters continues to decline, so we must find him and the antidote as soon as possible, or they will really die."

Helian Yueyi's expression turned gloomy as soon as Huangfu Shou mentioned their daughters. "Anyway, Lian'er told me that the challenges they face here are much more difficult than in the past, but I don't see any difference at all compared to the last time we came here."
"I don't have an answer for that." Huangfu Shou then sped up. "Let's go; we have to move faster, especially since time is ticking."

After some time, Zhang Fei [5] finished forging a spirit-grade sword, and it was better than the last one, especially since he injected his soul power into it. After he tidied up his forging equipment, he handed his sword to Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong. "You two can check it out."

"There's nothing to check anymore." Li Yanzhi replied with a shake of his head. "Everything about this sword is perfect, be it in terms of its style, weight, sharpness, or thickness. This way, the winner of the match is you."
Yuan Kong then asked him. "Do you know the Tie Clan?"
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was taken aback for a moment before nodding. "I learned about blacksmithing for the first time from Old Gang, and Senior Tie Xuan taught me more about it."
"Young... young master Tie Xuan?" Yuan Kong and Li Yanzhi stuttered.

Since both people reacted like that, Zhang Fei [5] was sure that the Tie Clan's status in blacksmithing was not small. He immediately took out the clan plaque that Tie Xuan gave him at their first meeting. "Senior Xuan not only helped me deepen my understanding of blacksmithing, but he also helped me in many ways, including providing me with many rare forging materials."
"Kid." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Duan Zhao, who took out a crystal ball with a high concentration of Qi inside. "This is the Luminous Qi Crystal, and I will start making your new weapon today."
"How long will it take you to make it, Senior?"

"Your new weapon is quite complicated, and I don't want to rush into creating it, especially since this crystal is too expensive and rare." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Duan Zhao. "Give me three months, and I will create the most perfect weapon for you."

"Senior, you can take your time, as I don't need a new weapon urgently. I don't mind if I have to wait a few months longer as long as the weapon is perfect." Zhang Fei [5] remembered something. "Senior, I wanted to discuss with you how to properly forge the earth-grade weapon, but I still have some matters to attend to now, so I will come back later."
"All right, you can come to me anytime."

After Zhang Fei [5] left, Yuan Kong spoke to Duan Zhao directly. "Old Duan, the Tie Clan is truly outstanding in blacksmithing, so you must maintain your good relationship with that kid, and he might introduce you to them in the future."

"Hahaha." Duan Zhao laughed at that. "Old Kong, if we want to build good relationships with other people, then build those relationships based on sincerity without thinking about reciprocity. The relationship between Zhang Fei [5] and the Tie Clan is unrelated to me, so I don't expect him to introduce me to them. If he is willing to introduce me to them, then I will be grateful to him. If he doesn't have that intention, I will never mention anything."
'What a fool!' Yuan Kong silently said.
Sometime later, all the participants had finished their respective weapons, and the result was that Duan Zhao's group narrowly won against the blacksmiths from the Divine Fire Realm.

"Since the results are out, we will bring them back to their realm, and we will report the results of this competition to the higher-ups, so you can wait for the next announcement." After that, Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong took the blacksmiths from the Divine Fire Realm to leave the realm.
Duan Zhao asked all his disciples to bring their disciples back to their respective places, and he began to create Zhang Fei [5]'s new weapon.
