"Since the results are out, we will bring them back to their realm, and we will report the results of this competition to the higher-ups, so you can wait for the next announcement." After that, Li Yanzhi and Yuan Kong took the blacksmiths from the Divine Fire Realm to leave the realm.
Duan Zhao asked all his disciples to bring their disciples back to their respective places, and he began to create Zhang Fei [5]'s new weapon.

chapters.title: Chapter 749: Blood Condensing Stage
paragraphs: At the Xi Clan, Xi Hongyan had just returned, but her expression was full of disappointment.
"What makes you so disappointed, Hongyan?" A middle-aged woman asked her.

Xi Hongyan let out a soft sigh. "Aunt Xi Qiuwei, I've been looking for Mai Xiaomeng for two weeks in the southern region, but I haven't managed to find her or her race members. I've also been monitoring the Hong Clan for the past two weeks, but she never appeared there. Instead, I discovered Murong Qianying relocated her Murong Clan not far from that clan, and she did that after Shang Huaqiang sent her husband and in-laws to another realm."
"The Netherworld Realm."
"Yes." Xi Hongyan nodded. "I still can't understand Shang Huaqiang's reason for invading a demon realm in the middle realms, but I think there might be something interesting about that realm."
"Do you want to send people to that realm?"

Xi Hongyan thought about it for quite some time. "Since that realm is in the middle realms, I plan to send Xi Baoxing and Xi Chaozu there. What about all those clans? Have Xi Zhenyang and Xi Xiuling managed to subdue them?"

"The Bao and Pei clans have already decided to join us, but the Xing and Fang clans still refuse, and they are putting up strong resistance to our people." Xi Qiuwei then asked her. "Are you going to the two clans yourself?"

"No need." Xi Hongyan refused and immediately walked away. "If Xi Zhenyang and Xi Xiuling can't subdue them, then they are not worthy of being members of my Xi Clan, and I don't need useless people like them. Aunt Qiuwei, order Xi Baoxing and Xi Chaozu to leave for the Netherworld Realm today."

"Yes." Xi Qiuwei let out a sigh in her heart after Xi Hongyan disappeared. 'Hongyan has become different since her parents died. Back then, she was innocent and gentle, but she has become cold and cruel now. She is no different from Shang Huaqiang, and she doesn't hesitate to dispose of our clan members who she feels are useless.'

In the Blossom Heaven Realm, Shang Xiaojuan, who was meditating in front of the stone obelisk, opened his eyes as a flying artifact landed behind him. He immediately stood up and approached Ai Weiren, who had just arrived. She did not come alone, and she brought five people with her, but he only recognized one of them. "What took you so long, Master? I've been waiting here for you for two weeks."
"Foolish disciple!" Ai Weiren rebuked him. "Do you think you can face those challenges in this tower by yourself? Even the Nameless One and Hun Di brought enough people to challenge this tower!"
Shang Xiaojuan scratched his head without daring to refute his master, and she then greeted one of them. "I didn't expect you to come here with my master, Aunt Xing Sichai."

"I've never heard of this tower, so I immediately agreed to join Weiren when she told me about it." Xing Sichai then walked to the stone obelisk and touched it. "Apparently, this stone obelisk is the first test to test our raw strength, and we can only enter the tower after lighting these crystals."

An old man immediately walked to her side and pointed to the monument not far ahead. "Look at that; I think that's the maximum limit for challenging this tower. Since the Nameless One's and Hun Di's groups are already inside, there are only ten slots left."

"In that case, we don't need to delay any longer." Another old man said as he walked over to their colleague, followed by Ai Wiren and the others. "There are only seven of us, so there are still enough slots for us. If we enter now, we might be able to catch up to the two groups."

They quickly took turns attacking the stone obelisk and obtained the qualifications to challenge the tower, and Ai Weiren immediately led them inside. Like the previous two groups, they were immediately faced with ten doors. However, they did not select the black door but rather the one that led them to seven different locations. If Zhang Fei saw that place, he would definitely know that it was the natural challenge.

After the series of notifications, Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was tempering his body in the beast pond with the two women, immediately opened his eyes and clenched both his fists. "I've waited two months for this, and my body cultivation has finally broken through to the third stage. My Qi circulation has also become slightly faster than before, but my endurance has increased the most."
"Congratulations, Long'er! Your body cultivation has finally broken through again." Shang Xinyu said with a smile.

"Thank you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen out of the beast blood pond. The three of them quickly got dressed. "Unfortunately, this beast blood is no longer useful to me if I don't mix other liquids into it, and my body's cultivation will become very slow."
"Aunt Xinxin should be able to help you with that, right?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded. "Xinxin already said she would give me another liquid to help me break through to the fourth stage, so I'll see her later."
"What are we going to do now? Are we going back to the Nine Stars Realm?" Shang Yifen asked.

"Actually, I thought I would bring you two back to the Red Sun Realm, especially since your cultivation would be too slow if you continued staying in the middle realms." Both women looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in confusion, especially since Shang Huaqiang would capture them if they returned to the Shang Clan. "Hey! Your two families are now living in the Hong Clan, remember? Therefore, you don't need to go back to the Shang Clan, and you can stay in that clan. In fact, my real body lives there now, but I'm still in seclusion, and I will be coming out in four and a half months. As for me, I will join my real body and the others so I can reach the Heaven Realm faster."
Both women nodded in understanding, and Shang Xinyu spoke to him. "I can feel that your cultivation is approaching the 6-Star Earth Realm now."

"If my calculations are correct, I will break through in two weeks. Once I reach the Heaven Realm, I will pick you two up at the Red Sun Realm, and you guys will join all my wives and partners to challenge the Star Tower. If you are lucky, you can get divine-grade techniques there." The eyes of the two women lit up after Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned the grades of the technique. "I'll send you guys there now."
"All right."

After he sent Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen to the Hong Clan, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not immediately leave the Wasteland Realm. Instead, he stared at the eastern island and thought about seeing Tianguo, who had been watching him ever since he returned to that realm.
[Do you want to see Tianguo now, master? You were even able to subdue Jiu Shui and Yan Jiang, both of whom are much stronger than him, so you should be able to subdue him.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head slightly. "Tianguo is different from them, Mei. Although his cultivation is lower than Jiu Shui's and Yan Jiang's, his soul power is stronger than theirs. His soul power is at the perfection stage of the Heavenly Soul level, and he also has the ability to possess the souls of other beasts. That's why I won't meet him now, and I will meet him after my soul power reaches the Heavenly Soul level. At that time, he won't be able to fight me back, and I will subdue him before forcing him to make a contract with me."
Following this, Zhang Xiaolong [3] entered the training space, where he engaged in dual cultivation and dual soul cultivation with his two partners, Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian.

"Why did he send you two back here?" Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu immediately explained the situation to Hong Xinxin. "Zhang Fei and all his clones are still busy with their cultivation, so he hasn't seen me in the past two weeks. Since his body cultivation has broken through to the third stage, I will prepare the Yang Tempering Liquid for him. By the way, Sister Qianying often comes to this clan, so you should not mention his real name here, especially since she still doesn't know his true identity."
"I know, Aunt Xinxin." Both women answered with a nod. "We haven't seen both of our families for quite a while, so we're going to see them now."

"They live on the east side of this clan, so you two can go there to meet them." After Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu left, Hong Xinxin immediately went to her clan's treasury to get the liquid for Zhang Fei.
However, Cai Yinzhi and Yan Yizhen were also there looking for something. "Do you want to get Jiushen Liquid for Zhang Fei again, Xin'er?"

"No, Grandma." Hong Xinxin immediately told them. "Zhang Fei's body cultivation has just broken through to the Blood Condensing Stage, so he no longer needs that liquid. Instead, I want to get the Yang Tempering Liquid for him, but we don't seem to have much stock."

Yan Yizhen immediately took several bottles of the liquid, stored them in a storage ring, and handed the ring to her daughter. "There are only a hundred now, but your father has ordered more. That guy will send the new stock over in a few days, and Zhang Fei can use the ones available for the time being."
"What about your soul power?"
"Even though Zhang Fei has taught us how to do dual soul cultivation, the increase in our soul power hasn't been that great." Yan Yizhen was the first to answer.

Cai Yinzhi then said. "Your soul power can increase quickly because Zhang Fei's soul power is already high enough, but your grandfather's and father's soul power is on par with us, so we can't increase it as fast as you. Even so, our soul power is much better than before, but it will take us longer to reach your level."

"I see." Hong Xinxin nodded in understanding. "The important thing is that you two must not stop dual soul cultivating with my father and grandfather, and I will ask Zhang Fei to help you improve your soul power later."

"Zhang Fei is currently focusing on pursuing the Heaven Realm, so you don't need to bother him because of us." Cai Yinzhi suddenly remembered something. "Xi Hongyan has returned to the western region, so I think you can ask Mai Xiaomeng to come back here."

Instead, Hong Xinxin smiled bitterly. "I've told Mai Xiaomeng about Xi Hongyan, but she doesn't want to come back yet, especially since Zhang Fei keeps ignoring her. In the past two weeks, his real body never came out of seclusion, and his clone was busy with a blacksmithing competition, which made her frustrated."

"Haha." Yan Yizhen laughed at that. "Mai Xiaomeng has always been confident in her beauty and body, but she has now met a man who is not affected by either, so it is natural for her to feel frustrated. By the way, your grandfather contacted me yesterday that they were on their way to this realm, and they will arrive in a week."

"Do you want Zhang Fei to meet them, Mother?" Yan Yizhen nodded to Hong Xinxin. "All right, I will try to talk to him first, but I'm not sure if he will be willing to meet them now. I will go to the Murong Clan now, especially since Sister Qianying feels lonely."
A while later, Hong Xinxin was already sitting in front of Murong Qianying. "Do you miss Long'er, Sister Qianying?"

"Why do you still ask if you already know the answer?" Murong Qianying responded with a heavy sigh. "I haven't seen Long'er for almost two months, so I miss him so much. Despite moving my clan here, I still find it difficult to leave them unattended.

"Long'er's body cultivation just broke through to the third stage today, but he decided to enter seclusion to pursue his cultivation, so he sent Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen back here." Murong Qianying looked disappointed when she heard that, but Hong Xinxin then asked her. "Do you want me to bring him here?"

"I don't want my clan members to know about our relationship, so I'll wait until the situation is more stable and he comes out of isolation first. After that, I'll ask him to pick me up, and I'll spend some time with him." Murong Qianying then told her about something else. "Chongyun just contacted me, and they're not far from the Netherworld Realm, but they won't arrive there until two weeks. However, Long'er's close ties to demons from that realm worry me, and I'm afraid he'll meet them there."

"Are you afraid that Shang Chongyun and the others will kill him?" Murong Qianying nodded to Hong Xinxin, who then grabbed her hand. "Sister Qianying, you already know that Long'er is a smart child, and he is much stronger than you imagine. Even if he meets them there, they may not be able to do anything to him, so you don't have to worry about him. Instead, you should worry about them, and they might fall into his trap like us, especially Ran Keqing."

Murong Qianying raised her eyebrows after she remembered Ran Keqing. Back then, she tried to control Zhang Xiaolong [3], and she also asked Shang Yumei to do so. However, their plan failed miserably, and they fell into his arms instead. "If Keqing really falls to Long'er, Tinglong will probably get enraged and try to kill him. However, that kid has the ability to move between realms, so he should be safe."
"Therefore, you don't need to worry about Long'er, especially since he will be safe." Hong Xinxin then asked her. "Did you know that Shang Huaqiang sent Shang Xishun to the Wasteland Realm?"
"Why did he send that stupid woman there?"

Hong Xinxin shook her head. "Long'er, Shang Xinyu, and Shang Yifen have been in seclusion in the Wasteland Realm for the past two weeks. When they arrived there, he detected Shang Xishun's presence in the realm, and he immediately informed me. She would never move without Shang Huaqiang's orders, and I think it might have something to do with Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's relationship."

"You are right." Murong Qianying nodded in agreement. "Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's relationship would never have happened without Long'er's intervention, and he used his abilities to influence them. Forget it; we don't need to interfere in their affairs, and their affairs are good for us because it gives us plenty of time to prepare against them."
After they talked about some other things, Hong Xinxin went straight back to the Hong Clan and contacted Zhang Fei to get the Yang Tempering Liquid so he could start tempering his body again.

Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, who were enjoying their time, were shocked by the sudden appearance of Zhang Fei [5] in the Xian Realm. "Who exactly are you? Why did you lock us up in this empty realm?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed and returned to his ten-year-old form, causing Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's eyes to widen. "Do you two recognize me now?"

Shang Xiaoyin's face instantly darkened, especially since she had long suspected that he was the mastermind behind everything, which started with the incident of her falling unconscious for four whole days around seven months ago. "You! You were the one who saved Shang Yaolin from me back then, right?"

paragraphs: "Back then, I just arrived in the Wasteland Realm, so we don't know or have any problems with each other." Zhang Fei [5] returned to his adult form and summoned the demon extermination sword before pointing it at them, forcing Shang Baishi to pull Shang Xiaoyin behind him. "You only had old problems with Shang Yaolin, but you kidnapped me just because I was close to her, and you also thought of controlling me. Unfortunately, none of you are aware of my true identity, and I manage to do many things. How do you feel about becoming a mother in the next few months?"
"Did you do that to us?" Shang Baishi asked with a frown.

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Your wife's biggest mistake was asking her mother for help to catch me, but Shang Ziyuan sent you to help her instead. That night, I lured you two to follow me to the northern region, but you didn't realize that I let you knock me unconscious. When you two brought me to the beast blood pond, I purposely used my abilities to make you two horny, and the result that night was her pregnancy. Oh! You two don't need to try to remember, especially since I removed the events from your memories, so you guys will never remember anything that happened that day other than your sexual activities."
Both Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin were in deep shock after hearing all that. "What do you really want from us?"

"Nothing," Zhang Fei [5] answered with a shrug. "I don't need you guys; I just want revenge for what you did to me. Additionally, I knew that Shang Ziyuan's role in the Shang clan was more vital than Shang Huaqiang's, so I wanted to use you two to distract her, and my plan succeeded because she was on her way to look for you in these lower realms."
Shang Xiaoyin was frightened after she learned that Shang Xiyuan was looking for them in the lower realms. "Husband."
"I know." Shang Baishi rubbed her hand to calm her down. "Are you going to hand us over to my sister?"

"If I wanted to do that, I wouldn't hide you two in this realm, and I would directly send you to the Shang Clan." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate leading to the Hong Clan, which shocked Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, especially after Hong Xinxin walked out of it. "As you guys can see, this gate leads to the Hong Clan, so it's not difficult for me to send you guys back there."

Hong Xinxin only smiled at the two people's expressions, and she handed three storage rings to Zhang Fei [5]. One contains one hundred Yang Tempering Liquid, one containing Yang and Yin Qi from cultivators in the Saint Realm and above, and the other one containing Yang and Yin Qi from cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms. "I didn't expect that the two of them would escape so far to your home realm."

Zhang Fei [5] checked the three storage rings before storing them. "I myself never expected that they would escape here, and I only found out about it after my subordinates reported to me about their arrival."
"Are you sure Shang Ziyuan can't find them in this realm?" Hong Xinxin asked.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I'm not sure because there are several portals connecting to this realm, including the one in the Tian Realm. However, there is no Qi in my home realm, so Shang Ziyuan might not be interested in checking there. Even if she is interested in checking here and managing to find them, I will directly move them to another realm."

"I see." Hong Xinxin then told Zhang Fei [5]. "Sister Qianying missed you so much, especially since she hasn't seen you for almost two months, so I think you should meet her soon. In addition, my mother's family will arrive at our clan in a week, and she hopes you will be willing to meet them."

"I'm curious about your mother's family's speed technique, and I want to learn it for some of my wives, so I will meet them in a week." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer made Hong Xinxin's smile bloom. "However, I will not meet Murong Qianying for now, especially since my real body and other clones are still focused on pursuing the Heaven Realm. Once I reach that stage, I will use my third clone to meet her."

Hong Xinxin nodded. "You can arrange it yourself, but I hope you won't keep Sister Qianyung waiting for too long. I will go back to my clan now and tell my mother about your decision, and she will be delighted with it."

Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin did not expect that Zhang Fei [5] had such closeness with Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying, and their conversation made the two realize that the three of them had a special relationship.

After he closed the gate, Zhang Fei [5] spoke to them. "Aside from my relationship with them, I have personal grudges with Shang Huaqiang, Fei Qinyuan, and Shang Ziyuan. Once my business with them is finished, I will release you two, and you guys can start a new life in another realm with your child."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the realm, making both people feel relieved. Shang Xiaoyin then asked her husband. "Do you think that guy will destroy our clan?"

"That might happen." Shang Baishi answered with a serious expression. "We both know that so many people hate our Shang Clan, including the Hong and Murong clans. That man is not an ordinary cultivator; he can create a gate connecting this realm with the Red Sun Realm. Even senior artifact crafters like Senior Gong Ren and Senior Cheng Gaoji have never succeeded in creating a portal connecting the lower realms with the upper realms, especially since the distance between the two is simply too far. Their limit is the middle realms, so I think he has the ability to destroy our clan."
"I wanted to tell my mother or uncle about this matter, but we can't access our storage rings with our cultivation still sealed like now." Shang Xiaoyin softly sighed.

Shang Baishi turned to his wife with a frown. "Are you crazy? If we contact them, they might be able to track our location. If your mother finds us, she will kill me directly, and she will also force you to abort your pregnancy."
"I—" Shang Xiaoyin stopped abruptly and embraced Shang Baishi. "I don't want to lose you or my child."

Shang Baishi let out a soft sigh and hugged her back. "I don't want our clan to be destroyed, but I don't want to die either. Since we can't do anything, we don't need to think about it, and we will focus on our lives in this realm until our child is born. I hope that guy will let us go after his business with our clan is done, and I will take you away to a quieter realm to raise our child."
"Yeah."
Zhang Fei [5] wanted to return to the Nine Stars Realm, but he suddenly received a long-distance message from Feng Jinqiu, so he immediately went to the Sky Jade Realm to meet the ice phoenix.

When Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the Blazing Phoenix Sect, Feng Jinaqiu immediately handed over an unconscious woman to him. She was none other than Ma Mingxin, the leader of the Blossom Heaven Realm. "She had just arrived in this realm, and I immediately ambushed her."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] immediately checked Ma Mingxin's cultivation, and her cultivation was quite high in the 5-Moon Divine Expansion Realm. "I will bring this woman to me, and I will lock her up in a special place."
"What about Zhang Yue?"
"My big sister's cultivation has already reached the Earth Realm, and she helped me create several new techniques, all of which are based on the Ice Phoenix Manifestation."
"Can you show them to me?"
"Sure." Zhang Fei [5] activated all four elements. Soon, a fire salamander, a dark fairy, a wind fairy, and a light winged race appeared around them.

Feng Jinqiu was amazed to see the four. "Incredible! I didn't expect that you could use the Ice Phoenix Manifestation as a basis to create them! Now that I think about it, you are the only cultivator in this universe who has managed to give form to your elements; not even the Nameless One can do it. Have you also succeeded in creating other techniques?"

"I managed to create several other individual techniques, and all the ideas came from my big sister. Besides, I managed to create a combined technique with her, which no one would have thought of before." Zhang Fei [5] smiled at Feng Jinqiu's curious gaze, so he summoned Zhang Yue out of the training space. "Your master is curious about our combined technique, so how about we show it to him?"
"I think it's fine, but we have to do it outside because this small space is too small." Feng Jinqiu hurriedly led them out of her room, causing Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue to laugh at her antics.

After they arrived there, Zhang Fei [5] used his dark flame, and Zhang Yue used her ice element. Feng Jinqiu was shocked when they started to bring their two elements closer together, but she could see the confidence in their expressions, so she did not stop them and waited for the results.

Several minutes later, Feng Jinqiu fell into a daze after she saw the dark flame encircle an ice lotus, spinning in place in front of them. "This! How did you two create such a technique? Fire and ice elements are always opposites of each other, but you were able to combine the two. Although this technique is not completely perfect, it is already a miracle. What is the name of this technique?"

"Hellflame frozen lotus." Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Yue answered together. "It's hard for us to explain the process, and it took us quite a long time to create this technique. At first, we also thought that this technique would never come true, but we finally managed to create it."

If she hadn't seen it with her own eyes, Feng Jinqiu also wouldn't have believed that fire and ice could merge into one and form a technique. "Since this technique is still imperfect, we can't determine its grade, and we can only determine it after we see its explosive power or effect. However, combining two opposing elements into one is not a simple feat, and I think it will become a divine or even an immortal-grade technique once you perfect it. Unfortunately, combined techniques are not simple to use because you have to fight together, and you both have to have equal fighting abilities, or one of you will be a burden to the other."

They immediately withdrew their elements and removed the lotus. Zhang Yue then said to Feng Jinqiu. "Fei'er's fighting abilities are already several levels above mine, Senior Jinqiu. He has fought countless people, and he has defeated several cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms. However, I will never give up, and I will continue to improve myself to reach his level; only then can I fight by his side every time he faces his enemies."

"Yue'er, I have always said that you are an intelligent woman, and you have proven that by mastering all the sub-techniques of the Ice Phoenix Scripture." Zhang Fei [5] smiled hearing Feng Jinqiu's assessment of Zhang Yue, especially since he himself felt that his big sister was indeed intelligent, and she gave him many ideas for creating his new techniques. "The thing you lack is fighting experience, and you can't improve your fighting experience just by fighting low-rank beasts, especially since their intelligence is not comparable to humans. If you want to increase your fighting experience faster, you have to fight more with humans, high-rank beasts, or demons. Killing humans or demons may still be hard for you, but you have to get used to it, and your killing intent will increase as the number of your victims increases."
"Killing intent?"

Feng Jinqiu used her killing intent and directed it slightly toward Zhang Yue, which caused her to become dizzy and tremble in fear. However, she immediately pulled it back, and Zhang Fei [5] supported her big sister. "Killing intent is important not only in battle, but it is also important to protect yourself. Even if your cultivation level is not very high, you can utilize your killing intent to deter others, making them reconsider their attack.
Zhang Yu turned to his little brother. "How strong is your killing intent? I have never seen you fight in person, so I have never felt its power."

"You should sit down first, big sis." Zhang Yue immediately followed her little brother's words, but Zhang Fei [5] moved away from her. "I will increase my killing intent gradually, so you won't be shocked by its power."
"All right." Zhang Yue nodded.
Zhang Fei [5] took a slight breath before activating a bit of his killing intent, but that already made Zhang Yue quite frightened. "This is my weakest killing intent, Big Sis."
"Are you serious that this killing intent is still the weakest?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] then increased his killing intent a little, but Zhang Yue could still withstand its power. Therefore, he increased it a few more times until her big sister was trembling violently, forcing Feng Jinqiu to protect her with her aura. "To tell you the truth, this is still half of my killing intent's power, and everyone in this realm will be affected by it if I use its highest power."
"Try it, Fei'er! I want to know how high your killing intent is."
Zhang Fei [5] spoke to Feng Jinqiue. "Please take my big sister further away."
"All right." Feng Jinqiu herself was already scared enough by Zhang Fei [5]'s current killing intent power, so she directly took Zhang Yue away from him.
As soon as Zhang Fei [5] unleashed the full force of his killing intent, the area experienced a rapid drop in temperature and violent shaking of the ground.

Although her cultivation far surpassed Zhang Fei [5], Feng Jinqiu was truly frightened by his killing intent, which made her body tremble and be drenched in cold sweat. Meanwhile, Zhang Yue looked pale and breathless after she felt her little brother's killing intent, forcing the ice phoenix to fly even further, or she would have fainted.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately withdrew his killing intent before the cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm realized it. "That's the full power of my killing intent, Big Sis. Unlike you, my hands are soaked with the blood of countless living creatures, whether humans, beasts, or demons."

"I have never met a younger generation as terrifying as you, Zhang Fei. Even a cultivator of my level would have difficulty withstanding the power of your killing intent, and I probably wouldn't be able to move if I got too close to you." Feng Jinqiu spoke after she brought Zhang Yue to land in front of him. "In fact, your killing intent is still inferior to the Nameless One, but that is normal since you are only 20 years old now, and he has lived for tens of thousands of years. However, I believe your killing intent will be able to rival his in the next few years, and it might surpass him if you never stop killing."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response. "Honestly, I have never thought about increasing my killing intent, and it will continue to increase by itself every time I kill the enemies that come my way."
"That's true." Feng Jinqiu directly handed Zhang Yue to him. "You have to take her back and calm her down."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately sent Zhang Yue back to the training space, and he brought Ma Mingxin into the Yin-Yang space afterward, leaving Feng Jinqiu sighing to himself. "That kid only used his killing intent, but he was already so terrifying. I fear that if he unleashed his bloodlust, it would likely result in the instant death of all the cultivators in the ten mortal realms."
